description:
Isingeniso

 Le Ndlela Yomgwaqo isebenza eNgilandi, eScotland naseWales. INdlela Yomgwaqo iwukufundwa okubalulekile kuwo wonke umuntu.

 Inhloso yeNdlela Yomgwaqo ukukhuthaza ukuphepha emgwaqweni, ngenkathi futhi kusekelwa uhlelo lokuhamba olunempilo, oluqhubekayo nolusebenzayo.

 Amagama eNdlela Yomgwaqo

 Imithetho eminingi kule Ndlela iyizidingo zomthetho, futhi uma ungayilaleli le mithetho wenza icala lobugebengu. Ungahlawuliswa, unikezwe amaphuzu esijeziso kulayisensi yakho noma ungavunyelwe ukushayela. Ezimweni ezimbi kakhulu ungathunyelwa ejele.

 Imithetho enjalo itholakala ngokusebenzisa amagama athi ‘AKUMELE/AKUMELE’. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lo mthetho uhlanganisa ukubhekisela okufushane emthethweni odala icala. Bheka incazelo yezifinyezo.

 Nakuba ukwehluleka ukulandela eminye imithetho yeKhodi kungeke, ngokwako, kubangele ukuthi umuntu ashushiswe, i-Highway Code ingasetshenziswa ebufakazini kunoma yiziphi izinqubo zenkantolo ngaphansi kweMithetho Yezomgwaqo (bheka umsebenzisi womgwaqo kanye nomthetho) ukuze kutholakale icala. Lokhu kufaka phakathi imithetho esebenzisa amagama eseluleko njengokuthi `kufanele/akufanele` noma `yenza/ungayenzi`.

 Ukwazi nokusebenzisa imithetho

 Ukwazi nokusebenzisa imithetho equkethwe ku-Highway Code kunganciphisa kakhulu ukulimala komgwaqo. Ukunciphisa inani lokufa nokulimala okwenzeka emigwaqweni yethu nsuku zonke kuyisibopho sonke esinaso. I-Highway Code ingasisiza ukuthi sifeze lowo mthwalo wemfanelo.

 Ulwazi olwengeziwe mayelana namasu okushayela nokugibela lungatholakala ku-`The Official DVSA Guide to Driving - the essential skills` kanye ne-`The Official DVSA Guide to Riding - the essential skills`.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 1. Isingeniso
description:
Izimoto ezizishayela zona

 Ngokuthi ‘izimoto ezizishayela zona’, sisho lezo ezibhalwe njengezimoto ezizenzakalelayo nguNobhala Wezokuthutha ngaphansi koMthetho Wezimoto Ezizenzakalelayo Nezikagesi ka-2018.

 Ukuze uhlole ukuthi imoto yakho izishayela zona, vakashela ‘Izimoto ezizishayela zona ezibhalwe ukusetshenziswa eGreat Britain’.

 Lezi zimoto ziyakwazi ukuzishayela zona ngokuphepha uma umsebenzi wokuzishayela uvuliwe kahle futhi umshayeli elandela imiyalelo yomenzi. Ngenkathi imoto izishayela zona, awudingi ukuyiqapha.

 Izimoto ezizishayela zona zihlukile ezimotweni ezifakwe izici zokushayela ezisizwayo kuphela, njengokulawula ukuhamba ngesikebhe kanye nosizo lokugcina umzila. Izici zokushayela ezisizwayo zingenza okunye kokushayela, kodwa umshayeli kusadingeka abe nesibopho sokushayela ngaso sonke isikhathi. Uma ushayela imoto usebenzisa izici zayo zokushayela ezisizwayo kuphela, uMthetho 150 uyasebenza.

 Ikhono lemoto ezishayela yona ngokwayo lingakhawulelwa ezimweni ezithile noma izingxenye zohambo. Izinto ezifana nohlobo lomgwaqo, isikhathi sosuku, isimo sezulu, indawo kanye nesivinini kungathinta lokhu. Kufanele ulandele imiyalelo yomenzi mayelana nokuthi ungayisebenzisa nini futhi kanjani umsebenzi wokuzishayela ngokuphephile.

 Ngenkathi imoto ezishayela yona izishayela ngokwayo esimweni esivumelekile, awunasibopho sendlela eshayela ngayo. Ungasusa ukunaka kwakho emgwaqweni futhi ungabuka nokuqukethwe ngedivayisi yokuzijabulisa yemoto eyakhelwe ngaphakathi, uma ikhona.

 Kodwa KUMELE usalandele yonke imithetho efanele:

 • KUMELE ulungele ukushayela. Isibonelo, kumele ube ngaphakathi kwemingcele esemthethweni yokushayela uphuze futhi ungabi ngaphansi kwethonya lezidakamizwa. Bheka Imithetho 90 kuya ku-96.

 • Imoto KUMELE ibe semthethweni emgwaqweni. Isibonelo, kumele ibe nesitifiketi se-MOT, uma sikhona, futhi kumele ikhokhiswe intela futhi iqinisekiswe.

 • Imoto kumele ifanelekele ukuba semgwaqweni. Bheka Imithetho 89 no-97, ‘Imibhalo yemoto kanye nezidingo zomshayeli ofundayo’, kanye ‘nokugcinwa kwemoto, ukuphepha nokuvikeleka’.

 • Uzobe usaphethe abagibeli bakho nanoma yini enye oyiphethe. Bheka Imithetho 98 kuya ku-102.

 • AKUMELE wenze noma yini engekho emthethweni, njengokusebenzisa ifoni ephathekayo noma idivayisi efanayo ephathwa ngesandla. Okuhlukile kulokhu kuchazwe kuMthetho 149.

 Uma imoto ezishayelayo idinga ukubuyisela ukulawula kumshayeli, izokunikeza isixwayiso esanele sokwenza lokhu ngokuphephile. KUMELE uhlale ukwazi futhi ulungele ukulawula, futhi KUMELE wenze kanjalo lapho imoto ikubuza. Isibonelo, kufanele uhlale esihlalweni sokushayela futhi uhlale uphapheme.

 Uma usuthathe ukulawula noma uvale umsebenzi wokuzishayela, unesibopho sazo zonke izici zokushayela.

 Imithetho: Izigaba ze-RTA 2, 3, 4, 5, 5A, 14 kanye no-15; isigaba 1 se-AEVA; kanye nemithethonqubo ye-CUR 100, 104, 109 (njengoba kuguqulwe yi-Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) (Automated Vehicles) Order 2022) kanye no-110, njengoba kushintshwe yi-CUR(A) (No. 2) Regulations 2022.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 1. Isingeniso
description:
Uhlu lwabasebenzisi bomgwaqo

 `Uhlu lwabasebenzisi bomgwaqo` luwumqondo obeka labo basebenzisi bomgwaqo engozini enkulu uma kwenzeka ingozi ephezulu. Uhlu lwabasebenzisi bomgwaqo alususi isidingo sokuba wonke umuntu aziphathe kahle.

 Abasebenzisi bomgwaqo abasengozini enkulu yokulimala uma kwenzeka ingozi ngabahamba ngezinyawo, abagibeli bamabhayisikili, abagibeli bamahhashi nabagibeli bamabhayisikili, kanti izingane, abantu abadala kanye nabantu abakhubazekile basengozini enkulu. Imithetho elandelayo ye-H icacisa lo mqondo.

 Umthetho H1

 Kubalulekile ukuthi BONKE abasebenzisi bomgwaqo:

 • baqaphele i-Highway Code
• bacabangele abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo
• baqonde umthwalo wabo wokuphepha kwabanye.

 Wonke umuntu uyahlupheka lapho kwenzeka ingozi yomgwaqo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi balimele ngokomzimba noma cha. Kodwa-ke, labo abaphethe izimoto ezingadala umonakalo omkhulu uma kwenzeka ingozi banesibopho esikhulu sokuqapha nokunciphisa ingozi eziyibangela kwabanye. Lesi simiso sisebenza kakhulu kubashayeli balezi:

 • izimpahla ezinkulu kanye nezimoto zabagibeli
• amaveni namabhasi amancane
• izimoto namatekisi
• izithuthuthu.

 Abagibeli bamabhayisikili, abagibeli bamahhashi kanye nabashayeli bezimoto ezidonswa amahhashi nabo banesibopho sokunciphisa ingozi kubahamba ngezinyawo.

 Akukho kulokhu okunciphisa umthwalo wemfanelo wabo BONKE abasebenzisi bomgwaqo, okuhlanganisa abahamba ngezinyawo, abagibeli bamabhayisikili kanye nabagibeli bamahhashi, wokunaka ukuphepha kwabo kanye nokuphepha kwabanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo.

 Khumbula njalo ukuthi abantu ohlangana nabo bangase babe nokungaboni kahle, ukuzwa noma ukuhamba, nokuthi lokhu kungase kungabonakali.

 Umthetho H2

 Umthetho wabashayeli, abagibeli bezithuthuthu, izimoto ezidonswa ngamahhashi, abagibeli bamahhashi kanye nabagibeli bamabhayisikili.

 Endaweni yokuhlangana, kufanele unikeze indlela abahambi ngezinyawo abawela noma abalinde ukuwela umgwaqo ojika kuwo noma osuka kuwo.

 KUMELE unikeze indlela abahambi ngezinyawo abawela i-zebra, kanye nabahamba ngezinyawo nabagibeli bamabhayisikili abawela i-zebra. Bheka Umthetho 195.

 Abahamba ngezinyawo babaluleke kakhulu lapho bewela i-zebra, lapho bewela i-parallel noma lapho bewela khona ukukhanya lapho benesiginali eluhlaza.

 Kufanele unikeze indlela abahambi ngezinyawo abalinde ukuwela i-zebra, kanye nabahamba ngezinyawo nabagibeli bamabhayisikili abalinde ukuwela i-parallel.

 Abagibeli bamabhayisikili kufanele banikeze ithuba abahambi ngezinyawo emigwaqweni yamabhayisikili esetshenziswa ngokuhlanganyela kanye nabagibeli bamahhashi emigwaqweni yamabhuloho.

 Abahamba ngezinyawo kuphela abangasebenzisa umgwaqo. Abahamba ngezinyawo bahlanganisa abasebenzisi be-wheelchair kanye ne-mobility scooter.

 Abahamba ngezinyawo bangasebenzisa noma iyiphi ingxenye yomgwaqo futhi basebenzise imizila yamabhayisikili kanye nomgwaqo, ngaphandle kokuthi izimpawu zivimbela abahamba ngezinyawo.

 Umthetho H2: Linda umuntu ohamba ngezinyawo awele umgwaqo ngaphambi kokujika. Lokhu kusebenza noma ngabe ujika kwesokudla noma kwesobunxele ungene emgwaqweni.

 Imithetho: I-TSRGD Isheduli 14, izingxenye 1 no-5; HA 1835 isigaba 72; R(S)A isigaba 129 sika-1984; kanye noMthetho Wasemaphandleni ka-1968, isigaba 1, ingxenye 30.

 Umthetho H3

 Umthetho wabashayeli nabagibeli bamabhayisikili.

 Akufanele udlule abagibeli bamabhayisikili, abagibeli bamahhashi noma izimoto ezidonswa amahhashi ezihamba phambili uma ujika noma uphuma endaweni yokuhlangana, ushintsha indlela noma ushintsha umzila, njengoba nje ungeke ujike endleleni yemoto ethile. Lokhu kusebenza kungakhathaliseki ukuthi basebenzisa umzila wamabhayisikili, basebenzisa umzila wamabhayisikili noma bagibela phambili emgwaqweni. Kufanele ubanikeze indlela.

 Ungajiki endaweni yokuhlangana uma ukwenza kanjalo kungabangela ukuthi umgibeli wamabhayisikili, umgibeli wehhashi noma imoto edonswa yihhashi ehamba phambili ime noma iphambuke.

 Kufanele ume bese ulinda igebe eliphephile ekuhambeni kwabagibeli bamabhayisikili uma kudingeka. Lokhu kufaka phakathi lapho abagibeli bamabhayisikili:

 • besondela, bedlula noma besuka endaweni yokuhlangana
• bedlula noma belinde eceleni kwethrafikhi engami noma ehamba kancane
• behambahamba endaweni ezungezayo.

 Umthetho H3: Linda umgibeli webhayisikili ukuthi adlule endaweni yokuhlangana ngaphambi kokujika. Lokhu kusebenza futhi uma kukhona umzila wamabhayisikili noma ithrekhi yamabhayisikili nokuthi ujika kwesokudla noma kwesobunxele ungene endaweni yokuhlangana.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 2. Imithetho yabahamba ngezinyawo (1 kuya ku-35)
description:
Isiqondiso esijwayelekile (Imithetho 1 kuya ku-6)

 Umthetho 1

 Izindawo zokuhamba ngezinyawo kanye nezinyawo, okuhlanganisa nanoma iyiphi indlela eceleni komgwaqo, kufanele kusetshenziswe uma kunikezwe. Lapho kungenzeka khona, gwema ukuba seduze nomgwaqo ufulathele ithrafikhi. Uma kufanele ungene emgwaqweni, bheka zombili izindlela kuqala.

 Hlala uqaphele indawo okuyo futhi ugweme iziphazamiso ezingadingekile. Njalo bonisa ukunakekelwa okufanele nokucabangela abanye.

 Umthetho 2

 Uma kungekho mgwaqo, hlala ngakwesokudla komgwaqo ukuze ubone izimoto ezizayo. Kufanele uqaphele kakhulu futhi:

 • ulungele ukuhamba ngomugqa owodwa, ikakhulukazi emigwaqweni emincane noma ekukhanyeni okubi
• hlala eduze komgwaqo.

 Kungaba ngcono ukuwela umgwaqo ngaphambi kokugoba okubukhali kwesokudla ukuze izimoto ezizayo zibe nethuba elingcono lokukubona. Buyela emuva ngemva kokugoba.

 Umthetho 3

 Siza abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo ukuthi bakubone. Gqoka noma uphathe into enombala okhanyayo, okhanyayo noma okhanyayo ezimweni ezimbi zokukhanya kwelanga.

 Uma kumnyama, sebenzisa izinto ezikhanyayo, isibonelo amabhande, amabhande, amajazi, amajakethi noma izicathulo. Izinto ezikhanyayo zingabonwa abashayeli abasebenzisa izibani zemoto ezikude kathathu kunezinto ezingabonisi.

 Umthetho 4

 Izingane ezincane akufanele zibe ngaphandle zodwa emgwaqweni noma emgwaqweni. Bheka Umthetho 7.

 Lapho ukhipha izingane:

 • hlala phakathi kwazo nezimoto
• bamba izandla zabo ngokuqinile
• bopha izingane ezincane kakhulu ezihlalweni noma usebenzise izintambo.

 Uma usunduza ingane encane enqoleni, ungayisunduzi inqola emgwaqweni uma uhlola ukuthi icacile yini ukuthi iwele, ikakhulukazi uma uphuma phakathi kwezimoto ezipakiwe.

 Umthetho 5

 Ukuhamba okuhleliwe noma imibuthano ehilela amaqembu amakhulu abantu abahamba emgwaqweni kufanele basebenzise indlela yokuhamba ngezinyawo uma ikhona. Uma indlela yokuhamba ngezinyawo ingekho, kufanele bahlale ngakwesobunxele.

 Izindawo zokulinda kufanele zibekwe ngaphambili nangemuva kweqembu. Kufanele bagqoke izingubo ezikhanyayo emini kanye nezingubo ezikhanyayo ebumnyameni.

 Ebusuku:

 • indawo yokulinda ngaphambili kufanele ibonise ukukhanya okumhlophe
• indawo yokulinda ngemuva kufanele ibonise ukukhanya okubomvu
• abantu abangaphandle kwamaqembu amakhulu kufanele nabo baphathe izibani futhi bagqoke izingubo ezikhanyayo.

 Umthetho 6

 Imigwaqo Emikhulu

 Abahamba ngezinyawo AKUMELE babe semigwaqweni emikhulu noma emigwaqweni eshelelayo ngaphandle uma kunesimo esiphuthumayo. Bheka Imithetho 272 kanye no-277.

 Imithetho: Isigaba 17 se-RTRA; umthethonqubo we-MT(E&W)R 15(1)(b); kanye nomthethonqubo we-MT(S)R 13.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 2. Imithetho yabahamba ngezinyawo (1 kuya ku-35)
description:
Ukuwela umgwaqo (Imithetho 7 kuya ku-17)

 Umthetho 7

 Ikhodi Yesiphambano Esiluhlaza

 Iseluleko esingezansi mayelana nokuwela umgwaqo singesabo bonke abahamba ngezinyawo. Izingane kufanele zifundiswe iKhodi futhi akufanele zivunyelwe ukuphuma zodwa kuze kube yilapho seziyiqonda futhi ziyisebenzise kahle. Ubudala lapho zingakwenza lokhu buhlukile kumntwana ngamunye.

 Izingane eziningi azikwazi ukwahlulela ukuthi izimoto zihamba ngesivinini esingakanani noma ukuthi zikude kangakanani. Izingane zifunda ngesibonelo, ngakho abazali nabanakekeli kufanele bahlale besebenzisa iKhodi ngokugcwele lapho behamba nezingane zabo. Abazali nabanakekeli banomthwalo wemfanelo wokunquma ukuthi izingane zingayisebenzisa ngokuphepha nini zodwa.

 A. Okokuqala thola indawo ephephile yokuwela

 Thola indawo ephephile yokuwela nalapho kunendawo yokufinyelela umgwaqo ngakolunye uhlangothi. Lapho kukhona indawo yokuwela eduze, sebenzisa.

 Kuphephile ukuwela usebenzisa:

 • isitimela esingaphansi komhlaba
• ibhuloho labahamba ngezinyawo
• isiqhingi
• indawo yokuwela i-zebra
• indawo yokuwela i-pelican
• indawo yokuwela i-toucan
• indawo yokuwela i-puffin elawulwa yiphoyisa, iphoyisa lokuwela isikole noma umphathi wethrafikhi.

 Ngaphandle kwalokho, khetha indawo lapho ungabona khona ngokucacile kuzo zonke izinhlangothi. Zama ukugwema ukuwela:

 • phakathi kwezimoto ezipakiwe — bheka uMthetho 14
• endaweni egobile
• eduze kwekhanda legquma.

 Hamba uye endaweni lapho abashayeli nabagibeli bangakubona khona ngokucacile. Ungaweqi umgwaqo ngokuphambene.

 B. Yima ngaphambi komgwaqo

 Yima ngaphambi nje kokuba ufike emkhawulweni, lapho ungabona khona ukuthi kukhona yini okuzayo. Ungasondeli kakhulu ethrafikhini. Uma kungekho mgwaqo, hlala kude nomgwaqo ngenkathi uqinisekisa ukuthi usakwazi ukubona ithrafikhi esondelayo.

 C. Bheka futhi ulalele

 Bheka yonke indawo ukuthola ithrafikhi bese ulalela. Ithrafikhi ingavela kunoma iyiphi indlela. Lalela futhi ubheke ngoba ngezinye izikhathi ungazwa ithrafikhi ngaphambi kokuba uyibone.

 D. Vumela ithrafikhi esondelayo idlule

 Uma ithrafikhi iza, yivumele idlule. Bheka yonke indawo futhi ulalele. Ungaweli kuze kube yilapho kukhona isikhala esiphephile ethrafikhini futhi uqinisekile ukuthi kunesikhathi esanele. Khumbula ukuthi ngisho nethrafikhi ekude kakhulu ingase isondele ngokushesha okukhulu.

 E. Wela ngokuphepha

 Uma kuphephile, hamba ngqo ngaphesheya komgwaqo futhi ungagijimi. Qhubeka ubheka futhi ulalele ithrafikhi ngenkathi uwela uma kwenzeka ukuthi kukhona ithrafikhi ongayibonanga noma kuvela eminye ithrafikhi ngokuzumayo.

 Qaphela abagibeli bamabhayisikili nabagibeli bamabhayisikili abahamba phakathi kwemizila yethrafikhi. Ungahambi ngokuvundlile ngaphesheya komgwaqo.

 Umthetho 8

 Endaweni yokuhlangana

 Uma uwela noma ulinde ukuwela umgwaqo, eminye ithrafikhi kufanele idedele indlela. Qaphela ithrafikhi ephendukela emgwaqweni, ikakhulukazi ngemuva kwakho, bese uwela endaweni lapho abashayeli bangakubona khona.

 Uma usuqalile ukuwela futhi ithrafikhi ifuna ukujika emgwaqweni, unezinto eziza kuqala futhi ithrafikhi kufanele idedele indlela. Bheka Imithetho H2 kanye no-170.

 Umthetho 9

 Izithiyo zokuphepha zabahamba ngezinyawo

 Lapho kunezithiyo, weqa umgwaqo kuphela ezikhaleni ezinikezwe abahamba ngezinyawo. Ungakhweli phezu kwezithiyo noma uhambe phakathi kwazo nomgwaqo.

 Umthetho 10

 Ukugandaya okuthintekayo

 Izindawo eziphakeme ezingase zithinteke ngaphansi kwezinyawo zinikeza isixwayiso nesiqondiso kubantu abayizimpumputhe noma abangaboni kahle.

 Izindawo ezivame kakhulu yilezi:

 • uchungechunge lwezinti eziphakeme, ezisetshenziswa ezindaweni zokuwela ezine-curb ewile
• uchungechunge lwezinti eziphakeme eziyindilinga, ezisetshenziswa ezindaweni zokuwela ezilinganayo, phezulu nangaphansi kwezitebhisi nakwezinye izingozi.

 Umthetho 11

 Imigwaqo ehamba ngendlela eyodwa

 Hlola ukuthi ithrafikhi ihamba ngakuphi. Ungaweli kuze kube yilapho kuphephile ukwenza kanjalo ngaphandle kokuma. Imizila yamabhasi namabhayisikili ingase isebenze ngendlela ephambene nayo yonke ithrafikhi.

 Umthetho 12

 Imizila yamabhasi namabhayisikili

 Qaphela lapho uwela imizila yamabhasi namabhayisikili ngoba ithrafikhi ingase ihambe ngokushesha kunakweminye imizila noma ngokumelene nokuhamba kwethrafikhi.

 Umthetho 13

 Imizila ehlanganyelwe nabahamba ngamabhayisikili

 Imizila yamabhayisikili ingahamba eceleni kwemizila yabahamba ngezinyawo noma amaphevimenti futhi ihlukaniswe yisici esifana nalesi:

 • ushintsho lwezinto
• umngcele
• unqenqema
• umugqa omhlophe.

 Le mizila ingase ihlanganise nobude obufushane bokugandaya okuthintekayo ukusiza abantu abangaboni kahle ukuthi bahlale ohlangothini olufanele.

 Ohlangothini lwabahamba ngezinyawo, ukugandaya okuthintekayo kungafaka uchungechunge lwezingodo ezinezithende ezisicaba ezigijima ngaphesheya kohambo, ezaziwa ngokuthi iphethini yeladi. Ngasohlangothini lomgibeli wamabhayisikili, imigoqo efanayo iqondiswe endleleni yokuhamba, eyaziwa ngokuthi iphethini ye-tramline.

 Eminye imizila eyabelwana ngayo nabagibeli bamabhayisikili ayihlukaniswa yisici esinjalo, okuvumela abagibeli bamabhayisikili nabahamba ngezinyawo ukuthi babelane ngendawo efanayo. Abagibeli bamabhayisikili kufanele bahloniphe ukuphepha kwakho — bheka uMthetho 62 — kodwa kufanele futhi uqaphele ukuthi ungabavimbi noma ubabeke engozini. Hlala uqaphela indawo yakho futhi ugweme iziphazamiso ezingadingekile.

 Lapho izimpawu zibonisa khona, eminye imizila yabelwana phakathi kwabahamba ngezinyawo, abagibeli bamabhayisikili, abagibeli bamahhashi kanye nezimoto ezidonswa amahhashi. Abagibeli bamabhayisikili, abagibeli bamahhashi kanye nabashayeli bezimoto ezidonswa amahhashi kufanele bahloniphe ukuphepha kwakho, kodwa kufanele uqaphele ukuthi ungabavimbi noma ubabeke engozini. Hlala uqaphela indawo yakho futhi ugweme iziphazamiso ezingadingekile.

 Umthetho 14

 Izimoto ezipakiwe

 Uma kufanele uwele phakathi kwezimoto ezipakiwe, sebenzisa imiphetho yangaphandle yezimoto njengokungathi ziyi-curb. Yima lapho bese uqinisekisa ukuthi uyakwazi ukubona yonke indawo nokuthi ithrafikhi iyakubona.

 Qiniseka ukuthi kukhona isikhala phakathi kwanoma yiziphi izimoto ezipakwe ngakolunye uhlangothi ukuze ukwazi ukufinyelela endaweni yokuhamba ngezinyawo.

 Ungalokothi uwele umgwaqo phambi noma ngemuva kwanoma iyiphi imoto enenjini yayo isebenza, ikakhulukazi imoto enkulu, ngoba umshayeli angase angakwazi ukukubona.

 Umthetho 15

 Izimoto ezibuyela emuva

 Ungalokothi uwele ngemuva kwemoto ebuyela emuva, ekhombisa izibani ezimhlophe ezibuyela emuva noma ezwakalisa isixwayiso.

 Umthetho 16

 Izimoto ezihambayo

 AKUMELE ungene noma ubambe imoto ehambayo.

 Umthetho: RTA 1988 isigaba 26.

 Umthetho 17

 Ebusuku

 Gqoka into ekhanyayo ukuze kube lula ngabanye ukukubona. Bheka uMthetho 3.

 Uma kungekho ndawo yokuwela abahamba ngezinyawo eduze, wela umgwaqo eduze kwesibani somgwaqo ukuze ithrafikhi ikubone kalula.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 2. Imithetho yabahamba ngezinyawo (1 kuya ku-35)
description:
Ukuwela (Imithetho 18 kuya ku-30)

 Umthetho 18

 Kuzo zonke izindawo zokuwela

 Uma usebenzisa noma yiluphi uhlobo lokuwela, kufanele:

 • hlola njalo ukuthi ithrafikhi ime ngaphambi kokuthi uqale ukuwela noma ucindezele i-pram uye endaweni yokuwela
• njalo uwele phakathi kwezipikili noma ngaphezulu kwezimpawu ze-zebra.

 Ungaweli eceleni kwendawo yokuwela noma emigqeni ye-zig-zag, njengoba lokhu kungaba yingozi.

 AKUMELE uzulazule kunoma yiluphi uhlobo lokuwela.

 Imithetho: I-TSRGD Isheduli 14, Ingxenye 5, kanye nesigaba se-RTRA 25(5).

 Umthetho 19

 Ukuwela kwe-Zebra

 Nikeza izimoto isikhathi esanele sokukubona nokuma ngaphambi kokuba uqale ukuwela. Izimoto zizodinga isikhathi esengeziwe sokuma lapho umgwaqo ushelela.

 Linda kuze kube yilapho izimoto zima kuzo zombili izinhlangothi noma umgwaqo usucacile ngaphambi kokuwela. Khumbula ukuthi izimoto akudingeki zime kuze kube yilapho othile esengene endaweni yokuwela.

 Abashayeli nabagibeli kufanele banikeze ithuba abahamba ngezinyawo abalinde ukuwela futhi KUMELE banikeze ithuba abahamba ngezinyawo endaweni yokuwela i-zebra. Bheka uMthetho H2.

 Qhubeka ubheka izinhlangothi zombili futhi ulalele uma kwenzeka umshayeli noma umgibeli engakubonanga futhi ezama ukudlula imoto emi.

 Izindawo zokuwela i-zebra zinezibani ezikhanyayo.

 Indawo yokuwela i-zebra enesiqhingi esiphakathi iyizindawo ezimbili zokuwela ezihlukene. Bheka uMthetho 20.

 UMthetho: I-TSRGD Ishejuli 14, Ingxenye 5.

 UMthetho 20

 Lapho kukhona isiqhingi phakathi nendawo yokuwela i-zebra, linda esiqhingini bese ulandela uMthetho 19 ngaphambi kokuwela ingxenye yesibili yomgwaqo. Kuyindawo yokuwela ehlukile.

 Umthetho 21

 Ezibanini zomgwaqo

 Kungase kube nezimpawu ezikhethekile zabahamba ngezinyawo. Kufanele uqale ukuwela umgwaqo kuphela uma isithombe esiluhlaza sibonakala.

 Uma usuqalile ukuwela futhi isithombe esiluhlaza siphuma, kufanele usenesikhathi sokufika kolunye uhlangothi, kodwa ungalibali.

 Uma kungekho zimpawu zabahamba ngezinyawo ezinikeziwe, qaphela ngokucophelela futhi ungaweli kuze kube yilapho izibani zomgwaqo zibomvu futhi ithrafikhi isimile.

 Qhubeka ubheka futhi uhlole ithrafikhi engase iphenduke ekhoneni. Khumbula ukuthi izibani zomgwaqo zingavumela ithrafikhi ukuthi ihambe kwezinye izindlela ngenkathi ithrafikhi kwezinye izindlela isimile.

 Umthetho 22

 Ukuwela iPelican

 Ukuwela iPelican kuyizindawo zokuwela ezilawulwa yisignali eziqhutshwa abahamba ngezinyawo. Cindezela inkinobho yokulawula ukuze usebenzise izimpawu zomgwaqo.

 Uma isithombe esibomvu sibonakala, ungaweli. Uma isithombe esiluhlaza esiqinile sibonakala, hlola ukuthi ithrafikhi imile bese uwela ngokucophelela.

 Uma isithombe esiluhlaza siqala ukukhanya, akufanele uqale ukuwela. Uma usuqalile ukuwela, kufanele ube nesikhathi sokuqeda ngokuphephile.

 Umthetho 23

 Ukuwela iPuffin

 Ukuwela iPuffin kuhlukile ekuweleni iPelican ngoba izibalo ezibomvu neziluhlaza zingaphezu kwebhokisi lokulawula ohlangothini lwakho lomgwaqo, futhi akukho sigaba sesibalo esiluhlaza esikhanyayo.

 Cindezela inkinobho bese ulinda isithombe esiluhlaza sibonakale.

 Umthetho 24

 Imigwaqo eminyene

 Uma umgwaqo uminyene, ithrafikhi eseceleni kwakho ingaphoqeleka ukuthi ime noma izibani zayo ziluhlaza. Ithrafikhi ingase isahamba ngakolunye uhlangothi lomgwaqo, ngakho-ke cindezela inkinobho bese ulinda isignali ukuthi iwele.

 Umthetho 25

 Ukuwela iToucan

 Ukuwela iToucan yizindawo zokuwela ezilawulwa ukukhanya ezivumela abagibeli bamabhayisikili nabahamba ngezinyawo ukuthi babelane ngendawo yokuwela futhi bawele ngesikhathi esifanayo. Ziqhutshwa ngenkinobho yokucindezela.

 Abahamba ngezinyawo nabagibele amabhayisikili babona isignali eluhlaza ndawonye. Abagibeli bamabhayisikili bavunyelwe ukugibela ngaphesheya.

 Umthetho 26

 Izimpawu zabantu abanenkinga yokuzwa

 Kwezinye izindawo zokuwela, kunomsindo ozwakalayo noma isibonakaliso sezwi esibonisa abantu abayizimpumputhe noma abangaboni kahle lapho kuvela isithombe esiluhlaza esiqinile. Kungase kube nesibonakaliso sokuthinta ukusiza abantu abayizimpumputhe.

 Umthetho 27

 Ukuwela amahhashi

 Ukuwela amahhashi kungokwabagibeli bamahhashi. Banalokhu:

 • izithiyo zokuhamba ngezinyawo
• izikhala ezibanzi zokuwela
• imidwebo yamahhashi nabagibeli kumaphaneli okukhanya
• kungaba amasethi amabili ezilawuli, elinye lawo liphakeme, noma iphaneli yokulawula eyodwa ephakeme.

 Umthetho 28

 Ukuwela i-pelican noma i-puffin edidekile

 Lapho izindawo zokuwela ohlangothini ngalunye lwesiphephelo esiphakathi zingekho emgqeni, ziyizindawo ezimbili zokuwela ezihlukene. Lapho ufika esiqhingini esiphakathi, cindezela inkinobho futhi bese ulinda isithombe esiluhlaza esiqinile.

 Umthetho 29

 Izindawo zokuwela ezilawulwa ngumuntu ogunyaziwe

 Ungaweli umgwaqo ngaphandle kokuthi unikezwe iphoyisa, umphathi wethrafikhi noma iphoyisa eliqapha ukuwela isikole. Njalo weqa phambi kwabo.

 Umthetho 30

 Ukuwela lapho kungekho khona izindawo zokuwela ezilawulwayo

 Lapho kungekho khona izindawo zokuwela ezilawulwayo, kungcono ukuwela lapho kunesiqhingi phakathi nomgwaqo.

 Sebenzisa i-Green Cross Code — bheka uMthetho 7 — ukuze weqe esiqhingini. Yima esiqhingini bese usebenzisa i-Green Cross Code futhi ukuze weqe ingxenye yesibili yomgwaqo.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 2. Imithetho yabahamba ngezinyawo (1 kuya ku-35)
subcategory: Izimo ezidinga ukunakekelwa okwengeziwe (imithetho 31 kuya ku-35)
description:
Izimo ezidinga ukunakekelwa okwengeziwe (Imithetho 31 kuya ku-35)

 Umthetho 31

 Izimoto eziphuthumayo

 Uma i-ambulensi, injini yomlilo, imoto yamaphoyisa noma enye imoto ephuthumayo isondela isebenzisa izibani eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ezikhanyayo, izibani zangaphambili kanye/noma ama-siren, hlala kude nomgwaqo.

 Umthetho 32

 Amabhasi

 Gibela noma wehle ebhasini kuphela uma lime ukuze likuvumele wenze kanjalo. Qaphela abagibeli bamabhayisikili uma wehla.

 Ungalokothi uwele umgwaqo ngemuva noma phambi kwebhasi. Linda kuze kube yilapho selihambile futhi ubona ngokucacile kuzo zombili izinhlangothi.

 Umthetho 33

 Ama-tramway

 Ama-tramway angase adlule ezindaweni zabahamba ngezinyawo. Indlela yawo izophawulwa ngokuthi:

 • izinqenqema ezingajulile
• izinguquko endaweni yokupaka noma kwenye indawo yomgwaqo
• imigqa emhlophe
• amachashazi aphuzi.

 Wela ezindaweni zokuwela ezibekiwe lapho kuhlinzekwe khona. Kwenye indawo, phatha ama-tram njengoba ubungaphatha ezinye izimoto zomgwaqo bese ubheka zombili izindlela eceleni komzila ngaphambi kokuwela.

 Ungahambi eceleni komzila, njengoba ama-tram angase avele ngemuva kwakho. Ama-tram ahamba buthule futhi awakwazi ukuqondisa ukuze akugweme.

 Umthetho 34

 Izindawo zokuwela ezingeni lesitimela

 AKUMELE uwele noma udlule umugqa wokuma lapho izibani ezibomvu zibonakala, okuhlanganisa nalapho kuboniswa khona umuntu ohamba ngezinyawo obomvu.

 Ungaweli uma:

 • i-alamu ikhala
• izithiyo ziyehliswa.

 Ithoni ye-alamu ingashintsha uma esinye isitimela sisondela.

 Uma kungekho zibani, ama-alamu noma izithiyo, yima, ubheke zombili izinhlangothi bese ulalela ngaphambi kokuwela.

 Indawo ethintekayo equkethe imigoqo eyindilinga egijima ngaphesheya kohambo lwabahamba ngezinyawo ingafakwa endleleni yabahamba ngezinyawo esondela endaweni yokuwela esezingeni eliphezulu ukuze kuxwayiswe abantu abangaboni kahle ngokuba khona kwayo. Indawo ethintekayo kufanele idlulele ububanzi obugcwele bendlela yabahamba ngezinyawo futhi kufanele ibekwe ebangeni elifanele ukusuka endaweni ethintekile noma emgqeni oveziwe wendlela ethintekile.

 Umthetho: I-TSRGD Ishejuli 14, Ingxenye 1.

 Umthetho 35

 Ukulungiswa komgwaqo kanye nendlela ethintekile

 Indawo ethintekile ingavalwa okwesikhashana ngoba akuphephile ukuyisebenzisa. Qaphela kakhulu uma uqondiswa ukuthi ungene noma uwele umgwaqo.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 3. Imithetho yabasebenzisi bezihlalo zabakhubazekile ezisebenzisa amandla kanye nezikuta zokuhamba (36 kuya ku-46)
subcategory: Izihlalo zabakhubazekile ezisebenzisa amandla kanye nama-scooter okunyakaza (imithetho 36 kuya ku-37)
englishSubcategory: Powered wheelchairs and mobility scooters (rules 36 to 37)
description:
Izitulo zabakhubazekile ezisebenzisa amandla kanye nezikuta zokuhamba (Imithetho 36 kuya ku-37)

 Umthetho 36

 Kukhona uhlobo olulodwa lwesitulo sabakhubazekile esisetshenziswa ngesandla, esibizwa ngokuthi inqola engasebenzi yeKlasi 1, kanye nezinhlobo ezimbili zezitulo zabakhubazekile ezisebenzisa amandla kanye nezikuta zokuhamba ezihambayo ezisebenzisa amandla.

 Izitulo zabakhubazekile ezisebenzisa amandla kanye nezimoto zeKlasi 2:

 • zinomkhawulo wejubane eliphezulu ongu-4 mph (6 km/h)
• zenzelwe ukusetshenziswa ezindleleni zokuhamba.

 Izimoto zeKlasi 3:

 • zinomkhawulo wejubane eliphezulu ongu-8 mph (12 km/h)
• zihlonyiselwe ukusetshenziswa emgwaqweni kanye nasendleleni.

 Umthetho 37

 Uma usemgwaqweni, kufanele ulalele isiqondiso nemithetho yezinye izimoto. Uma usesigabeni somgwaqo, kufanele ulandele isiqondiso nemithetho yabahamba ngezinyawo.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 3. Imithetho yabasebenzisi bezihlalo zabakhubazekile ezisebenzisa amandla kanye nezikuta zokuhamba (36 kuya ku-46)
description:
Ezindleleni zokuhamba ngezinyawo (Imithetho 38 kuya ku-40)

 Umthetho 38

 Izindleleni zokuhamba ngezinyawo ziphephile kunemigwaqo futhi kufanele zisetshenziswe uma zitholakala.

 Kufanele unikeze abahamba ngezinyawo kuqala futhi ubonise ukucabangela abanye abasebenzisi bendleleni, ikakhulukazi labo abanenkinga yokuzwa noma yokubona okungenzeka bangazi ukuthi ulapho.

 Umthetho 39

 Izihlalo zabakhubazekile nezikuta ezisebenzisa amandla AKUMELE zihambe ngesivinini esingaphezu kuka-4 mph (6 km/h) ezindleleni zokuhamba ngezinyawo noma ezindaweni zabahamba ngezinyawo.

 Kungadingeka unciphise ijubane lakho ukuze uzivumelanise nabanye abasebenzisi bendleleni abahamba ngezinyawo abangase bangakwazi ukuphuma endleleni yakho ngokushesha, noma lapho indlela incane kakhulu.
Umthetho: Umthethonqubo we-UICHR 4.

 Umthetho 40

 Uma usuka endaweni egandayiwe uya emgwaqweni, kufanele uqaphele kakhulu. Ngaphambi kokuhamba, hlala ubheka nxazonke futhi uqiniseke ukuthi kuphephile ukujoyina ithrafikhi.

 Zama njalo ukusebenzisa izinqe eziwile lapho usuka endaweni egandayiwe, noma ngabe lokhu kusho ukuhamba ibanga elide ukuze uthole eyodwa.

 Uma kufanele ukhuphuke noma wehle endaweni egandayiwe:

 • hlala usondela kuyo nge-engeli efanele
• ungazami ukuxoxisana nendawo egandayiwe ephakeme kunalokho okunconywa ngumenzi wemoto.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 3. Imithetho yabasebenzisi bezihlalo zabakhubazekile ezisebenzisa amandla kanye nezikuta zokuhamba (36 kuya ku-46)
description:
Emgwaqweni (Imithetho 41 kuya ku-46)

 Umthetho 41

 Kufanele uqaphele lapho uhamba emgwaqweni ngoba kungenzeka ukuthi uhamba kancane kunezinye izimoto. Umshini wakho ukhawulelwe ku-8 mph (12 km/h) futhi ungase ungabonakali kangako.

 Umthetho 42

 Uma usemgwaqweni, izimoto zeSigaba 3 kufanele zihambe ngendlela yethrafikhi.

 Abasebenzisi beSigaba 2 kufanele bahlale besebenzisa indlela yethrafikhi uma itholakala. Uma kungekho ndlela yethrafikhi, kufanele baqaphele lapho behamba emgwaqweni. Lapho kungenzeka khona, abasebenzisi beSigaba 2 kufanele bahambe ngendlela yethrafikhi.

 Uma uhamba ebusuku, lapho KUFANELE kusetshenziswe izibani, kufanele uhambe ngendlela yethrafikhi ukuze ugweme ukudida abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo.

 Umthetho: Umthethonqubo we-UICHR 9.

 Umthetho 43

 KUMELE ulandele imithetho efanayo yokusebenzisa izibani, izinkomba kanye nama-horn njengezinye izimoto zomgwaqo uma imoto yakho ifakelwe zona.

 Ebusuku, izibani KUMELE zisetshenziswe.

 Qaphela ukuthi abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo bangase bangakuboni. Kufanele uzenze ubonakale kakhulu, ngisho nasemini kanye nasebusuku, ngezilinganiso ezinjengalezi:

 • ugqoke ijakethi elikhanyayo
• ukubeka imichilo ekhanyayo ngemuva kwemoto.

 Umthetho: Umthethonqubo we-UICHR 9.

 Umthetho 44

 Qaphela kakhulu ezindaweni zokuhlangana kwemigwaqo. Uma uhamba ngqo phambili, hlola ukuthi azikho izimoto ezizo:

 • uwele indlela yakho usuka kwesobunxele
• uwele indlela yakho usuka kwesokudla
• udlule bese ujika kwesobunxele.

 Kunezindlela eziningana zokubhekana nokujika kwesokudla, ikakhulukazi uma ujika usuka emgwaqweni omkhulu. Uma ukungena phakathi nomgwaqo kunzima noma kuyingozi, ungenza lokhu:

 • ume ohlangothini lwesobunxele lomgwaqo bese ulinda igebe eliphephile emotweni
• xoxisana ngokujika njengomhambi ngokuhamba eceleni kwendlela bese uwela umgwaqo phakathi kwemigwaqo lapho kuphephile ukwenza kanjalo.

 Abasebenzisi bekilasi lesi-3 kufanele bashintshe izimoto zabo baye emkhawulweni wejubane ophansi lapho behamba ngemigwaqo.

 Uma indawo ehlanganayo iyingozi kakhulu, kungaba kuhle ukucabanga ngenye indlela.

 Ngokufanayo, lapho uxoxisana ngemigwaqo emikhulu enemizila emibili noma ngaphezulu, kungaba ngcono ukusebenzisa indlela noma ukuthola umzila ogwema ngokuphelele imigwaqo ejikelezayo.

 Umthetho 45

 Yonke imikhawulo yokupaka evamile kufanele ilandelwe.

 Imoto yakho akufanele ishiywe inganakekelwe uma ibangela isithiyo kwabanye abahamba ngezinyawo, ikakhulukazi labo abasebenzisa izihlalo zabakhubazekile.

 Imvume yokupaka enikezwe ngaphansi kohlelo lweBlue Badge — bheka Ukufunda okwengeziwe — kusebenza ezimotweni ezibonisa ibheji elivumelekile.

 Umthetho 46

 Lezi zimoto AKUMELE zisetshenziswe emigwaqweni emikhulu. Bheka Umthetho 253.

 Akufanele zisetshenziswe emigwaqweni emikhulu emibili engavinjelwe lapho umkhawulo wejubane udlula khona amakhilomitha angu-50 ngehora (80 km/h). Uma zisetshenziswa kulezi zindawo ezimbili, KUMELE zibe nebhekoni eliphuzi elikhanyayo.

 Ibhekoni eliphuzi elikhanyayo kufanele lisetshenziswe kuzo zonke ezinye izindawo ezimbili. Bheka Umthetho 220.

 Imithetho: Izigaba ze-RTRA 17(2) kanye no-17(3), kanye nemithethonqubo ye-RVLR 17(1) kanye no-26.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 4. Imithetho mayelana nezilwane (47 kuya ku-58)
description:
Izimoto ezidonswa amahhashi (Imithetho 47 kuya ku-48)

 Umthetho 47

 Izimoto ezidonswa amahhashi ezisetshenziswa emgwaqweni omkhulu kufanele zisetshenziswe futhi zigcinwe ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso ezibekwe kuKhodi Yokusebenza YoMnyango Wezokuthutha Yezimoto Ezidonswa Amahhashi.

 Le Khodi:

 • ibeka izidingo zokuhlolwa kokushayela emgwaqweni
• ifaka uhlu oluphelele lokuhlolwa kokuphepha ukuqinisekisa ukuthi inqola kanye nezinto ezihambisana nayo ziphephile futhi zisebenza kahle.

 Umasipala Wendawo ungadinga ukuthi umshayeli ahlangabezane nezindinganiso ezibekwe kuHlolo Lokushayela Emgwaqweni uma umshayeli efisa ukuthola ilayisensi kamasipala yendawo yokusebenzisa isevisi yokuthwala abagibeli.

 Umthetho 48

 Imishini nezingubo zokuphepha

 Zonke izimoto ezidonswa amahhashi kufanele zibe nezibonisi ezimbili ezibomvu zangemuva.

 Kuphephile ukungashayeli ebusuku. Uma ushayela ebusuku, kufanele kufakwe isibani esimhlophe ngaphambili nesibomvu ngemuva.

 Umthetho: Umthethonqubo we-RVLR 4.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 4. Imithetho mayelana nezilwane (47 kuya ku-58)
description:
Abagibeli bamahhashi (Imithetho 49 kuya ku-55)

 Umthetho 49

 Imishini yokuphepha

 Izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka engu-14 KUMELE zigqoke isigqoko esihambisana neMithethonqubo. KUMELE siboshwe ngokuphephile. Abanye abagibeli kufanele nabo balandele lezi zidingo.

 Lezi zidingo azisebenzi enganeni engumlandeli wenkolo yamaSikh ngenkathi igqoke isigqoko.

 Imithetho: H(PHYR)A isigaba 1 kanye nomthethonqubo we-H(PHYR)R 3.

 Umthetho 50

 Ezinye izingubo

 Kufanele ugqoke:

 • amabhuzu noma izicathulo ezinezinyawo eziqinile nezithende
• izingubo ezinombala okhanyayo noma ezikhanyayo emini
• izingubo ezikhanyayo uma kufanele ugibele ebusuku noma ungabonakali kahle.

 Umthetho 51

 Ebusuku

 Kungcono ukungagibeli emgwaqweni ebusuku noma ungabonakali kahle. Uma wenza kanjalo:

 • gqoka izingubo ezibonisa ukukhanya
• qinisekisa ukuthi ihhashi lakho linemichilo ekhombisa ukukhanya ngaphezu kwamalunga e-fetlock
• faka ukukhanya okumhlophe ngaphambili kanye nokubomvu ngemuva, ngebhande, engalweni yakho yesokudla kanye/noma emlenzeni noma esicathulweni sokugibela.

 Uma uhola ihhashi ebusuku:

 • phatha ukukhanya esandleni sakho sokunene okubonisa ukukhanya okumhlophe ngaphambili kanye nokubomvu ngemuva
• gqoka izingubo ezibonisa ukukhanya kokubili kuwe kanye nehhashi lakho.

 Kunconywa kakhulu ukuthi ihhashi lakho lifake nesivikelo somsila esikhanyayo noma esibonisa ukukhanya.

 Ukugibela

 Umthetho 52

 Ngaphambi kokuthatha ihhashi noma imoto edonswa yihhashi uye nayo emgwaqweni, kufanele:

 • uqinisekise ukuthi yonke intambo ifanelana kahle futhi isesimweni esihle
• qiniseka ukuthi uyakwazi ukulawula ihhashi.

 Uma ungumgibeli wehhashi ongenalwazi noma ungakaze ugibele isikhashana, cabanga ngokuthatha i-Ride Safe Award evela kwi-British Horse Society. I-Ride Safe Award inikeza isisekelo sokuba noma yimuphi umgibeli wehhashi aphephe futhi abe nolwazi lapho egibela kuzo zonke izindawo, ikakhulukazi emgwaqweni. Ukuze uthole ulwazi olwengeziwe, bheka ku-www.bhs.org.uk.

 Gibela njalo namanye amahhashi angakhathazekile uma ucabanga ukuthi ihhashi lakho lizokhathazeka ngethrafikhi.

 Ungalokothi ugibele ihhashi ngaphandle kwesihlalo sobukhosi kanye netomu.

 Umthetho 53

 Ngaphambi kokugibela noma ukujika, bheka ngemuva kwakho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuphephile bese unikeza isignali yengalo ecacile.

 Uma ugibela emgwaqweni, kufanele:

 • hlala ngakwesobunxele
• gcina izandla zombili zisezintanjeni ngaphandle kokuthi ubonisa
• gcina zombili izinyawo ezintanjeni
• ungathwali omunye umuntu
• ungathwali lutho olungathinta ibhalansi yakho noma lubhajwe ezintanjeni
• gcina ihhashi oliholayo ngakwesobunxele sakho
• hamba ngendlela yokuhamba kwezimoto emgwaqweni ohamba ngendlela eyodwa
• ungalokothi ugibele ngaphezu kwamabili ngokulingana
• gibela ngomugqa owodwa emigwaqweni emincane noma ematasa futhi uma ugibela uzungeze amajika.

 Umthetho 54

 AKUMELE ugibele ihhashi endleleni yabahamba ngezinyawo noma endleleni yabahamba ngezinyawo. Akufanele ugibele ihhashi uye emzileni wamabhayisikili.

 Sebenzisa indlela yomgwaqo lapho kungenzeka khona.

 Izindawo zokuwela amahhashi zingase zinikezwe abagibeli bamahhashi ukuze bawele umgwaqo, futhi kufanele uzisebenzise lapho zitholakala khona. Bheka uMthetho 27.

 Kufanele wehle ezinqoleni zokuwela ezilinganayo lapho kuboniswa khona uphawu `lokwehla komgibeli wamahhashi`.

 Imithetho: HA 1835 isigaba 72 kanye nesigaba R(S)A 129(5).

 Umthetho 55

 Gwema izindawo ezizungezile noma kuphi lapho kungenzeka khona. Uma usebenzisa indawo ezungezile, kufanele:

 • hlala ngakwesobunxele
• qaphela izimoto eziwela indlela yakho ukuthi zihambe noma zijoyine indawo ezungezile
• bonisa ngakwesokudla lapho ugibela izindawo zokuphuma ukuze ubonise ukuthi awuphumi
• bonisa ngakwesokunxele ngaphambi nje kokushiya indawo ezungezile.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 4. Imithetho mayelana nezilwane (47 kuya ku-58)
description:
Ezinye izilwane (Imithetho 56 kuya ku-58)

 Umthetho 56

 Izinja

 Ungavumeli inja ihambe emgwaqweni yodwa.

 Gcina inja iseduze nawe uma uhamba:

 • indlela ehlanganyelwe abagibeli bamabhayisikili noma abagibeli bamahhashi.

 Umthetho 57

 Izilwane ezisezimotweni

 Uma uhamba ngemoto, qiniseka ukuthi izinja nezinye izilwane ziboshwe ngendlela efanele ukuze zingakwazi:

 • ukukuphazamisa ngenkathi ushayela
• ukukulimaza uma uyeka ngokushesha
• ukuzilimaza uma uyeka ngokushesha.

 Izindlela zokubopha izilwane ezimotweni zifaka:

 • ibhande lesihlalo
• isithwali sezilwane ezifuywayo
• ikheji lezinja
• umqaphi wezinja.

 Umthetho 58

 Izilwane ezifuywayo

 Izilwane ezifuywayo kufanele zilawulwe ngaso sonke isikhathi.

 Uma kungenzeka, thumela omunye umuntu emgwaqweni ongaphambili ukuze axwayise abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo, ikakhulukazi lapho kugoba noma emaphethelweni egquma.

 Kuphephile ukungazithuthi izilwane uma sekuhlwile. Uma uzithutha uma sekuhlwile:

 • gqoka izingubo ezikhanyayo
• qiniseka ukuthi izibani ziyathwalwa, kube nokukhanya okumhlophe ngaphambili kanye nokukhanya okubomvu ngemuva komhlambi.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 5. Imithetho yabagibeli bamabhayisikili (59 kuya ku-82)
description:
Ukubuka Konke (Imithetho 59 kuya ku-72)

 Umthetho 59

 Izingubo

 Gwema izingubo ezingase zibambeke eketangeni noma esondweni, noma zifihle izibani zakho ngenkathi ugibela ibhayisikili.

 Izingubo ezinombala okhanyayo noma ezikhanyayo zingasiza abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo ukuthi bakubone emini nasekukhanyeni okubi. Izingubo ezikhanyayo nezesekeli, njengebhande nezibopho zengalo noma zamaqakala, zingandisa ukubonakala kwakho ebumnyameni.

 Kufanele ugqoke isigqoko sebhayisikili:

 • esihambisana nemithetho yamanje
• esisayizi ofanele
• esiboshwe kahle.

 Ubufakazi busikisela ukuthi isigqoko esifakwe kahle sizonciphisa ingozi yakho yokuthola ukulimala ekhanda ezimweni ezithile.

 Umthetho 60

 Ebusuku, umjikelezo wakho KUMELE ube nalokhu:

 • isibani sangaphambili esimhlophe esikhanyayo
• isibani sangemuva esibomvu esikhanyayo
• isibani sangemuva esibomvu esikhanyayo
• izibani ze-pedal eziphuzi uma zenziwe ngemva komhla lu-1 kuMfumfu 1985.

 Izibani zangaphambili ezimhlophe nezibani zesipikha nazo zizokusiza ukuthi ubonakale.

 Izibani ezikhanyayo ziyavunyelwa, kodwa abagibeli bamabhayisikili abagibela ezindaweni ezingenazo izibani zasemgwaqweni bayelulekwa ukuba basebenzise isibani sangaphambili esiqinile.

 Umthetho: Imithethonqubo ye-RVLR 13, 18 kanye no-24.

 Umthetho 61

 Imizila yamabhayisikili nezinye izikhungo

 Imizila yamabhayisikili imakwe ngomugqa omhlophe, ongase uphuke, endleleni yemoto. Bheka Umthetho 140.

 Sebenzisa izinsiza ezifana nemizila yamabhayisekili kanye nemizila, imigqa yokuma ethuthukisiwe kanye nezindawo zokuwela i-toucan lapho zenza uhambo lwakho luphephe futhi lube lula. Bheka Imithetho 62 kanye no-73. Ukuthi uzozisebenzisa yini kuzoncika kokuhlangenwe nakho kwakho, amakhono kanye nesimo ngaleso sikhathi.

 Nakuba lezi zinsiza zihlinzekwa ngokuphepha, abagibeli bamabhayisikili bangasebenzisa ukwahlulela kwabo futhi abaphoqelekile ukuzisebenzisa.

 Umthetho 62

 Imizila yamabhayisekili

 Imizila yamabhayisekili iyimizila yabagibeli bamabhayisikili evikelwe ngokomzimba noma etholakala kude nethrafikhi yezimoto, ngaphandle kwalapho bewela khona imigwaqo eseceleni. Bheka Umthetho 206.

 Imizila yamabhayisekili ingahamba eceleni kwezindlela zabahamba ngezinyawo noma izindlela zokuhamba ngezinyawo futhi ihlukaniswe nazo yi:

 • ushintsho lwezinto
• unqenqema
• unqenqema
• umugqa omhlophe.

 KUMELE uhlale ohlangothini oluhloselwe abagibeli bamabhayisikili ngoba uhlangothi lwabahamba ngezinyawo luhlala luyindawo yokuhamba ngezinyawo noma indlela yabahamba ngezinyawo.

 Eminye imizila yamabhayisikili ehlanganyelwa nabahamba ngezinyawo ayihlukaniswa yisici esinjalo. Kule mizila esetshenziswa ngokuhlanganyela, qaphela njalo lapho udlula abahamba ngezinyawo, ikakhulukazi izingane, abantu abadala kanye nabantu abakhubazekile, futhi ubanike indawo eyanele. Hlala ulungele ukwehlisa ijubane nokuma uma kudingeka. Bheka uMthetho H2.

 Umthetho: HA 1835 isigaba 72.

 Umthetho 63

 Ukwabelana ngendawo nabahamba ngezinyawo, abagibeli bamahhashi kanye nezimoto ezidonswa amahhashi

 Uma ugibela lapho kuvunyelwe khona ukuhlanganyela nabahamba ngezinyawo, abagibeli bamahhashi noma izimoto ezidonswa amahhashi:

 • qaphela lapho udlula abahamba ngezinyawo kanye nabagibeli bamahhashi, ikakhulukazi izingane, abantu abadala kanye nabantu abakhubazekile
• yehlisa ijubane lapho kudingeka
• bazise ukuthi ukhona, isibonelo ngokushaya insimbi yakho noma ukumemeza ngenhlonipho.

 Kunconywa ukuthi kufakwe insimbi ebhayisikilini lakho.

 Khumbula ukuthi abahamba ngezinyawo bangase babe yizithulu, izimpumputhe noma babe nombono ongemuhle, futhi lokhu kungase kungabonakali.

 Ungadluli abahamba ngezinyawo, abagibeli bamahhashi noma izimoto ezidonswa amahhashi eduze noma ngesivinini esikhulu, ikakhulukazi ngemuva. Akufanele udlule ihhashi ngakwesobunxele salo. Amahhashi angashaqeka uma edlula ngaphandle kwesixwayiso. Hlala ulungele ukwehlisa ijubane nokuma lapho kudingeka.

 Umthetho 64

 AKUMELE ugibele ibhayisikili endaweni egandayiwe.

 Imithetho: HA 1835 isigaba 72 kanye nesigaba R(S)A 129.

 Umthetho 65

 Imizila yamabhasi

 Imizila eminingi yamabhasi ingasetshenziswa abagibeli bamabhayisikili lapho izimpawu zibonisa lokhu.

 Qaphela abantu abagibela noma behla ebhasini. Qaphela kakhulu lapho udlula ibhasi noma ushiya umzila webhasi ngoba uzongena ekugelezeni kwezimoto okumatasa kakhulu.

 Ungadluli phakathi komgwaqo ohambayo nebhasi uma ibhasi lisesitobhini.

 Umthetho 66

 Kufanele:

 • ugweme izenzo ezinganciphisa ukulawula kwakho ibhayisikili lakho
• ucabangele abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo lapho ugibela ngamaqembu
• ungagibeli eduze kwesinye imoto uma kwenzeka ima ngokuzumayo
• ungaphathi lutho olungathinta ibhalansi yakho noma lubhajwe emasondweni noma eketangeni
• ucabangele kakhulu abahamba ngezinyawo abayizimpumputhe nabangaboni kahle kanye nabagibeli bamahhashi — bheka uMthetho H1
• yazisa abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo ukuthi ukhona lapho kudingeka, isibonelo ngokubiza noma ukushaya insimbi yakho uma unayo.

 Kunconywa ukuthi kufakwe insimbi.

 Ungagibela umgwaqo uqondene, futhi kungaba ngcono ukwenza kanjalo, ikakhulukazi ngamaqembu amakhulu noma uma uhamba nezingane noma abagibeli abangenalo ulwazi oluningi. Qaphela abashayeli abangemuva kwakho futhi ubavumele badlule lapho uzizwa sengathi kuphephile, isibonelo ngokungena emgqeni owodwa noma ngokuma.

 Umthetho 67

 Kufanele:

 • ubheke nxazonke ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuphephile ngaphambi kokusuka eceleni komgwaqo, ukuphuma ukuze udlule izimoto ezimile noma ezingasebenzi, ukujika ezindaweni zokuhlangana noma ukuma
• ubheke izithiyo zomgwaqo njengemisele yamanzi, izembozo zesevisi kanye nemigodi
• uzibeke ukuze ukwazi ukushintshela kwesobunxele kanye nakwesokudla ukuze ugweme izithiyo ngokuphephile
• qaphela lapho udlula izimoto ezipakiwe, ushiye okungenani ububanzi bomnyango noma imitha eli-1 ukuze ugweme ukushayiswa umnyango ovulekile
• ubheke abahamba ngezinyawo abangena endleleni yakho
• qaphela ithrafikhi esondela ngemuva, okuhlanganisa nabanye abagibeli bamabhayisikili
• nikeza isignali ecacile yokukhombisa abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo ukuthi uhlose ukwenzani — bheka ‘Izimpawu kwabanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo’
• qaphela kakhulu eduze kwezihibe zomgwaqo, ukuncishiswa kanye nezinye izici zokuthulisa ithrafikhi.

 Uma ugibela ibhayisikili emgwaqweni, dlula ngakwesobunxele sezimoto ezinkulu kuphela uma zimile noma zihamba kancane. Qhubeka ngokuqapha ngoba umshayeli angase angakwazi ukukubona. Qaphela kakhulu lapho usondela ezindaweni zokuhlangana noma lapho imoto enkulu ingashintsha khona imizila iye ngakwesobunxele.

 Umthetho 68

 AKUMELE:

 • thwala umgibeli ngaphandle kokuthi ibhayisikili lakho lakhiwe noma lalungiselelwa ukuthwala elilodwa
• bamba imoto ehambayo noma i-trailer
• gibela ngendlela eyingozi, yokunganaki noma yokungacabangeli
• gibela uphuze utshwala noma izidakamizwa, okuhlanganisa nemithi.

 Umthetho: Izigaba 24, 26, 28, 29 kanye no-30 ze-RTA zika-1988, njengoba zichitshiyelwe yi-RTA ka-1991.

 Umthetho 69

 KUMELE ulalele zonke izimpawu zomgwaqo kanye nezimpawu zokukhanya kwethrafikhi.

 Imithetho: Isigaba 36 se-RTA sika-1988 kanye ne-TSRGD Isheduli 3, Ingxenye 3; Isheduli 7, Ingxenye 4; Isheduli 9, Izingxenye 4 kanye no-6; Isheduli 13, Ingxenye 6; kanye neSheduli 14, Ingxenye 2.

 Umthetho 70

 Uma upaka ibhayisikili lakho:

 • thola indawo ecacile lapho abadlulayo bangayibona khona
• sebenzisa izitendi zamabhayisikili noma ezinye izindawo zokupaka amabhayisikili lapho kungenzeka khona
• ungayishiyi lapho ingavimba noma ibeke abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo engozini
• yivikele kahle ukuze ingaweli phezu kwayo bese iba yisithiyo noma ingozi.

 Umthetho 71

 Ezimpambanweni zomgwaqo namalambu omgwaqo kanye nasezimpambanweni zamabhayisikili kuphela ezinezibani zomgwaqo, AKUMELE uwele umugqa wokuma ngenkathi izibani zibomvu.

 Ezinye izimpambano zinentambo yokuma ethuthukisiwe ekuvumela ukuthi uzibeke phambili kunezinye izimoto bese ulinda. Bheka Umthetho 178. Uma izibani zibomvu, ungase uwele umugqa wokuqala wokuma, kodwa AKUMELE uwele umugqa wokugcina wokuma.

 Imithetho: Isigaba 36 se-RTA sika-1988 kanye neShejuli 14 ye-TSRGD, Ingxenye 1.

 Umthetho 72

 Ukuma komgwaqo

 Kunezindawo ezimbili eziyisisekelo zomgwaqo okufanele zithathwe abagibeli bamabhayisikili, kuye ngesimo.

 1. Gibela phakathi nomzila wakho ukuze ubonakale kahle ngangokunokwenzeka:

 • emigwaqweni ethule noma emigwaqweni — uma imoto esheshayo isondela ngemuva, hamba ngakwesobunxele ukuze uyivumele idlule uma ungakwenza lokho ngokuphephile
• emotweni ehamba kancane — lapho ithrafikhi iqala ukuhamba ngokukhululeka, hamba ngakwesobunxele uma kuphephile ukuze izimoto ezisheshayo ngemuva zidlule
• uma usondela ezindaweni zokuhlangana noma ukuncipha komgwaqo lapho kungaba okungaphephile ngabashayeli ukubadlula.

 2. Emigwaqweni ematasa lapho izimoto zihamba ngokushesha kunawe, zivumele zidlule lapho kuphephile khona ngenkathi zihlala okungenani amamitha angu-0.5 ukusuka onqenqemeni lomgwaqo, futhi zikude lapho lokhu kuphephile khona.

 Ithrafikhi ezindaweni eziningi zezimoto ezihamba kabili ihamba ngokushesha. Qaphela kakhulu lapho uwela imigwaqo eshelelayo.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 5. Imithetho yabagibeli bamabhayisikili (59 kuya ku-82)
description:
Izindawo zokuhlangana kwemigwaqo (Imithetho 73 kuya ku-77)

 Umthetho 73

 Izindawo zokuhlangana

 Ezinye izindawo zokuhlangana, ikakhulukazi lezo ezinezibani zomgwaqo, zinezindawo ezikhethekile zokugibela amabhayisikili. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izibani ezincane zokugibela amabhayisikili eziphakeme kakhulu, ezingavumela abagibeli bamabhayisikili ukuthi bahambe noma bawele ngokwehlukana noma ngaphambi kwezinye izimoto.

 Sebenzisa lezi zindawo lapho zenza khona uhambo lwakho luphephe futhi lube lula.

 Ezindaweni zokuhlangana ezingenazo izindawo zokugibela amabhayisikili ezihlukene, kunconywa ukuthi uqhubeke sengathi ushayela imoto. Bheka Imithetho 170 kuya ku-190.

 Zibeke maphakathi nomzila wakho owukhethile lapho uzizwa ukwazi ukwenza khona ngokuphephile. Lokhu kuzokwenza ubonakale ngangokunokwenzeka futhi kusize ukuvimbela ezinye izimoto ukuthi zingadluli lapho ukwenza kanjalo kungaba yingozi.

 Uma ungazizwa uphephile ukuqhubeka ngale ndlela, ungakhetha ukwehla bese uqhuba ibhayisikili lakho uwele i-junction.

 Umthetho 74

 Ukujika

 Uma usondela endaweni ehlangana ngayo izimoto ngakwesobunxele, qaphela izimoto ezijika phambi kwakho, kungaba ziphuma noma zingene emgwaqweni oseceleni.

 Uma uhlose ukujika ngakwesobunxele:

 • qala uhlole abanye abagibeli bamabhayisikili noma abagibeli bamabhayisikili
• bonisa inhloso yakho
• ungagibeli ngaphakathi kwezimoto ezibonisa noma ezinciphisa ijubane ukuze ujike ngakwesobunxele.

 Uma uhlose ukujika ngakwesokudla:

 • hlola ithrafikhi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iphephile
• bonisa bese uthuthela enkabeni yomgwaqo
• linda isikhala esiphephile sethrafikhi ezayo
• bheka okokugcina ngaphambi kokuqeda ukujika.

 Kungaba ngcono ukulinda ngakwesobunxele kuze kube yilapho kukhona isikhala esiphephile, noma ukwehla bese usunduza ibhayisikili lakho ngaphesheya komgwaqo.

 Uma ujika noma uphuma emgwaqweni oseceleni, kufanele unikeze indlela abahamba ngezinyawo abawela noma abalinde ukuwela. Bheka Umthetho H2.

 Umthetho 75

 Ukujika kwezigaba ezimbili

 Kwezinye izindawo zokuhlangana ezilawulwa yisignali, izimpawu nezimpawu zingase zifundise abagibeli bamabhayisikili ukuba bajike kwesokudla ngezigaba ezimbili.

 Isigaba 1: Lapho izibani zomgwaqo ziphenduka zibe luhlaza, abagibeli bamabhayisikili abafisa ukujika kufanele bahambe baqonde phambili baye endaweni ephawulwe endleleni yemoto ngophawu lwebhayisikili kanye nomcibisholo wokujika. Kufanele bame bese belinda lapho.

 Isigaba 2: Lapho izibani zomgwaqo ohlangothini olude lwendawo yokuhlangana, manje ezibhekene nabagibeli bamabhayisikili, ziphenduka zibe luhlaza, abagibeli bamabhayisikili kufanele baqedele ukuqondisa.

 Umthetho 76

 Ukuya phambili ngqo

 Uma uhamba uqonde phambili endaweni yokuhlangana, ubaluleke kakhulu kunethrafikhi elinde ukujika noma ukuphuma emgwaqweni oseceleni ngaphandle kokuthi izimpawu zomgwaqo noma izimpawu zibonisa okuhlukile. Bheka Umthetho H3.

 Hlola ukuthi ungaqhubeka ngokuphephile, ikakhulukazi uma usondela ezindaweni zokuhlangana ngakwesobunxele eceleni kwethrafikhi engami noma ehamba kancane. Qaphela abashayeli abahlose ukujika endleleni yakho.

 Khumbula ukuthi umshayeli ongaphambili angase angakwazi ukukubona, ngakho cabanga ngesivinini sakho nendawo ohamba kuyo emgwaqweni.

 Qaphela kakhulu lapho unquma ukuthi kuphephile yini ukudlula amaloli angami noma ahamba kancane kanye nezinye izimoto ezinde, ikakhulukazi uma usondela ezindaweni zokuhlangana, ngoba abashayeli babo bangase bangakwazi ukukubona.

 Khumbula ukuthi izimoto ezinde kungadingeka zihambe ziye kwesokudla ngaphambi kokujika ngakwesobunxele. Amasondo azo angemuva angase asondele kakhulu emkhawulweni ngenkathi ejika. Bheka uMthetho 67.

 UMthetho 77

 Imigwaqo ematasa

 Uma uwela imigwaqo emikhulu esheshayo noma ematasa, ungase ukuthole kuphephile futhi kulula:

 • wehle bese usunduza ibhayisikili lakho ngaphesheya
• ulinde isikhala esiphephile emotweni ngaphambi kokuwela, ikakhulukazi emigwaqweni esheshayo kanye nemigwaqo emibili yezimoto
• sebenzisa iziqhingi zezimoto noma ukubhukha okuphakathi lapho kufaneleka khona.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 5. Imithetho yabagibeli bamabhayisikili (59 kuya ku-82)
description:
Ama-Roundabout (Imithetho 78 kuya ku-80)

 Umthetho 78

 Imininingwane egcwele yenqubo efanele ezindaweni zokuzungeza ngaphandle kwezindawo zokugibela amabhayisikili inikezwe kuMithetho 184 kuya ku-190.

 Qaphela izimoto eziwela indlela yakho ukuze zihambe noma zijoyine i-roundabout. Khumbula ukuthi abashayeli bangase bangakuboni kalula.

 Umthetho 79

 Jikela kwesokudla

 Uma ujika kwesokudla, ungagibela umzila wesobunxele noma wesokudla bese uhamba ngakwesobunxele njengoba usondela ekuphumeni kwakho.

 Zibeke maphakathi nomzila wakho uma kuphephile ukwenza kanjalo. Bheka Umthetho 72. Faka uphawu kwesokudla ukukhombisa ukuthi awuphumi ku-roundabout.

 Ngaphandle kwalokho, ungase uzizwe uphephile wehla futhi uhamba ngebhayisikili lakho uzungeze i-roundabout ogwadule noma onqenqemeni.

 Uma unquma ukugibela uzungeze i-roundabout emzileni ongakwesobunxele, kufanele:

 • uqaphele ukuthi abashayeli bangase bangakuboni kalula
• uqaphele kakhulu lapho ugibela ibhayisikili ezindaweni zokuphuma
• uphawu lwesokudla ukukhombisa ukuthi awuphumi ku-roundabout
• qaphela izimoto eziwela indlela yakho ukuze zihambe noma zijoyine i-roundabout.

 Lapho i-roundabout inezindawo zokugibela amabhayisikili ezihlukene, kufanele uzisebenzise lapho zenza uhambo lwakho luphephe futhi lube lula. Kodwa-ke, awuphoqelekile ukuzisebenzisa. Ukuthi uzozisebenzisa kuzoncika kokuhlangenwe nakho kwakho, amakhono kanye nesimo ngaleso sikhathi.

 Umthetho 80

 Nikeza izimoto ezinde indawo eyanele ku-roundabout ngoba zidinga isikhala esengeziwe sokuhamba.

 Ungagibeli endaweni lapho imoto ende idinga ukuhamba ku-roundabout. Kungaba ngcono ukulinda kuze kube yilapho imoto ende isidlulile endaweni ezungezile.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 5. Imithetho yabagibeli bamabhayisikili (59 kuya ku-82)
description:
Ukuwela umgwaqo (Imithetho 81 kuya ku-82)

 Umthetho 81

 Ungagibeli ezindaweni zokuwela amahhashi ngoba zezabagibeli bamahhashi kuphela.

 Ungagibeli ezindaweni zokuwela i-pelican, i-puffin noma i-zebra. Yehlisa ibhayisikili lakho uliqhube.

 Umthetho 82

 Izindawo zokuwela

 Izindawo zokuwela i-toucan ziyizindawo zokuwela ezilawulwa kalula ezivumela abagibeli bamabhayisikili nabahamba ngezinyawo ukuthi babelane ngendawo yokuwela futhi bawele ngesikhathi esifanayo. Ziqhutshwa ngenkinobho yokucindezela.

 Abahamba ngezinyawo nabagibele amabhayisikili babona isignali eluhlaza ndawonye. Abagibele amabhayisikili bavunyelwe ukuwela.

 Imizila yamabhayisikili ezinhlangothini eziphambene zomgwaqo ingaxhunywa ezindaweni zokuwela ezilawulwa yizignali kuphela. Ungagibela ugibele ngaphesheya, kodwa AKUMELE uwele kuze kube yilapho uphawu lomjikelezo oluhlaza lubonakala.

 Izindawo zokuwela umzila wamabhayisikili zingase zibe sezindaweni ezibanzi zabahamba ngezinyawo. Abahamba ngamabhayisikili kufanele babheke futhi balungele ukuma kwabahamba ngezinyawo abawela umzila ngokungahlelekile kanye nasezindaweni zokuwela ezibekiwe.

 Qaphela kakhulu lapho uwela izindawo zokuwela ezisezingeni lesitimela kanye nemigwaqo yesitimela. Bheka uMthetho 306.

 Kufanele wehle ezindaweni zokuwela ezisezingeni lapho kuboniswa khona uphawu `lokwehla komgibeli`.

 Umthetho: I-TSRGD Isheduli 14, Ingxenye 1.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 6. Imithetho Yabagibeli Bezithuthuthu (83 kuya ku-88)
description:
Okujwayelekile (Imithetho 83 kuya ku-88)

 Umthetho 83

 Izigqoko zokuzivikela

 Kuzo zonke izinkambo, umgibeli nomgibeli webhayisikili, isikuta noma i-moped KUMELE bagqoke isigqoko sokuzivikela.

 Lesi sidingo asisebenzi kumlandeli wenkolo yamaSikh lapho egqoke isigqoko.

 Izigqoko zokuzivikela KUMELE:

 • zihambisane neMithethonqubo
• ziboshwe ngokuphephile.

 Abagibeli nabagibeli bamabhayisikili amathathu nama-quadricycle, abizwa nangokuthi ama-quadbike, kufanele nabo bagqoke izigqoko zokuzivikela.

 Ngaphambi kohambo ngalunye, hlola ukuthi i-visor yesigqoko sakho ihlanzekile futhi isesimweni esihle.

 Imithetho: Izigaba 16 no-17 ze-RTA ka-1988, kanye ne-MC(PH)R, njengoba kushintshiwe, umthethonqubo 4.

 Umthetho 84

 Imishini yokuzivikela kanye nezingubo

 Kunconywa ukugqoka izivikeli zamehlo. Uma zigqokiwe, KUMELE zihambisane neMithethonqubo.

 Izivikeli zamehlo eziklwebhekile noma ezingalingani kahle zingakuvimbela ukubuka kwakho lapho ugibela, ikakhulukazi elangeni elikhanyayo kanye namahora obumnyama.

 Cabanga ukugqoka izivikelo zendlebe. Amabhuzu aqinile, amagilavu nezingubo ezifanele kungakusiza ukukuvikela uma uhileleke engozini.

 Imithetho: Isigaba 18 se-RTA ka-1988 kanye ne-MC(EP)R, njengoba kushintshiwe, umthethonqubo 4.

 Umthetho 85

 Abagibeli be-Pillion

 AKUMELE uthwale abagibeli be-Pillion abangaphezu koyedwa. Umgibeli KUMELE ahlale phansi kwesithuthuthu esihlalweni esifanele.

 Umgibeli kufanele:

 • abheke phambili
• agcine izinyawo zombili ezindaweni zokubeka izinyawo.

 AKUMELE uphathe umgibeli we-pillion ngaphandle kokuthi isithuthuthu sakho senzelwe ukuthwala esisodwa.

 Abanikazi bamalayisense esikhashana AKUMELE baphathe umgibeli we-pillion.

 Imithetho: RTA 1988 isigaba 23, MV(DL)R umthethonqubo 16(6) kanye nomthethonqubo we-CUR 102.

 Umthetho 86

 Ukugibela emini

 Zenze ubonakale ngangokunokwenzeka ezinhlangothini, ngaphambili nangemuva.

 Ungagqoka:

 • isigqoko esinombala okhanyayo noma esinombala okhanyayo
• izingubo noma imichilo ekhanyayo.

 Ukusebenzisa izibani ezicwilisiwe, ngisho nasemini enhle, kungakwenza ubonakale kakhulu.

 Kodwa-ke, qaphela ukuthi abanye abashayeli kungenzeka abakakuboni noma kungenzeka ukuthi bahlulele ibanga lakho noma isivinini sakho ngendlela engafanele, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zokuhlangana.

 Umthetho 87

 Ukugibela ebumnyameni

 Gqoka izingubo ezikhanyayo noma imichilo ukuze uthuthukise ukubonakala kwakho ebumnyameni. Lokhu kubonakalisa ukukhanya okuvela ezibanini zezinye izimoto, kukwenze ubonakale usekude kakhulu.

 Bheka Imithetho 113 kuya ku-116 ukuthola izidingo zokukhanyisa.

 Umthetho 88

 Ukuqondisa

 Ngaphambi kokuqondisa, qaphela okungemuva kwakho kanye nezinhlangothi zombili. Bheka ngemuva bese usebenzisa izibuko zakho uma zifakiwe.

 Uma uhamba emigqeni yethrafikhi, qaphela:

 • abahamba ngezinyawo bewela phakathi kwezimoto
• izimoto eziphuma ezimpambanweni
• izimoto ezishintsha imizila.

 Zibeke ngendlela yokuthi abashayeli abangaphambili bakwazi ukukubona ezibukweni zabo.

 Uma uhlunga ithrafikhi ehamba kancane, qaphela futhi ugcine ijubane lakho liphansi.

 Khumbula: Ukuqaphela – Isignali – Ukuqondisa.

 Isimo semoto

 KUMELE uqinisekise ukuthi imoto yakho kanye ne-trailer kuhambisana nezidingo ezigcwele zalokhu:

description:
Ukufaneleka kokushayela (Imithetho 90 kuya ku-94)

 Umthetho 90

 Qiniseka ukuthi ukulungele ukushayela.

 KUMELE ubike kwi-Agency yeLayisensi Yokushayela Nezimoto (i-DVLA) noma yisiphi isimo sempilo esingathinta ukushayela kwakho.

 Umthetho: RTA 1988 isigaba 94.

 Umthetho 91

 Ukukhathala

 Ukushayela ukhathele kwandisa kakhulu ingozi yakho yokushayisana. Ukunciphisa le ngozi:

 • qiniseka ukuthi ukulungele ukushayela
• ungaqali uhambo uma ukhathele
• lala ngokwanele ngaphambi kokuqala uhambo olude
• gwema uhambo olude phakathi kwamabili no-6 ekuseni, lapho ukuqapha kwemvelo kuphansi kakhulu
• hlela uhambo lwakho ukuze lufake amakhefu anele
• thatha ikhefu okungenani imizuzu eyi-15 ngemva kwamahora amabili okushayela
• uma uzizwa ulele, yima endaweni ephephile.

 Ungami endaweni ephuthumayo noma ehlombe eliqinile lomgwaqo omkhulu ukuze uphumule. Bheka uMthetho 262 ukuze uthole isiqondiso ngezindawo okufanele uphumule kuzo uma uhamba emigwaqweni emikhulu.

 UMthetho 92

 Umbono

 Emini enhle, KUMELE ukwazi ukufunda ipuleti lenombolo yemoto kusuka ku:

 • Amamitha angama-20 ukuthola ipuleti lenombolo yesitayela samanje
• Amamitha angama-20.5 ukuthola ipuleti lenombolo yesitayela esidala.

 Uma udinga izibuko noma amalensi okuxhumana ukuze uhlangabezane nale mfuneko, KUMELE uwagqoke ngaso sonke isikhathi ngenkathi ushayela.

 Amaphoyisa anamandla okufuna umshayeli ukuthi ahlole amehlo.

 Imithetho: Isigaba 96 se-RTA sika-1988, kanye nomthethonqubo we-MV(DL)R 40 kanye noShejuli 8.

 Umthetho 93

 Ukukhanya kwelanga okukhanyayo

 Yehlisa ijubane futhi, uma kudingeka, yeka uma ukukhanya kwelanga okukhanyayo kukukhazimulisa.

 Umthetho 94

 Izibuko ezinombala, amalensi nama-visor

 Ebusuku noma lapho kungabonakali kahle, ungasebenzisi izibuko ezinombala, amalensi noma ama-visor uma kuvimbela ukubona kwakho.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 7. Imithetho yabashayeli nabagibeli bezithuthuthu (89 kuya ku-102)
description:
Utshwala nezidakamizwa (Imithetho 95 kuya ku-96)

 Umthetho 95

 Utshwala

 Ungaphuzi bese ushayela ngoba utshwala buzothinta kakhulu ukwahlulela kwakho namakhono akho.

 ENgilandi naseWales, AKUMELE ushayele une:

 • izinga lotshwala lokuphefumula elingaphezu kwama-microgram angu-35 ngamamililitha angu-100 okuphefumula
• izinga lotshwala egazini elingaphezu kwama-milligram angu-80 ngamamililitha angu-100 egazi.
EScotland, imikhawulo esemthethweni iphansi. AKUMELE ushayele une:

 • izinga lotshwala lokuphefumula elingaphezu kwama-microgram angu-22 ngamamililitha angu-100 okuphefumula
• izinga lotshwala egazini elingaphezu kwama-milligram angu-50 ngamamililitha angu-100 egazi.

 Utshwala buzokwenza lokhu:

 • buzokunikeza umuzwa wokuzethemba ongamanga
• bunciphise ukuhambisana futhi bunciphise ukusabela kwakho
• buthinta isahlulelo sakho sejubane, ibanga kanye nengozi
• bunciphisa ikhono lakho lokushayela, noma ngabe ungaphansi komkhawulo osemthethweni
• buthatha isikhathi sokuphuma emzimbeni wakho.

 Ungase ungafaneleki ukushayela kusihlwa ngemva kokuphuza ngesikhathi sasemini noma ekuseni ngemva kokuphuza kusihlwa sangaphambilini.

 Isixazululo esingcono kakhulu ukungaphuzi nhlobo lapho uhlela ukushayela ngoba noma yiliphi inani lotshwala lithinta ikhono lakho lokushayela ngokuphepha. Uma uzophuza, hlela enye indlela yokuhamba.

 Imithetho: RTA 1988 izigaba 4, 5 kanye no-11(2), kanye ne-PLSR.

 Umthetho 96

 Izidakamizwa nemithi

 AKUMELE ushayele uphuze izidakamizwa noma imithi.

 Ngemithi, thintana nodokotela wakho noma nosokhemisi. Ungashayeli uma welulekwa ukuthi imithi ingakulimaza.

 AKUMELE ushayele uma unezidakamizwa ezingekho emthethweni noma imithi ethile egazini lakho ngaphezu kwemingcele ebekiwe.

 Ukuthatha izidakamizwa ezingekho emthethweni ngaphambi kokushayela kuyingozi kakhulu. Ungalokothi uthathe izidakamizwa ezingekho emthethweni uma uhlose ukushayela. Imiphumela yazo ayibikezeleki, ingaba nkulu kakhulu kuneyotshwala futhi ingabangela izingozi zomgwaqo ezibulalayo noma ezinkulu.

 Izidakamizwa ezingekho emthethweni zinikezwe imikhawulo ephansi kakhulu ebekiwe, ngakho-ke ngisho namanani amancane angakubeka ngaphezu kwaleyo mingcele.

 Imikhawulo ebekiwe yemithi ethile iphakeme kunamazinga avame ukutholakala egazini leziguli ezithathe imithamo ejwayelekile yokwelapha.

 Uma ukuhlushwa kwemithi egazini lakho kungaphezu komkhawulo wayo obekiwe ngoba unikezwe umuthi noma unikezwe umthamo omkhulu wemithi ngokusemthethweni, ungaphakamisa ukuzivikela kwezokwelapha okusemthethweni, uma nje ukushayela kwakho kungaphazanyiswanga umuthi obuwuthatha.

 Umthetho: RTA 1988 izigaba 4 no-5.

Umthetho 97

 Ngaphambi kokuhamba

 KUMELE uqinisekise ukuthi:

 • unelayisensi esebenzayo kanye nomshwalense wokushayela imoto ohlose ukuyisebenzisa — bheka ‘Imibhalo yemoto kanye nezidingo zomshayeli womfundi’
• imoto yakho isemthethweni futhi ifanelekile ukuba semgwaqweni — bheka ‘Imibhalo yemoto kanye nezidingo zomshayeli womfundi’ kanye ‘Ukugcinwa kwezimoto, ukuphepha kanye nokuphepha’ ukuze uthole ukuhlolwa okubalulekile kokugcinwa kwezimoto kanye nokuphepha.

 KUMELE uqinisekise ukuthi:

 • uhlele umzila wakho futhi uvumele isikhathi esanele samakhefu kanye nokubambezeleka okungenzeka
• unophethiloli noma inkokhelo eyanele yohambo lwakho, ikakhulukazi uma kuhlanganisa ukushayela emgwaqweni omkhulu
• uyazi ukuthi zonke izilawuli zikuphi nokuthi uzisebenzisa kanjani
• izingubo zakho nezicathulo zakho akukuvimbeli ekusebenziseni izilawuli ngendlela efanele
• izibuko zakho nesihlalo sakho kulungiswe kahle ukuze kunikezwe induduzo, ukulawula okugcwele kanye nokubona okuphezulu
• izivikelo zekhanda lakho zilungiswa kahle ukuze kuncishiswe ingozi yokulimala entanyeni nasemhlane lapho kushayisana.

 Ukusetshenziswa okuphuthumayo, kunconywa ukuthi:

 • unefoni ephathekayo equkethe oxhumana nabo abaphuthumayo, njengosizo lokuphazamiseka kwemoto
• unezingubo ezibonakala kalula.

 Imithetho: Izigaba ze-RTA 1988 42, 45, 47, 49, 53, 87, 99(4) kanye no-143; imithethonqubo ye-MV(DL)R 16 kanye no-40 kanye noSheduli 4; isigaba se-VERA 29; imithethonqubo ye-RVLR 1989 23 kanye no-27; kanye nemithethonqubo ye-CUR 27, 30, 32 kanye no-61.

description:
Umthetho 98

 Ukudonsa nokulayisha imoto

 Ngaphambi kokudonsa

 Njengomshayeli:

 • AKUMELE ukudonsa okungaphezu kwezimvume zakho zelayisensi. Uma uphumelele ukuhlolwa kwakho kokushayela imoto ngomhlaka-1 Januwari 1997 noma ngemuva kwalokho, imikhawulo iyasebenza esisindweni senqola ongayidonsa
• KUMELE uqinisekise ukuthi imoto yakho nenqola yakho zifanelekile ukuba semgwaqweni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa nokuhlola ukuthi wonke amathayi asemthethweni, uhlelo lokubhuleka kwenqola lusebenza ngokugcwele futhi zonke izibani zenqola zisebenza kahle
• AKUMELE ukulayisha ngokweqile imoto yakho noma inqola
• Akufanele ukudonsa isisindo esingaphezu kwalokho okunconywa umenzi wemoto
• kufanele usabalalise isisindo kunqola yakho noma inqola ngokulinganayo, ngezinto ezisindayo phezu kwe-axle noma ama-axle, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi umthwalo wehla ebholeni lokudonsa
• akufanele udlule isisindo esinconywe umenzi noma umthwalo we-tow-ball. Ukusatshalaliswa kwesisindo okufanele kufanele kunciphise amathuba okujika, ukugwaza nokulahlekelwa ukulawula
 • KUMELE uvikele umthwalo wakho, futhi AKUMELE uqhume ngendlela eyingozi
 • Kumelwe uqinisekise ukuthi izinto ezisindayo noma ezibukhali nezilwane zivikelekile ngokuphephile. Lapho kushayisana, izinto noma izilwane ezingavikelekile zingashaya umuntu ongaphakathi emotweni futhi zibangele ukulimala okukhulu
 • izibuko zokudonsa KUMELE zisetshenziswe uma imoto yakho incane kune-trailer noma umthwalo wakho, noma uma i-trailer noma umthwalo uvimbela umbono wakho wangemuva
 • i-trailer yakho KUMELE ibe nedivayisi yesibili yokuxhuma, njengeketanga lokuphepha
 • ukuthwala umthwalo noma ukudonsa i-trailer kungadinga ukuthi ulungise izibani zakho zangaphambili.

 Ngesikhathi sokudonsa

 Njengomshayeli:

 • qaphela ukuthi imikhawulo yesivinini encishisiwe iyasebenza — bheka uMthetho 124
• qaphela ukuthi ibanga lakho lokuma linganda kakhulu — bheka uMthetho 126
• AKUMELE usebenzise umzila ongakwesokudla womgwaqo omkhulu onemizila emithathu noma ngaphezulu — bheka uMthetho 265
• uma i-trailer iqala ukuphambuka noma ukugxuma, noma ulahlekelwa ukulawula, yehlisa i-accelerator bese wehlisa isivinini kancane ukuze uthole ukulawula kabusha. Ungabhuleki kakhulu.

 Ukuphazamiseka

 Uma kwenzeka ukuphazamiseka, khumbula ukuthi:

 • ukudonsa imoto ngentambo yokudonsa kungaba yingozi; cabanga ukusebenzisa i-tow bar eqinile noma ukuvuselela kochwepheshe esikhundleni salokho
• kungathatha isikhathi eside ukwakha isivinini lapho ujoyina kabusha umgwaqo — bheka futhi uMthetho 278.

 Ukuze uthole iseluleko esengeziwe mayelana nokudonsa ngokuphephile, bheka Ukufunda okwengeziwe.

 Imithetho: Imithethonqubo ye-CUR 27, 33, 86A kanye ne-100; umthethonqubo we-RVLR 18; umthethonqubo we-MT(E&W)R 12; kanye nemithethonqubo ye-MV(DL)R 6, 7 kanye no-76 kanye noSheduli 2.

description:
Amabhande esihlalo kanye nezivikelo zezingane (Imithetho 99 kuya ku-102)

 Umthetho 99

 KUMELE ugqoke ibhande lesihlalo ezimotweni, emaveni nakwezinye izimoto zezimpahla uma lifakiwe.

 Abantu abadala nezingane ezineminyaka engu-14 noma ngaphezulu KUMELE basebenzise ibhande lesihlalo noma izivikelo zezingane, lapho lifakiwe khona, lapho behleli emabhasini amancane, emabhasini nasezinqoleni.

 Ukukhululwa kuvunyelwe:

 • abanezitifiketi zokuxolelwa kwezokwelapha
• abantu abaletha noma abaqoqa ezimotweni zezimpahla lapho behamba ibanga elingaphansi kwamamitha angu-50, cishe ama-162 izinyawo .

 Imithetho: RTA 1988 izigaba 14 no-15; MV(WSB)R; MV(WSBCFS)R; kanye ne-MV(WSB)(A)R 2005 kanye no-2006.

 Izidingo zebhande lesihlalo

 Lokhu okulandelayo kufingqa izidingo zomthetho eziyinhloko zokugqoka amabhande esihlalo ezimotweni, emaveni nakwezinye izimoto zezimpahla.

 Umshayeli

 • Isihlalo sangaphambili: ibhande lesihlalo KUMELE ligqokwe uma lifakiwe.
• Umthwalo wemfanelo: umshayeli.

 Ingane engaphansi kweminyaka emi-3 ubudala

 • Isihlalo sangaphambili: ibhande lesihlalo elifanele KUMELE lisetshenziswe.
• Isihlalo sangemuva: ibhande lesihlalo elifanele lengane KUMELE lisetshenziswe. Uma lingekho etekisini, ingane ingahamba ngaphandle kokuvinjelwa.
• Umthwalo wemfanelo: umshayeli.

 Ingane kusukela ngosuku lwayo lokuzalwa lwesithathu kuze kube yilapho ifinyelela amamitha angu-1.35 ukuphakama noma usuku lwayo lokuzalwa lwe-12, noma yikuphi okwenzeka kuqala

 • Isihlalo sangaphambili: isihlalo sengane esifanele KUMELE sisetshenziswe.
• Isihlalo sangemuva: isihlalo sengane esifanele KUMELE sisetshenziswe lapho kufakwa khona amabhande esihlalo.
• Ibhande lesihlalo lomuntu omdala KUMELE lisetshenziswe uma isihlalo sengane esifanele singatholakali etekisini enelayisensi noma emotweni eqashiwe yangasese, ngezizathu zesidingo esingalindelekile ebangeni elifushane, noma ngoba izihlalo ezimbili ezisetshenziswayo zivimbela isihlalo sesithathu ukuthi singafakwa.
• Umthwalo wemfanelo: umshayeli.

 Ingane ende kunamamitha angu-1.35, cishe amasentimitha angu-4 amamitha ama-intshi angu-5, noma eneminyaka engu-12 noma engu-13

 • Isihlalo sangaphambili: ibhande lesihlalo KUMELE ligqokwe uma litholakala.
• Isihlalo sangemuva: ibhande lesihlalo KUMELE ligqokwe uma litholakala.
• Umthwalo wemfanelo: umshayeli.

 Abagibeli abadala abaneminyaka engu-14 noma ngaphezulu

 • Isihlalo sangaphambili: ibhande lesihlalo KUMELE ligqokwe uma litholakala.
• Isihlalo sangemuva: ibhande lesihlalo KUMELE ligqokwe uma litholakala.
• Umthwalo wemfanelo: umgibeli.

 Umthetho 100

 Umshayeli KUMELE aqinisekise ukuthi yonke ingane engaphansi kweminyaka eyi-14 ubudala emotweni, evenini noma kwenye imoto yezimpahla igqoka ibhande lesihlalo noma isebenzisa isihlalo sengane esivunyiwe lapho kudingeka khona.

 Uma ingane ingaphansi kwamamitha ayi-1.35, cishe amasentimitha angu-4 amamitha ama-5, isihlalo sengane, isihlalo sengane, isihlalo se-booster noma umcamelo we-booster KUMELE kusetshenziswe. Kumelwe ifanele isisindo sengane futhi ifakwe ngokwemiyalelo yomenzi.

 Imithetho: RTA 1988 izigaba 14 no-15; MV(WSB)R; MV(WSBCFS)R; kanye ne-MV(WSB)(A)R 2006.

 Umthetho 101

 Isihlalo somntwana esibheke ngemuva AKUMELE sifakelwe esihlalweni esivikelwe yi-airbag esebenzayo yangaphambili. Uma kwenzeka ingozi, i-airbag ingabangela ukulimala okukhulu noma ukufa enganeni.

 Imithetho: RTA 1988 izigaba 14 no-15; MV(WSB)R; MV(WSBCFS)R; kanye ne-MV(WSB)(A)R 2006.

 Umthetho 102

 Izingane ezisezimotweni, emaveni nakwezinye izimoto zezimpahla

 Abashayeli abathwala izingane kufanele baqinisekise nokuthi:

 • izingane zingena emotweni ngomnyango oseduze nomgwaqo
• izivikelo zezingane zifakwa kahle ngokwemiyalelo yomenzi
• izingane azihlali ngemuva kwezihlalo zangemuva emotweni yefa noma i-hatchback ngaphandle kokuthi kufakwe isihlalo somntwana esikhethekile
• kusetshenziswa izingidi zeminyango yokuphepha kwengane, lapho zifakwa khona, lapho izingane zisemotweni
 • izingane zigcinwa zilawulwa.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 8. Imithetho ejwayelekile, amasu kanye nezeluleko zabo bonke abashayeli nabagibeli (103 kuya ku-158)
description:
Izimpawu (Imithetho 103 kuya ku-106)

 Umthetho 103

 Izimpawu ziyaxwayisa futhi zazise abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo, okuhlanganisa nabahamba ngezinyawo, ngezenzo zakho ozihlosile. Bheka ‘Izimpawu kwabanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo’.

 Kufanele njalo:

 • unikeze izimpawu ezicacile ngesikhathi esiningi, ngemva kokuhlola ukuthi izimpawu ngaleso sikhathi ngeke zidukise
• sebenzisa izimpawu ukweluleka abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo ngaphambi kokushintsha indlela noma isiqondiso, ukuma noma ukuhamba
• khansela izimpawu ngemva kokusebenzisa
• qiniseka ukuthi izimpawu zakho ngeke zidide abanye
• sebenzisa isignali yengalo ukugcizelela noma ukuqinisa isignali yakho uma kudingeka.

 Isibonelo, uma uhlose ukuma ngemva komgwaqo oseceleni, ungabonisi kuze kube yilapho udlula umgwaqo. Ukubonisa izimpawu kusenesikhathi kunganikeza umbono wokuthi uhlose ukuphendukela kuwo. Izibani zakho zamabhuleki zizoxwayisa ithrafikhi ngemuva kokuthi wehlisa ijubane.

 Khumbula ukuthi ukubonisa izimpawu akukuniki kuqala.

 Umthetho 104

 Kufanele futhi:

 • qaphela izimpawu ezinikezwa abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo futhi uqhubeke kuphela uma wanelisekile ukuthi kuphephile
• khumbula ukuthi inkomba kwenye imoto kungenzeka ukuthi ayizange ikhanselwe.

 Umthetho 105

 KUMELE ulalele izimpawu ezinikezwe ngu:

 • amaphoyisa
• amaphoyisa omgwaqo
• abaqaphi bomgwaqo — bheka ‘Izimpawu zabantu abagunyaziwe’
• izimpawu ezisetshenziswa abaqaphi bokuwela izikole.

 Imithetho: Isigaba se-RTRA 28; Isigaba 35 se-RTA sika-1988; Isigaba 6 se-TMA; kanye nesigaba se-FTWO 3.

 Umthetho 106

 Amaphoyisa amisa izinqubo

 Uma amaphoyisa efuna ukuthi umise imoto yakho, lapho kungenzeka khona, azodonsela ukunaka kwakho ngokuthi:

 • izibani eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ezikhanyayo noma izibani zangaphambili, noma ukushaya i-siren noma uphondo, ngokuvamile ngemuva
• akuqondise ukuthi ume eceleni ngokukhomba kanye/noma usebenzisa inkomba yesobunxele.

 KUMELE ume eceleni bese ume ngokushesha nje lapho kuphephile ukwenza kanjalo. Ngemva kokuma, cisha injini yakho.

 Umthetho: RTA 1988 isigaba 163.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 8. Imithetho ejwayelekile, amasu kanye nezeluleko zabo bonke abashayeli nabagibeli (103 kuya ku-158)
