Ezinye izinqubo zokuma (Imithetho 107 kuya ku-112)

 Umthetho 107

 Izikhulu ze-Agency ye-Driver and Vehicle Standards

 Izikhulu ze-Agency ye-Driver and Vehicle Standards zinamandla okumisa izimoto kuyo yonke imigwaqo, okuhlanganisa imigwaqo emikhulu kanye nemigwaqo emikhulu.

 Zizodonsela ukunaka kwakho ngokukhanyisa izibani eziphuzi:

 • zisuka phambili, zicele ukuthi uzilandele ziye endaweni ephephile yokuma
• ngemuva, zikuqondise ukuthi ume eceleni ngokukhomba kanye/noma ukusebenzisa inkomba yesobunxele.

 Kuyicala ukungalandeli iziqondiso zabo. KUMELE ulalele noma yiziphi izimpawu abazinikezayo. Bheka ‘Izimpawu zabantu abagunyaziwe’.

 Imithetho: RTA 1988 isigaba 67, kanye nesigaba se-PRA 41 kanye neShejuli 5(8).

 Umthetho 108

 Amaphoyisa omgwaqo

 Amaphoyisa omgwaqo anamandla okumisa izimoto emigwaqweni eminingi emikhulu kanye neminye imigwaqo `A` eNgilandi naseWales.

 Uma amaphoyisa omgwaqo agqoke iyunifomu efuna ukumisa imoto yakho ezindaweni zokuphepha, njengomthwalo ongavikelekile, lapho kungenzeka khona, azokudonsa ukunaka kwakho ngokuthi:

 • akhanyisa izibani eziphuzi, ngokuvamile ngemuva
• akuqondise ukuthi ume eceleni ngokukhomba kanye/noma usebenzisa inkomba yesobunxele.

 KUMELE ume eceleni bese ume ngokushesha nje lapho kuphephile. Ngemva kokuma, cisha injini yakho.

 Kuyicala ukungalandeli iziqondiso zawo. Bheka `Izimpawu zabantu abagunyaziwe`.

 Umthetho: Izigaba 35 no-163 ze-RTA zika-1988, njengoba zichitshiyelwe yisigaba 6 se-TMA.

 Umthetho 109

 Izimpawu zethrafikhi kanye nezimpawu zomgwaqo

 KUMELE ulalele:

 • zonke izimpawu zethrafikhi — bheka ‘Izimpawu zokukhanya ezilawula ithrafikhi’
• zonke izimpawu zethrafikhi ezinikeza imiyalo, okuhlanganisa nezimpawu zesikhashana kanye nezimpawu — bheka ‘Izimpawu zethrafikhi’.

 Qiniseka ukuthi uyazi, uyaqonda futhi wenza okuthile kuzo zonke ezinye izimpawu zethrafikhi nolwazi kanye nezimpawu zomgwaqo. Bheka ‘Izimpawu zethrafikhi’, ‘Izimpawu zomgwaqo’ kanye ‘nezimpawu zezimoto’.

 Imithetho: Isigaba 36 se-RTA sika-1988 kanye ne-TSRGD Isheduli 3, Ingxenye 4; Isheduli 9, Izingxenye 7 kanye no-8; Isheduli 14, Izingxenye 1 kanye no-5; Isheduli 7, Ingxenye 6; kanye neSheduli 15, Ingxenye 1.

 Umthetho 110

 Izibani zokukhanyisa

 Khanyisa izibani zakho zokukhanyisa kuphela ukuze wazise abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo ukuthi ukhona.

 Ungakhanyisi izibani zakho zokukhanyisa ukuze udlulise noma yimuphi omunye umyalezo noma wesabise abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo.

 Umthetho 111

 Ungalokothi ucabange ukuthi izibani zokukhanyisa ziyisimemo sokuqhubeka. Sebenzisa isahlulelo sakho bese uqhubeka ngokucophelela.

 Umthetho 112

 Ihutha

 Sebenzisa ihutha lakho kuphela ngenkathi imoto yakho ihamba futhi uma udinga ukuxwayisa abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo ngokuba khona kwakho.

 Ungalokothi ushayele ihutha lakho ngomsindo.

 AKUMELE usebenzise ihutha lakho:

 • lapho umile emgwaqweni
• lapho ushayela endaweni eyakhiwe phakathi kuka-11:30 ntambama no-7:00 ekuseni
• ngaphandle kwalapho omunye umsebenzisi womgwaqo ebeka ingozi.

 Umthetho: Umthethonqubo we-CUR 99.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 8. Imithetho ejwayelekile, amasu kanye nezeluleko zabo bonke abashayeli nabagibeli (103 kuya ku-158)
description:
Izidingo zokukhanyisa (Imithetho 113 kuya ku-116)

 Umthetho 113

 KUMELE:

 • uqinisekise ukuthi zonke izibani eziseceleni kanye nezibani zepuleti lokubhalisa langemuva zikhanyiswa phakathi kokushona kwelanga nokuphuma kwelanga
• sebenzisa izibani zasebusweni ebusuku, ngaphandle komgwaqo onezibani zasebusweni ezikhanyisiwe. Imigwaqo enjalo ngokuvamile ikhawulelwe ku-30 mph (48 km/h), noma ku-20 mph (32 km/h) eWales, ngaphandle kokuthi kuchazwe ngenye indlela
• sebenzisa izibani zasebusweni lapho ukubonakala kuncipha kakhulu — bheka uMthetho 226.

 Ubusuku, okusho amahora obumnyama, buchazwa njengesikhathi esisukela engxenyeni yehora ngemva kokushona kwelanga kuze kube yingxenye yehora ngaphambi kokuphuma kwelanga.

 Imithetho: Imithethonqubo ye-RVLR 3, 24 kanye no-25; eScotland, isigaba se-RTRA 82, njengoba sichitshiyelwe yi-NRSWA, isigaba 59 seShejuli 8; kanye ne-RR(20)O.

 Umthetho 114

 AKUMELE:

 • sebenzisa noma yiziphi izibani ngendlela ekhazimulisa noma ebangela ukungakhululeki kwabanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo, okuhlanganisa abahamba ngezinyawo, abagibeli bamabhayisikili kanye nabagibeli bamahhashi
• sebenzisa izibani zenkungu zangaphambili noma zangemuva ngaphandle kokuthi ukubonakala kuncishiswe kakhulu.

 KUMELE ucime izibani zakho zenkungu lapho ukubonakala kuthuthukiswa ukuze ugweme ukukhazimulisa abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo. Bheka Umthetho 226.

 Emigqeni yethrafikhi engashintshi, abashayeli kufanele basebenzise ibhuleki lokupaka. Uma imoto isimile, susa unyawo lwakho ebhulekini lezinyawo ukuze uvale izibani zebhuleki. Lokhu kuzonciphisa ukukhanya kwabasebenzisi bomgwaqo ngemuva kuze kube yilapho ithrafikhi iqala ukuhamba futhi.

 Umthetho: Umthethonqubo we-RVLR 27.

 Umthetho 115

 Kufanele futhi:

 • sebenzisa izibani ezifakwe amalambu acwilisiwe, noma izibani ezifiphele uma zifakiwe, ebusuku ezindaweni ezakhiwe kahle kanye nangesikhathi sezulu esingesihle sasemini ukuze ubonakale
• gcina izibani zakho zicwilisiwe ngenkathi udlula imoto uze ulingane nenye imoto, bese usebenzisa ugongolo olukhulu uma kudingeka, ngaphandle kokuthi ukwenza kanjalo kuzokhazimulisa abasebenzisi bomgwaqo abazayo
• yehlisa ijubane futhi, uma kudingeka, yima uma ukhazimuliswa izibani ezingaphambili.

 Umthetho 116

 Izibani zokuxwayisa ngengozi

 Izibani zokuxwayisa ngengozi zingasetshenziswa ngenkathi imoto yakho imile ukuxwayisa ukuthi ivimba ithrafikhi okwesikhashana. Ungalokothi uzisebenzise njengezaba zokupaka okuyingozi noma okungekho emthethweni.

 AKUMELE usebenzise izibani zokuxwayisa ngengozi ngenkathi ushayela noma udonswa ngaphandle kokuthi:

 • usemzileni omkhulu noma emgwaqweni wezimoto ezimbili ongenamingcele
• udinga ukuxwayisa abashayeli abangemuva kwakho ngengozi noma isithiyo esingaphambili.

 Sebenzisa izibani zokuxwayisa ngengozi isikhathi esanele kuphela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isixwayiso sakho siqashelwe.

 Umthetho: Umthethonqubo we-RVLR 27.

 Ukubhreka

 Umthetho 117

 Ezimweni ezivamile

 Indlela ephephile yokubhreka ukubhreka kusenesikhathi futhi kancane. Qeda ngokuqinile njengoba uqala ukuma. Nciphisa ingcindezi ngaphambi nje kokuba imoto iphumule ukuze ugweme ukuma okuxegayo.

 Umthetho 118

 Esimweni esiphuthumayo

 Ukubhreka ngokushesha. Zama ukungabhreka kakhulu kangangokuthi amasondo avale, njengoba amasondo akhiyiwe angabangela ukulahlekelwa ukulawula.

 Umthetho 119

 Ukushelela

 Ukushelela kuvame ukubangelwa:

 • ukubhreka kakhulu
• ukusheshisa kakhulu
• ukuqondisa kanzima kakhulu
• ukushayela ngesivinini esikhulu kakhulu ngenxa yezimo zomgwaqo.

 Uma kwenzeka ukushelela, susa imbangela yako ngokukhulula i-pedal yebhuleki ngokuphelele noma unciphise i-accelerator. Jikisa isondo lokuqondisa liye ngakwesokushelela. Isibonelo, uma ingemuva lemoto lishelela ngakwesokudla, shayela ngokushesha uye kwesokudla ukuze ululame.

 Umthetho 120

 Izinhlelo zokubhuleka ezilwa nokukhiya (i-ABS)

 Uma imoto yakho inamabhuleki alwa nokukhiya, landela iseluleko esisencwadini yayo yemiyalelo.

 Esimweni esiphuthumayo, faka ibhuleki lezinyawo ngokuqinile futhi ungalidedeli ingcindezi kuze kube yilapho imoto yehlile ijubane elifunekayo. I-ABS kufanele ikuvumele ukuthi ugcine ukulawula kokuqondisa, kodwa ungacabangi ukuthi imoto ene-ABS izoma ibanga elifushane.

 Umthetho 121

 Amabhuleki athintekile ngamanzi

 Ngemva kokushayela emanzini ajulile, amabhuleki akho angase angasebenzi kahle. Wahlole ngesikhathi sokuqala esiphephile ngokucindezela i-pedal yebhuleki kancane.

 Uma amabhuleki engasebenzi kahle ngokugcwele, sebenzisa ingcindezi encane kancane ngenkathi ushayela kancane. Lokhu kuzosiza ukuwomisa.

 Umthetho 122

 Ukugudla i-coasting

 Ukugudla i-coasting kusho ukuhamba nge-neutral noma nge-clutch ecindezelwe phansi. Kunganciphisa ukulawula komshayeli ngoba:

 • ukugudla kwenjini kuyasuswa
• isivinini sizokhula ngokushesha ekwehleni
• ukusetshenziswa okwengeziwe kwebhuleki lezinyawo kunganciphisa ukusebenza kwalo
• impendulo yokuqondisa iyathinteka, ikakhulukazi ekugobeni nasemakhoneni
• ukukhetha igiya elifanele lapho kudingeka kungaba nzima kakhulu.

 Umthetho 123

 Umshayeli nendawo ezungezile

 AKUMELE:

 • ushiye imoto epakiwe ingagadiwe injini yayo isebenza
• ushiye injini isebenza ngokungadingekile ngenkathi imoto imile emgwaqweni womphakathi.

 Ngokuvamile, uma imoto imile futhi kungenzeka ukuthi ihlale injalo isikhathi esingaphezu kwemizuzu embalwa, faka ibhuleki lokupaka bese uvala injini ukuze unciphise ukukhishwa kwegesi kanye nokungcoliswa komsindo.

 Injini ingaqhubeka isebenza uma imoto imile emgwaqweni noma uma isetshenziselwa ukuxilonga amaphutha.

 Umthetho: Imithethonqubo ye-CUR 98 kanye ne-107.

 Umthetho 124

 Imikhawulo yesivinini

 AKUMELE weqe umkhawulo wesivinini esiphezulu somgwaqo noma semoto yakho.

 Ngaphandle kokuthi izimpawu zibonise okunye, imigwaqo enezibani zomgwaqo, ngaphandle kwemigwaqo emikhulu, ngokuvamile inomkhawulo wesivinini:

 • 30 mph (48 km/h) eNgilandi naseScotland
• 20 mph (32 km/h) eWales.

 Imikhawulo yesivinini esiphezulu

 Izimoto nezithuthuthu, okuhlanganisa amaveni atholakala emotweni afinyelela ku-2 tonnes isisindo esiphezulu esithwalwe:

 • izindawo ezakhiwe eNgilandi naseScotland: 30 mph (48 km/h)
• izindawo ezakhiwe eWales: 20 mph (32 km/h)
• imigwaqo eyodwa: 60 mph (96 km/h)
• imigwaqo emibili: 70 mph (112 km/h)
• imigwaqo emikhulu: 70 mph (112 km/h).

 Izimoto ezidonsa amakharavani noma ama-trailer, okuhlanganisa amaveni nezithuthuthu ezivela emotweni:

 • izindawo ezakhiwe eNgilandi naseScotland: 30 mph (48 km/h)
• izindawo ezakhiwe eWales: 20 mph (32 km/h)
• imigwaqo eyodwa: 50 mph (80 km/h)
• imigwaqo emibili: 60 mph (96 km/h)
• imigwaqo emikhulu: 60 mph (96 km/h).

 Ama-motorhomes noma ama-carraven ezimoto angadluli amathani angu-3.05 isisindo esiphezulu esingalayishiwe:

 • izindawo ezakhiwe eNgilandi naseScotland: 30 mph (48 km/h)
• izindawo ezakhiwe eWales: 20 mph (32 km/h)
• imigwaqo eyodwa: 60 mph (96 km/h)
• imizila emibili: 70 mph (112 km/h)
• imizila emikhulu: 70 mph (112 km/h).

 Ama-motorhomes noma ama-carraven ezimoto adlula amathani angu-3.05 isisindo esiphezulu esingalayishiwe:

 • izindawo ezakhiwe eNgilandi naseScotland: 30 mph (48 km/h)
• izindawo ezakhiwe eWales: 20 mph (32 km/h)
• imizila eyodwa: 50 mph (80 km/h)
• imizila emibili: 60 mph (96 km/h)
• imizila emikhulu: 70 mph (112 km/h).

 Amabhasi, amabhasi kanye namabhasi amancane angadluli amamitha ayi-12 ubude obuphelele:

 • izindawo ezakhiwe eNgilandi naseScotland: 30 mph (48 km/h)
• izindawo ezakhiwe eWales: 20 mph (32 km/h)
• imigwaqo eyodwa: 50 mph (80 km/h)
• imigwaqo emibili: 60 mph (96 km/h)
• imigwaqo emikhulu: 70 mph (112 km/h).

 Umkhawulo womgwaqo omkhulu ungama-60 mph (96 km/h) uma imoto idlula amamitha ayi-12 ubude.

 Izimoto zezimpahla ezingadluli amathani angu-7.5 isisindo esiphezulu esithwalwe:

 • izindawo ezakhiwe eNgilandi naseScotland: 30 mph (48 km/h)
• izindawo ezakhiwe eWales: 20 mph (32 km/h)
• imizila eyodwa: 50 mph (80 km/h)
• imizila emibili: 60 mph (96 km/h)
• imizila emikhulu: 70 mph (112 km/h).

 Umkhawulo womgwaqo omkhulu ungama-60 mph (96 km/h) uma imoto yezimpahla ixhunywe noma idonsa i-trailer.

 Izimoto zezimpahla ezidlula amathani angu-7.5 isisindo esiphezulu eNgilandi naseWales:

 • izindawo ezakhiwe eNgilandi naseScotland: 30 mph (48 km/h)
• izindawo ezakhiwe eWales: 20 mph (32 km/h)
• imizila eyodwa: 50 mph (80 km/h)
• imizila emibili: 60 mph (96 km/h)
• imigwaqo emikhulu: 60 mph (96 km/h).

 Izimoto zezimpahla ezidlula amathani angu-7.5 isisindo esiphezulu esithwalwe eScotland:

 • izindawo ezakhiwe eNgilandi naseScotland: 30 mph (48 km/h)
• izindawo ezakhiwe eWales: 20 mph (32 km/h)
• imigwaqo eyodwa: 40 mph (64 km/h)
• imigwaqo emibili: 50 mph (80 km/h)
• imigwaqo emikhulu: 60 mph (96 km/h).

 Ukuze uthole imikhawulo esebenza ezinhlotsheni zezimoto ezikhethekile, kufaka phakathi izimoto ezinkulu kakhulu, bheka okunye ukufunda.

 Imikhawulo ebekwe endaweni ingafaka:

 • 20 mph (32 km/h) kwezinye izindawo ezakhiwe eNgilandi naseScotland
• 30 mph (48 km/h) kwezinye izindawo ezakhiwe eWales
• 50 mph (80 km/h) ezindleleni zezimoto ezilodwa ezinezingozi ezaziwayo
• imikhawulo yesivinini esiphezulu eguquguqukayo kweminye imigwaqo emikhulu kanye nemigwaqo emibili.

 Imikhawulo yesivinini iphoqelelwa ngamaphoyisa.

 Umthetho: Izigaba ze-RTRA 81, 86 kanye no-89 kanye noHlelo 6, njengoba kushintshiwe yi-MV(VSL)(E&W), kanye ne-RR(20)O.

 Umthetho 125

 Isivinini esiphephile

 Umkhawulo wesivinini ungowesiphezulu ngokuphelele. Akusho ukuthi ukushayela ngaleso sivinini kuphephile kuzo zonke izimo.

 Isivinini esingaphephile sandisa amathuba okubangela noma okungakwazi ukugwema ukushayisana, kanye nobunzima bengozi. Isivinini esingafanele siphinde sesabise abantu futhi sivimbele ukuhamba, ukugibela ibhayisikili kanye nokugibela amahhashi.

 Ukushayela ngesivinini esikhulu kakhulu ngenxa yemigwaqo kanye nezimoto kuyingozi. Nciphisa isivinini sakho njalo uma:

 • ukwakheka komgwaqo noma isimo sawo kuletha izingozi, njengokugoba
• ukwabelana ngomgwaqo nabantu abahamba ngezinyawo, ikakhulukazi izingane, abantu abadala noma abakhubazekile, abagibeli bamabhayisikili, abagibeli bamahhashi, izimoto ezidonswa amahhashi kanye nabagibeli bamabhayisikili
• izimo zezulu zenza isivinini esiphansi siphephe kakhudlwana
• ukushayela ebusuku, lapho abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo kunzima ukubabona.

 Ukuma amabanga

 Shayela ngesivinini esikuvumela ukuthi ume kahle ngaphakathi kwebanga ongalibona licace.

 Kufanele:

 • ushiye isikhala esanele sokuma ngokuphepha uma imoto engaphambili yehlisa noma ima ngokuzumayo; ungalokothi usondele ngaphezu kwebanga lokuma eliphelele
• vumela okungenani igebe lemizuzwana emibili emigwaqweni enesivinini esikhulu kanye nasemathuneni lapho ukubonakala kuncipha khona
• okungenani phinda kabili leli gebe emigwaqweni emanzi
• khulisa kuze kube izikhathi eziyishumi emigwaqweni ebandayo
• khumbula ukuthi izimoto ezinkulu nezithuthuthu zidinga ibanga elikhulu lokuma
• vumela igebe lemizuzwana emine uma ushayela imoto enkulu emhubheni
• shiya okungenani igebe lamamitha ama-5 ukusuka emotweni engaphambili uma kufanele ume emhubheni.

 Ukushaya intambo ngemuva kwenzeka lapho igebe emotweni engaphambili lincane kakhulu ukuthi ungama ngokuphepha uma leyo moto ibhuleka ngokuzumayo.

 Ukushaya intambo ngemuva kuyingozi futhi kuyesabisa futhi kungabangela ukushayisana, ikakhulukazi ngesivinini. Ibanga lokulandela eliphephile likunika isikhathi sokusabela nokuma uma kudingeka.

 Izenzo zokushayela eziyingozi nezingenandaba, okuhlanganisa nokushaya intambo ngemuva, ziphoqelelwa ngamaphoyisa.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 8. Imithetho ejwayelekile, amasu kanye nezeluleko zabo bonke abashayeli nabagibeli (103 kuya ku-158)
subcategory: Imigqa kanye nezimpawu zemizila emgwaqweni (imithetho 127 kuya ku-132)
englishSubcategory: Lines and lane markings on the road (rules 127 to 132)
description:
Imigqa kanye nezimpawu zemizila emgwaqweni (Imithetho 127 kuya ku-132)

 Umthetho 127

 Imigqa emhlophe ephukile

 Umugqa omhlophe ophukile uphawula phakathi komgwaqo.

 Lapho imigqa iba mide futhi izikhala ziba mfushane, kuba nengozi phambili.

 Ungaweqi umugqa ngaphandle kokuthi ubona ukuthi umgwaqo ucacile futhi uhlose ukuwudlula noma ukuwucisha.

 Umthetho 128

 Imigqa emhlophe ephindwe kabili enomugqa oseduze nawe ophukile

 Ungaweqa imigqa ukuze uwudlule uma kuphephile, uma nje ungaqeda ukuqondisa ngaphambi kokufinyelela umugqa omhlophe oqinile ohlangothini lwakho.

 Imicibisholo emhlophe ekhomba indlela emgwaqweni ikhombisa ukuthi udinga ukubuyela ohlangothini lwakho lomgwaqo.

 Umthetho 129

 Imigqa emhlophe ephindwe kabili enomugqa oseduze nawe oqinile

 AKUMELE uwele noma ugibele umugqa oqinile ngaphandle kokuthi kuphephile futhi udinga ukungena endaweni eseduze noma umgwaqo oseceleni.

 Uma kudingeka futhi uma umgwaqo ucacile, ungawela umugqa ukuze:

 • udlule imoto emile
• udlule ibhayisikili elihamba ngesivinini esingu-10 mph (16 km/h) noma ngaphansi
• udlule ihhashi elihamba ngesivinini esingu-10 mph (16 km/h) noma ngaphansi
• udlule imoto yokulungisa umgwaqo ehamba ngesivinini esingu-10 mph (16 km/h) noma ngaphansi.

 Imithetho: RTA 1988 isigaba 36 kanye ne-TSRGD Isheduli 9, Ingxenye 8.

 Umthetho 130

 Izindawo zemigqa emhlophe evundlile noma ama-chevron

 Lezi zindawo zihlukanisa imizila yethrafikhi noma zivikela ithrafikhi ejika kwesokudla.

 Uma indawo izungezwe umugqa omhlophe ophukile, akufanele ungene kuyo ngaphandle kokuthi kudingeka ukungena futhi ungabona ukuthi iphephile.

 Uma indawo inama-chevron futhi izungezwe imigqa emhlophe eqinile, AKUMELE ungene kuyo ngaphandle uma kunesimo esiphuthumayo.

 Imithetho: Imithethonqubo ye-MT(E&W)R 5, 9, 10 kanye no-16; Imithethonqubo ye-MT(S)R 4, 8, 9 kanye no-14; Isigaba 36 se-RTA sika-1988; kanye neShejuli 9 ye-TSRGD, Ingxenye 8.

 Umthetho 131

 Abahlukanisi bemizila

 Izihlukanisi zemizila ziyimigqa emifushane, emhlophe ephukile esetshenziswa ezindleleni ezinkulu ukuze zihlukaniswe ngemizila. Kufanele ugcine phakathi kwazo.

 Umthetho 132

 Izigxobo zomgwaqo ezikhanyayo

 Izigxobo zomgwaqo ezikhanyayo zingasetshenziswa nemigqa emhlophe.

 • Izigxobo ezimhlophe ziphawula imizila noma phakathi komgwaqo.
• Izigxobo ezibomvu ziphawula unqenqema lwesobunxele lomgwaqo.
• Izigxobo eziphuzi ziphawula ukubhukha okuphakathi komgwaqo omkhulu noma umgwaqo omkhulu.
• Izigxobo eziluhlaza ziphawula unqenqema lomgwaqo omkhulu emigwaqweni evulekile kanye nemigwaqo eshelelayo.
• Izigxobo eziluhlaza neziphuzi zikhombisa izinguquko zesikhashana ekuhlelweni kwemizila, isibonelo lapho kwenziwa khona umsebenzi womgwaqo.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 8. Imithetho ejwayelekile, amasu kanye nezeluleko zabo bonke abashayeli nabagibeli (103 kuya ku-158)
subcategory: Imigwaqo yezimoto enemizila eminingi (imithetho 133 kuya ku-143)
description:
Imizila yezimoto enemizila eminingi (Imithetho 133 kuya ku-143)

 Ukuziphatha komgwaqo

 Umthetho 133

 Ngaphambi kokushintsha imizila:

 • sebenzisa izibuko zakho
• uma kudingeka, bheka eceleni ngokushesha
• qiniseka ukuthi ngeke uphoqe omunye umsebenzisi womgwaqo ukuthi ashintshe indlela noma isivinini
• uma kuphephile, bonisa izinhloso zakho kwabanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo
• hamba lapho indlela icacile.

 Umthetho 134

 Landela izimpawu nezimpawu zomgwaqo bese ungena emzileni njengoba kuqondiswe.

 Ezimweni ezixinene, ungazishintshi imizila ngokungadingekile.

 Ukuhlangana ngokulandelana kunconywa kuphela uma kuphephile futhi kufanele futhi izimoto zihamba ngesivinini esiphansi kakhulu, njengalapho zisondela emisebenzini yomgwaqo noma engozini yethrafikhi yomgwaqo. Akukhuthazwa ngesivinini esiphezulu.

 Imigwaqo eyodwa

 Umthetho 135

 Endleleni eyodwa enemizila emithathu lapho izimpawu noma izimpawu zinganikezi kuqala ithrafikhi kunoma iyiphi indlela:

 • sebenzisa umzila ophakathi kuphela ukuze udlule noma ujike kwesokudla
• khumbula ukuthi awunalo ilungelo lokusebenzisa umzila ophakathi kunomshayeli osondela ohlangothini oluphambene
• ungasebenzisi umzila ongakwesokudla.

 Umthetho 136

 Lapho umgwaqo owodwa unemizila emine noma ngaphezulu, sebenzisa kuphela imizila ekhonjiswe yizimpawu noma izimpawu zomgwaqo.

 Imigwaqo emibili

 Indlela yezimoto ezimbili iwumgwaqo onomkhawulo ophakathi ohlukanisa izindlela zayo zezimoto.

 Umthetho 137

 Endleleni yezimoto ezimbili enemizila emibili, hlala emzileni wesobunxele. Sebenzisa umzila wesokudla ukuze udlule noma ujike kwesokudla.

 Ngemva kokudlula, buyela emzileni wesobunxele uma kuphephile.

 Umthetho 138

 Endleleni yezimoto ezimbili enemizila emithathu noma ngaphezulu, ungasebenzisa imizila ephakathi noma yesokudla ukuze udlule. Buyela emizileni ephakathi bese uye emzileni wesobunxele uma kuphephile.

 Umthetho 139

 Imizila yokukhwela kanye neyokukhasa

 Imizila yokukhwela kanye neyokukhasa inikezwa kwamanye amagquma.

 Sebenzisa eyodwa uma:

 • ushayela imoto ehamba kancane
• izimoto ezingemuva kwakho zifisa ukukudlula.

 Qaphela izimpawu nezimpawu zomgwaqo ezibonisa ukuthi umzila usuzophela.

 Umthetho 140

 Imizila yamabhayisikili nemizila yamabhayisikili

 Imizila yamabhayisikili iboniswa ngezimpawu zomgwaqo nezimpawu.

 AKUMELE ushayele noma upake emzileni wamabhayisikili ophawulwe umugqa omhlophe oqinile ngesikhathi samahora okusebenza kwawo.

 Ungashayeli noma upake emzileni wamabhayisikili ophawulwe umugqa omhlophe ophukile ngaphandle kokuthi lokhu kungenakugwenywa.

 AKUMELE upake kunoma yimuphi umzila wamabhayisikili ngenkathi kusebenza imikhawulo yokulinda.

 Nikeza abagibeli bamabhayisikili indlela emzileni wamabhayisikili, okuhlanganisa nabagibeli bamabhayisikili abasondela ngemuva. Ungabanqumi lapho bejika noma beshintsha imizila. Bheka Umthetho H3.

 Lungela ukuma bese ulinda igebe eliphephile ekuhambeni kwabagibeli bamabhayisikili ngaphambi kokuwela umzila wamabhayisikili.

 Imizila yamabhayisikili iyimizila yabagibeli bamabhayisikili evikelwe ngokomzimba noma etholakala kude nezimoto, ngaphandle kwalapho bewela khona imigwaqo eseceleni. Imizila yamabhayisikili ingabiwa nabahamba ngezinyawo.

 Uma ujika ungene noma uphuma endaweni yokuhlangana, vumela abagibeli bamabhayisikili basondele noma basebenzise umzila wamabhayisikili. Bheka uMthetho H3.

 Lungela ukuma bese ulinda igebe eliphephile ngaphambi kokuwela umzila wamabhayisikili. Khumbula ukuthi abagibeli bamabhayisikili bangasebenzisa umzila kuzo zombili izinhlangothi.

 Abagibeli bamabhayisikili abaphoqelekile ukusebenzisa imizila yamabhayisikili noma imizila yamabhayisikili.

 Umthetho: Izigaba ze-RTRA 5 no-8.

 Umthetho 141

 Imizila yamabhasi

 Imizila yamabhasi itholakala ngezimpawu zomgwaqo nezimpawu. Izimpawu zibonisa ukuthi yiziphi ezinye izimoto, uma zikhona, ezingasebenzisa lo mzila.

 Ngaphandle kokuthi izimpawu zikhomba okunye, ungashayeli emzileni webhasi ngesikhathi sokusebenza kwawo.

 Ungangena emzileni webhasi ukuze ume, ulayishe noma wehlise lapho lokhu kungavunyelwe khona.

 Umthetho 142

 Imizila yezimoto enabantu abaningi kanye neminye imizila yezimoto ekhethiwe

 Eminye imizila ikhawulelwe ezinhlotsheni ezithile zezimoto. Imikhawulo ingasebenza kwesinye noma sonke isikhathi. Izimpawu zethrafikhi zibonisa izikhathi zokusebenza kanye nezinhlobo zezimoto ezivunyelwe.

 AKUMELE ushayele emzileni okhethiwe ngesikhathi sokusebenza kwawo ngaphandle kokuthi izimpawu zibonisa ukuthi imoto yakho ivunyelwe. Bheka ‘Izimpawu zethrafikhi’.
Izimoto ezivunyelwe ukusebenzisa imizila ekhethiwe zingase zihlanganise noma zingafaki:

 • amabhayisikili
• amabhasi
• amatekisi
• izimoto eziqashiwe ezizimele ezinelayisensi
• izithuthuthu
• izimoto ezithwala imithwalo esindayo (ama-HGV)
• izimoto ezinabantu abaningi (ama-HOV).

 Ngesikhathi umzila we-HOV usebenza, KUMELE usetshenziswe kuphela yilaba:

 • izimoto eziqukethe okungenani inani elincane labantu ababoniswe ezimpawini zomgwaqo
• ezinye izimoto, njengebhasi nezithuthuthu, lapho izimpawu ngaphambi kokuqala komzila zivumela khona, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bangakanani abantu abagibela kuwo.

 Imithetho: Izigaba ze-RTRA 5 no-8, kanye nesigaba 36 se-RTA ka-1988.

 Umthetho 143

 Imigwaqo ehamba ngendlela eyodwa

 Ithrafikhi KUMELE ihambe ngendlela ekhonjiswe yizimpawu. Amabhasi kanye/noma amabhayisikili angaba nomzila onqamula imigwaqo.

 Khetha umzila ofanele wokuphuma kwakho ngokushesha okukhulu. Ungashintsha imizila ngokuzumayo.

 Ngaphandle kokuthi izimpawu noma izimpawu zomgwaqo zibonisa okuhlukile, sebenzisa:

 • umzila wesobunxele uma ujika kwesobunxele
• umzila wesokudla uma ujika kwesokudla
• umzila ofanele kakhulu uma uhamba uqonde phambili.

 Khumbula ukuthi ithrafikhi ingadlula kuzo zombili izinhlangothi.

 Imithetho: Isigaba 36 se-RTA sika-1988 kanye nesigaba 5 no-8 se-RTRA.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 8. Imithetho ejwayelekile, amasu kanye nezeluleko zabo bonke abashayeli nabagibeli (103 kuya ku-158)
description:
Iseluleko esijwayelekile (Imithetho 144 kuya ku-158)

 Umthetho 144

 AKUMELE:

 • shayela ngendlela eyingozi
• shayela ngaphandle kokunakekelwa okufanele nokunaka
• shayela ngaphandle kokucabangela okunengqondo kwabanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo.

 Ukushayela kudinga ukugxila nokunaka ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ungase ushayele ngendlela eyingozi noma uhamba ngesivinini esikhulu ngisho noma ungahlosile ukwenza kanjalo.

 Umthetho: Izigaba 2 no-3 ze-RTA 1988, njengoba zichitshiyelwe yi-RTA 1991.

 Umthetho 145

 AKUMELE ushayele endaweni noma ngaphezulu kwendlela yabahamba ngezinyawo, indlela yabahamba ngezinyawo noma indlela yamabhuloho ngaphandle kokuthi uthole ukufinyelela okusemthethweni empahleni noma esimweni esiphuthumayo.

 Imithetho: Isigaba 72 se-HA 1835 kanye nesigaba 34 se-RTA ka-1988.

 Umthetho 146

 Lungisa ukushayela kwakho ngohlobo nesimo somgwaqo. Ikakhulukazi:

 • ungaphathi imikhawulo yejubane njengezinhloso; ukushayela ngomkhawulo ophezulu ngokuvamile akufanelekile noma akuphephile
• cabanga ngezimo zomgwaqo kanye nethrafikhi
• lungela izimo ezingalindelekile noma ezinzima, njengomgwaqo ovinjiwe ngale kwejika elingaboni
 • lungisa ijubane lakho njengesinyathelo sokuqapha
• lungela abasebenzisi bomgwaqo abavela ezimpambanweni
• emigwaqweni eseceleni kanye nasemizileni yasemaphandleni, qaphela izimpambano ezingaphawuliwe lapho kungekho muntu obaluleke kakhulu
• lungela ukuma ezinhlelweni zokulawula ithrafikhi, emisebenzini yomgwaqo, ezindaweni zokuwela abahamba ngezinyawo noma ezibanini zomgwaqo
• lindela lokho abahambi ngezinyawo nabahamba ngamabhayisikili abangakwenza
• khumbula ukuthi abahamba ngezinyawo, ikakhulukazi izingane, bangase bangene emgwaqweni ngaphandle kokukubona uma bebheke ngakolunye uhlangothi.

 Umthetho 147

 Yiba nokucabangela

 Qaphela futhi ucabangele wonke umuntu osebenzisa umgwaqo, ikakhulukazi labo abadinga ukunakekelwa okwengeziwe. Bheka Umthetho 204.

 AKUMELE uphonse noma yini emotweni, okuhlanganisa ukudla, ukupakishwa kokudla, iziphetho zikagwayi, amathini, amaphepha noma izikhwama zokuthwala. Lezi zinto zingabeka abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo engozini, ikakhulukazi abagibeli bezithuthuthu nabagibeli bamabhayisikili.

 Zama ukuqonda uma omunye umsebenzisi womgwaqo ebangela izinkinga, njengoba engase angabi nolwazi noma angajwayelene nendawo. Yiba nesineke futhi ukhumbule ukuthi noma ubani angenza iphutha.

 Ungacasuki noma uhileleke lapho othile eziphatha kabi emgwaqweni, njengoba lokhu kuzokwenza isimo sibe sibi kakhulu. Misa imoto, yehlisa umoya bese uqhubeka kuphela uma uzizwa ukhululekile.

 Uma umsebenzisi womgwaqo ephuma endleleni yakho endaweni yokuhlangana, yehlisa ijubane bese ubamba ukuze aphume. Ungasabeli ngokweqile ngokulandela eduze kakhulu ukuze umesabise.

 Umthetho: Isigaba se-EPA 87.

 Umthetho 148

 Ukugxila

 Ukushayela nokugibela ngokuphephile kudinga ukugxila. Gwema iziphazamiso ezifana nalezi:

 • umculo ophakeme, ongase uvale eminye imisindo
• ukuzama ukufunda amamephu
• ukuqala noma ukulungisa umculo noma umsakazo
• ukuphikisana nabagibeli noma abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo
• ukudla nokuphuza
• ukubhema.

 AKUMELE ubheme ezimotweni zokuthutha umphakathi noma ezimotweni ezisetshenziselwa umsebenzi ezimweni ezithile ezibekiwe. Imithetho ehlukile iyasebenza eNgilandi, eWales naseScotland.

 ENgilandi naseWales, umshayeli AKUMELE abheme noma avumele noma ubani ukuba abheme emotweni yangasese evalekile ethwele umuntu ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-18. Lokhu kufaka phakathi amakharavani ezimoto.

 EScotland, kuyicala kunoma ubani oneminyaka engu-18 noma ngaphezulu ukubhema emotweni yangasese lapho umuntu ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-18 ekhona futhi imoto isendaweni yomphakathi. Okuhlukile yilapho imoto ipakwe futhi isetshenziswa njengendawo yokuhlala.

 Imithetho: TSf(EV)R; TSfP(W)R; TPSCP(S)R; S-f(PV)R; S-f(W)R; kanye ne-SP(CIMV)(S)A.

 Omakhalekhukhwini kanye nobuchwepheshe obusemotweni

 Umthetho 149

 KUMELE usebenzise ukulawula imoto yakho kahle ngaso sonke isikhathi.

 AKUMELE usebenzise ifoni ephathekayo ephathwa ngesandla noma idivayisi efanayo ekwazi ukuxhumana okusebenzisanayo, njengethebhulethi, nganoma iyiphi injongo ngenkathi ushayela noma uqapha umshayeli ofundayo.

 Lo mthetho wokuvinjelwa uhlanganisa konke ukusetshenziswa kwedivayisi yokuxhumana ephathwa ngesandla, noma ngabe ikhono layo lokuxhumana elisebenzisanayo livaliwe noma alitholakali.

 AKUMELE:

 • thatha ifoni noma idivayisi efanayo ngenkathi ushayela ukuze ushayele inombolo bese uyibeka endaweni yokulala yengxoxo
• thatha futhi usebenzise ifoni ephathwa ngesandla noma idivayisi efanayo ngenkathi umile emgwaqweni.

 Ungashayela u-999 noma u-112 esimweni esiphuthumayo sangempela lapho ukuma kungaphephile noma kungenzeki.

 Ungasebenzisa ifoni ephathwa ngesandla noma idivayisi efanayo ukwenza inkokhelo engenakuthintana endaweni yokukhokha engenakuthintana uma:

 • imoto yakho imile
• izimpahla noma izinsizakalo zitholwa ngesikhathi esifanayo, noma ngemva kokukhokha.

 Ungalokothi usebenzise imakrofoni ephathwa ngesandla ngenkathi ushayela.

 Imishini engenazandla nayo ingakuphazamisa. Kuphephile kakhulu ukungasebenzisi ucingo noma idivayisi efanayo ngenkathi ushayela noma ugibele. Misa endaweni ephephile kuqala, noma usebenzise i-voicemail bese ulalela imiyalezo kamuva.

 Ungapaka usebenzisa uhlelo lokusebenza noma idivayisi elawulwa kude ephathwa ngesandla. Uhlelo lokusebenza noma idivayisi KUMELE kube semthethweni, futhi akufanele ubeka muntu engozini ngenkathi uyisebenzisa.

 Imithetho: Izigaba 2 no-3 ze-RTA 1988, kanye nemithethonqubo ye-CUR 104 no-110.

 Umthetho 150

 Izinhlelo ezingaphakathi kwezimoto

 Izinhlelo ezifana nokuzulazula kwesathelayithi, izixwayiso zokuminyana, amakhompyutha kanye nezinhlelo ze-multimedia zingaphazamisa abashayeli.

 KUMELE ulawule imoto yakho kahle ngaso sonke isikhathi.

 Ungathembeli ezinhlelweni zokusiza umshayeli ezifana nokusiza emgwaqweni omkhulu, izixwayiso zokuhamba emzileni noma ukupaka okulawulwa kude. Zinikeza usizo, kodwa akumelwe unciphise ukugxilisa ingqondo kwakho.

 Ungaphazanyiswa amamephu noma ulwazi lokuzulazula olusekelwe esikrinini noma lokuphatha imoto ngenkathi ushayela noma ugibela. Yima endaweni ephephile uma kudingeka.

 Uhlala unesibopho ngemoto ngenkathi usebenzisa uhlelo lokusiza umshayeli, okuhlanganisa nokusiza emgwaqweni omkhulu, noma uhlelo lokusebenza lokupaka olulawulwa kude oluphathwa ngesandla noma idivayisi. KUMELE ugcine ukulawula okugcwele kulezi zinhlelo ngaso sonke isikhathi.

 Imithetho: Izigaba 2 no-3 ze-RTA 1988, kanye nemithethonqubo ye-CUR 104 no-110.

 Umthetho 151

 Ithrafikhi ehamba kancane

 Kufanele:

 • nciphisa ibanga phakathi kwemoto yakho nemoto engaphambili ukuze ugcine ukuhamba kwezimoto
• ungalokothi ulandele eduze kangangokuthi awukwazi ukuma ngokuphepha
• shiya isikhala esanele sokuhamba uma imoto engaphambili iphuka noma imoto ephuthumayo idinga ukudlula
• ungashintshi uye emzileni ongakwesobunxele ukuze udlule
• vumela ukungena nokubuya emigwaqweni eseceleni, ngoba ukuyivimba kunezela ekuminyaneni
• vumela abahamba ngezinyawo nabahamba ngamabhayisikili ukuba bawele phambi kwakho
• qaphela abagibeli bamabhayisikili nabahamba ngamabhayisikili abadlula kuzo zombili izinhlangothi.

 Ukushayela ezindaweni ezakhiwe

 Umthetho 152

 Imigwaqo yokuhlala

 Shayela kancane nangokucophelela emigwaqweni lapho kungenzeka khona abahamba ngezinyawo, abahamba ngamabhayisikili nezimoto ezipakiwe. Umkhawulo wejubane eliphezulu ongu-20 mph (32 km/h) ungasebenza kwezinye izindawo.

 Qaphela:

 • izimoto eziphuma ezimpambanweni noma emigwaqweni yokungena
• izimoto ezihambayo
• zivula iminyango yezimoto
• abahamba ngezinyawo
• izingane ezigijima phakathi kwezimoto ezipakiwe
• abagibeli bamabhayisikili nabagibeli bamabhayisikili.

 Umthetho 153

 Izindlela zokuthula ithrafikhi

 Eminye imigwaqo inezimbobo zomgwaqo, ama-chicanes kanye nokuncipha okuhloswe ngakho ukunciphisa isivinini sethrafikhi.

 Uma usondela kulezi zici:

 • yehlisa isivinini sakho
• vumela abagibeli bamabhayisikili nabagibeli bamabhayisikili ukuba badlule
• gcina isivinini esincishisiwe kulo lonke isigaba esimbozwe izinyathelo zokuthula ithrafikhi
• nikeza indlela abasebenzisi bomgwaqo abazayo lapho izimpawu zikuqondisa ukuthi wenze kanjalo
• ungadluli abasebenzisi bomgwaqo abahambayo ngaphakathi kwalezi zindawo.

 Imigwaqo yasemaphandleni

 Umthetho 154

 Qaphela kakhulu emigwaqweni yasemaphandleni. Nciphisa isivinini sakho lapho usondela:

 • ukugoba, okungase kube bukhali kunalokho okubonakala ngakho
• izindawo zokuhlangana nokujika, okungase kufihlwe kancane
• amadolobhana.

 Lungela abahamba ngezinyawo, abagibeli bamahhashi, abagibeli bamabhayisikili, izimoto zasemapulazini ezihamba kancane kanye nodaka emgwaqweni. Qiniseka ukuthi ungama ngaphakathi kwebanga ongalibona licacile.

 Umthetho 155

 Imigwaqo yomzila owodwa

 Imigwaqo yomzila owodwa ibanzi ngokwanele imoto eyodwa kuphela futhi ingaba nezindawo ezikhethekile zokudlula.

 Uma imoto isondela kuwe, noma umshayeli ongemuva efuna ukukudlula:

 • donsela endaweni yokudlula ngakwesobunxele sakho
• linda ngaphesheya kwendawo yokudlula ngakwesokudla sakho.

 Nikeza abasebenzisi bomgwaqo indlela abahamba bekhuphuka intaba noma nini lapho kungenzeka. Uma kudingeka, buyela endaweni yokudlula ukuze uvumele enye imoto idlule.

 Yehlisa ijubane lapho udlula abahamba ngezinyawo, abagibeli bamabhayisikili nabagibeli bamahhashi.

 Umthetho 156

 Ungapaki ezindaweni zokudlula.

 Izimoto ezivinjelwe ukusebenzisa imigwaqo nezindawo zokupaka

Umthetho 157

 Ezinye izimoto ezinezimoto azihlangabezani nezidingo zokwakha nezobuchwepheshe zezimoto zomgwaqo. Ngokuvamile azihloselwe, azifaneleki noma azisemthethweni ukusetshenziswa emigwaqweni, ezindleleni zabahamba ngezinyawo, ezindleleni zabahamba ngezinyawo, ezindleleni zabahamba ngezinyawo, ezindleleni zabahamba ngamabhayisikili noma ezindleleni zamabhuloho.

 Lokhu kufaka phakathi izithuthuthu ezincane kakhulu, ezibizwa nangokuthi ama-mini moto, kanye nama-scooter anezimoto, abizwa nangokuthi ama-go-peds, asebenza ngezinjini zikagesi noma zangaphakathi.

 Lezi zimoto AKUMELE zisetshenziswe emigwaqweni, ezindleleni zabahamba ngezinyawo, ezindleleni zabahamba ngezinyawo noma ezindleleni zabahamba ngezinyawo.

 Imithetho: RTA 1988 izigaba 34, 41A, 42, 47, 63 kanye no-66; HA 1835 isigaba 72; kanye nesigaba R(S)A 129.

 Umthetho 158

 Izithuthuthu ezithile, amabhayisikili amathathu kanye namabhayisikili amane, abizwa nangokuthi amabhayisikili amane, enzelwe ukusetshenziswa ngaphandle komgwaqo kuphela futhi awahlangabezani nezindinganiso zomthetho zokusetshenziswa komgwaqo.

 Izimoto ezingahlangabezani nalezi zindinganiso AKUMELE zisetshenziswe emigwaqweni, ezindleleni zabahamba ngezinyawo, ezindleleni zabahamba ngezinyawo, ezindleleni zabahamba ngezinyawo noma ezindleleni zabahamba ngezinyawo.

 Ngaphambi kokusebenzisa noma yisiphi isithuthuthu, amabhayisikili amathathu, amabhayisikili amane noma enye imoto emgwaqweni, KUMELE uqinisekise ukuthi:

 • ihlangabezana nezindinganiso zomthetho
• ibhaliswe kahle
• ikhokhiswa intela
• inomshwalense.

 Ngisho noma imoto ibhalisiwe, ikhokhiswa intela futhi inomshwalense wokusetshenziswa emgwaqweni, AKUMELE isetshenziswe ezindleleni zokuhamba ngezinyawo.

 Imithetho: Izigaba 34, 41A, 42, 47, 63, 66 kanye no-156 ze-RTA 1988; isigaba 72 se-HA 1835; isigaba 129 se-R(S)A; kanye nezigaba 1 ze-VERA, 29, 31A kanye no-43A.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 9. Ukusebenzisa umgwaqo (159 kuya ku-203)
description:
Imithetho ejwayelekile (Imithetho 159 kuya ku-161)

 Umthetho 159

 Ngaphambi kokuhamba, kufanele:

 • usebenzise zonke izibuko ukuhlola ukuthi umgwaqo ucacile
• bheka nxazonke ukuhlola izindawo ongaboni kuzo, okuyizindawo ongakwazi ukuzibona ezibukweni
• uphawu uma kudingeka ngaphambi kokuhamba
• bheka nxazonke ukuhlola kokugcina.

 Suka kuphela uma kuphephile.

 Umthetho 160

 Uma usuhamba, kufanele:

 • hlala ngakwesobunxele ngaphandle kokuthi izimpawu zomgwaqo noma izimpawu zibonisa okuhlukile. Kusebenza okuhlukile lapho udlula, ujika kwesokudla, noma udlula izimoto ezipakiwe noma abahamba ngezinyawo emgwaqweni
• hlala kahle ngakwesobunxele emajikeni kwesokudla. Lokhu kuthuthukisa umbono wakho ngomgwaqo futhi kusiza ukuvimbela ukushayisana kwezimoto ezisondela zisuka kolunye uhlangothi
 • shayela noma ugibele ngezandla zombili esiteringini noma ezibambweni lapho kungenzeka khona, kukusiza ukuthi ugcine ukulawula okugcwele ngaso sonke isikhathi
 • sebenzisa izinhlelo zokusiza umshayeli kuphela ngokwemiyalelo yomkhiqizi
 • hlala uqaphele abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo, ikakhulukazi abagibeli bamabhayisikili nabagibeli bamabhayisikili abahlunga izimoto. Kunzima ukuzibona kunezimoto ezinkulu, futhi abagibeli bazo basengozini enkulu
 • nikeza abagibeli bamabhayisikili nabagibeli bamabhayisikili indawo eyanele, ikakhulukazi lapho ushayela imoto ende noma udonsa i-trailer
 • nika abagibeli bamabhayisikili indawo lapho beshintsha indlela noma umzila futhi ungabanqamuli
 • khetha igiya eliphansi ngaphambi kokufinyelela ethambekeni elide lokwehla ukuze usize ukulawula isivinini sakho
 • khumbula lapho udonsa ukuthi ubude obengeziwe buthinta ukudlula nokuqondisa, kuyilapho isisindo esengeziwe sithinta ukubhuleka nokusheshisa.

 Umthetho 161

 Izibuko

 Sebenzisa zonke izibuko ngempumelelo kulo lonke uhambo lwakho. Kufanele:

 • Sebenzisa izibuko zakho njalo ukuze uhlale wazi ukuthi yini engemuva kwakho nasohlangothini ngalunye
• Zisebenzise ngesikhathi esifanele ngaphambi kokubonisa noma ukushintsha indlela noma isivinini
• Khumbula ukuthi izibuko azibonisi yonke indawo nokuthi amabala angabonisi ahlala
• bheka nxazonke bese uhlola amabala angabonisi uma kudingeka.

 Khumbula: Izibuko – Isibonakaliso – Ukuqondisa.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 9. Ukusebenzisa umgwaqo (159 kuya ku-203)
description:
Ukudlula (Imithetho 162 kuya ku-169)

 Umthetho 162

 Ngaphambi kokudlula, qiniseka ukuthi:

 • umgwaqo ongaphambili ucacile ngokwanele
• abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo abaqali ukukudlula
• kukhona isikhala esifanele phambi komsebenzisi womgwaqo ohlose ukumdlula.

 Umthetho 163

 Ukudlula kuphela uma kuphephile futhi kusemthethweni. Kufanele:

 • ungasondeli kakhulu emotweni ohlose ukuyidlula
• sebenzisa izibuko zakho, uphawule uma kuphephile, bheka ngokushesha eceleni endaweni engaboni uma kudingeka bese uqala ukuphuma
• ungacabangi ukuthi ungalandela imoto engaphambili edlulayo, njengoba kungase kube nendawo yemoto eyodwa kuphela
• uma usuqala ukudlula, dlula ngokushesha ngenkathi uvumela isikhala esiningi
• buyela kwesobunxele ngokushesha okukhulu ngaphandle kokuphazamisa
• qaphela kakhulu ebusuku futhi ungabonakali kahle, lapho ukwahlulela isivinini nebanga kunzima
• vumela izimoto ezizayo ngaphambi kokudlula izimoto ezipakiwe noma ezinye izithiyo ohlangothini lwakho
• dlula ngakwesobunxele kuphela uma imoto engaphambili ikhombisa ukuthi kufanele ujike kwesokudla futhi kukhona indawo
• hlala emzileni wakho lapho ithrafikhi ihamba kancane emigqeni. Uma umugqa ongakwesokudla sakho uhamba kancane, ungadlula ngakwesobunxele.

 Abagibeli bamabhayisikili bangadlula ithrafikhi ehamba kancane noma engami nhlangothi zombili. Kufanele baqhubeke ngokuqapha ngoba abashayeli bangase bangababoni, ikakhulukazi eduze kwezindawo zokuhlangana kanye nalapho bedlula amaloli noma ezinye izimoto ezinkulu.

 Nikeza abagibeli bamabhayisikili, abagibeli bamabhayisikili, abagibeli bamahhashi kanye nezimoto ezidonswa amahhashi okungenani isikhala esingangemoto.

 Njengesiqondiso:

 • shiya okungenani amamitha angu-1.5 uma udlula abagibeli bamabhayisikili ngesivinini esifinyelela ku-30 mph, futhi uvumele isikhala esengeziwe ngesivinini esiphezulu
• dlula abagibeli bamahhashi nezimoto ezidonswa amahhashi ngaphansi kwe-10 mph bese ushiya okungenani amamitha amabili
• shiya okungenani amamitha amabili futhi ugcine isivinini esiphansi uma udlula umuntu ohamba ngezinyawo emgwaqweni, njengalapho kungekho khona indlela yokuhamba ngezinyawo
• qaphela kakhulu futhi uvumele isikhala esengeziwe uma udlula abagibeli bamabhayisikili, abagibeli bamabhayisikili, abagibeli bamahhashi, izimoto ezidonswa amahhashi noma abahamba ngezinyawo esimweni sezulu esibi, okuhlanganisa imimoya enamandla, kanye nasebusuku.

 Linda ngemuva futhi ungamdluli umshayeli wesithuthuthu, umgibeli webhayisikili, umgibeli wehhashi, imoto edonswa amahhashi noma abahamba ngezinyawo uma ukudlula kungaphephile noma izindawo ezidingekayo zingenakufinyelelwa.

 Khumbula: Izibuko – Isignali – Ukuqondisa.

 Umthetho 164

 Izimoto ezinkulu

 Ukudlula izimoto ezinkulu kunzima kakhulu. Kufanele:

 • wehle ukuze uthuthukise umbono wakho phambili futhi uvumele umshayeli wemoto enkulu ukuthi akubone ezibukweni zakhe
• khumbula ukuthi ukulandela izimoto ezinkulu eduze kakhulu, okuhlanganisa izimoto zezolimo ezifana namatrakta anama-trailer noma imishini eqinile, kufihla umbono wakho futhi kungase kufihle enye imoto ehamba kancane phambili
• qinisekisa ukuthi unendawo eyanele yokuqedela ukuqondisa ngaphambi kokuthatha isinyathelo, njengoba ukudlula imoto enkulu kuthatha isikhathi eside
• ungadluli uma ungabaza
• ungacabangi ukuthi ungalandela imoto edlula imoto ende, ngoba ingase ishiye ukuqondisa bese ibuyela emuva.

 Umthetho 165

 AKUMELE udlule:

 • uma kungadingeka uwele noma ugibele imigqa emibili emhlophe enomugqa oqinile oseduze nawe, kuncike ezintweni ezihlukile kuMthetho 129
• uma kungadingeka ungene endaweni yokuhlukanisa izimoto ezungezwe umugqa omhlophe oqinile
• imoto eseduze nendawo yokuwela yabahamba ngezinyawo, ikakhulukazi uma ime yabahamba ngezinyawo
• uma kungadingeka ungene emzileni obekelwe amabhasi, ama-tram noma amabhayisikili ngesikhathi sokusebenza kwawo
• ngemva kophawu oluthi ‘Akukho ukudlula’ futhi ngaphambi kokuba uphawu lukhansele umkhawulo.

 Imithetho: Isigaba 36 se-RTA sika-1988 kanye ne-TSRGD Isheduli 1; Isheduli 9, Ingxenye 7; kanye neSheduli 14, Ingxenye 1.

 Umthetho 166

 UNGADLULI uma ungabaza noma ungakwazi ukubona kude ngokwanele ukuze wazi ukuthi kuphephile, okuhlanganisa nalapho usondela:

 • ikhona noma ukugoba
• ibhuloho eligobile
• ibunzi legquma.

 Umthetho 167

 UNGAYIDELI indawo lapho lokhu kungakufaka khona engqubuzweni nomunye umsebenzisi womgwaqo, okuhlanganisa:

 • lapho usondela noma endaweni yokuhlangana komgwaqo ohlangothini ngalunye lomgwaqo
• lapho umgwaqo uncipha khona
• lapho usondela endaweni yokuwela isikole
• lapho usondela ezindaweni zokuwela
• lapho imoto engaphambili yehlisa ukuma komuntu owela ngezinyawo esuka esiqhingini sabahamba ngezinyawo — bheka uMthetho 165
• phakathi komgwaqo onqenqemeni nebhasi noma i-tram esitobhini
• lapho ithrafikhi imile khona ezindaweni zokuhlangana noma emsebenzini womgwaqo
• lapho ungaphoqa omunye umsebenzisi womgwaqo ukuba aphambuke noma ehlise ijubane
• lapho ukuwela okulinganayo
• uma umsebenzisi womgwaqo ekhomba ngakwesokudla, noma ngabe ucabanga ukuthi isignali bekufanele ikhanselwe. Linda kuze kube yilapho ikhanselwe
• uma ulandela umgibeli webhayisikili esondela endaweni ezungezile noma ehlanganayo futhi uhlose ukujika ngakwesobunxele. Hlala ngemuva futhi unganqamuli abagibeli bebhayisikili abahamba phambili, okuhlanganisa nalabo abasebenzisa imizila yamabhayisikili noma imizila — bheka uMthetho H3
• uma ulandela umgibeli wehhashi noma imoto edonswa yihhashi esondela endaweni ezungezile noma ehlanganayo futhi uhlose ukujika ngakwesobunxele. Hlala ngemuva futhi unganqamuli kubo
• uma i-tram imi endaweni yokuma ye-tram eceleni komgwaqo futhi kungekho ndlela edlulayo ephawulwe ngokucacile.

 Umthetho 168

 Ukunqotshwa

 Uma omunye umshayeli ekudlula:

 • gcina indlela ezinzile nesivinini
• yehlisa ijubane uma kudingeka ukuze imoto idlule
• ungalokothi uvimbele umshayeli ofisa ukudlula
• ungasheshisi noma ushayele ngendlela engalindelekile, njengoba lokhu kuyingozi.

 Uma othile edlula futhi engena esikhaleni esiphambi kwakho, yehla ukuze ubuyisele igebe elilandela imizuzwana emibili.

 Umthetho 169

 Ungabambeli umugqa omude wethrafikhi, ikakhulukazi uma ushayela imoto enkulu noma ehamba kancane.

 Hlola izibuko zakho njalo futhi, uma kudingeka, ngena endaweni ephephile ukuze uvumele ithrafikhi idlule.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 9. Ukusebenzisa umgwaqo (159 kuya ku-203)
description:
Izindawo zokuhlangana kwemigwaqo (Imithetho 170 kuya ku-183)

 Umthetho 170

 Qaphela kakhulu izindawo zokuhlangana. Kufanele:

 • qaphela abagibeli bamabhayisikili, abagibeli bamabhayisikili, abahamba ngezinyawo kanye nabasebenzisi be-wheelchair noma i-mobility scooter abasebenzisa i-wheelchair noma i-mobility scooter, njengoba kungase kube nzima ukukubona futhi kungenzeka ukuthi abakubonanga noma abakuzwanga usondela ngemuva
• vumela abahamba ngezinyawo abawela noma abalinde ukuwela umgwaqo ojika kuwo noma osuka kuwo. Abahamba ngezinyawo asebeqalile ukuwela babaluleke kakhulu — bheka uMthetho H2
• hlala ngemuva kwabagibeli bamabhayisikili, abagibeli bamahhashi, izimoto ezidonswa amahhashi kanye nabagibeli bamabhayisikili ezindaweni zokuhlangana, noma ngabe balinde ukujika futhi baseduze nomngcele
• qaphela izimoto ezinde ezijika phambili, njengoba zingadinga ububanzi bonke bomgwaqo — bheka uMthetho 221
• qaphela abagibeli bamahhashi, abangase bathathe indawo ehlukile yomgwaqo kulowo owulindele
• ungacabangi ukuthi imoto esondela ngakwesokudla bese ikhomba kwesobunxele izojika; linda futhi uqiniseke ukuthi
• bheka nxazonke ngaphambi kokuvela
• ungaweli noma ujoyine umgwaqo kuze kube yilapho kunesikhala esikhulu ngokwanele ukwenza kanjalo ngokuphephile.

 Umthetho 171

 KUMELE ume ngemuva komugqa endaweni yokuhlangana nophawu oluthi `Yima` kanye nomugqa omhlophe oqinile ngaphesheya komgwaqo. Linda isikhala esiphephile emotweni ngaphambi kokuhamba.

 Imithetho: RTA 1988 isigaba 36 kanye ne-TSRGD Isheduli 9, Izingxenye 7 no-8.

 Umthetho 172

 Indlela eya endaweni yokuhlangana ingaba nophawu oluthi `Give Way` noma unxantathu ophawulwe emgwaqweni.

 KUMELE uvumele ithrafikhi emgwaqweni omkhulu lapho uphuma endaweni yokuhlangana enemigqa emhlophe ephukile ngaphesheya komgwaqo.

 Imithetho: Isigaba 36 se-RTA sika-1988 kanye neShejuli 9 ye-TSRGD, Izingxenye 7 no-8.

 Umthetho 173

 Imigwaqo emibili

 Uma uwela umgwaqo wezimoto ezimbili noma ujika kwesokudla, qala uhlole ukuthi ukubhukha okuphakathi kujule ngokwanele yini ukuvikela ubude obugcwele bemoto yakho.

 Uma kujule ngokwanele, phatha ingxenye ngayinye yomgwaqo wezimoto njengomgwaqo ohlukile. Linda ekubhukheni okuphakathi kuze kube yilapho kukhona igebe eliphephile emotweni engxenyeni yesibili.

 Uma ukubhukha okuphakathi kujule kakhulu emotweni yakho, linda uze ukwazi ukuwela yomibili imizila yezimoto ngokunyakaza okukodwa.

 Umthetho 174

 Iziphambano zamabhokisi

 Iziphambano zamabhokisi zinemigqa ephuzi ecwebezelayo edwetshwe emgwaqweni.

 AKUMELE ungene endaweni yokuhlangana kwebhokisi kuze kube yilapho umgwaqo wakho wokuphuma noma umzila usucacile.

 Ungangena futhi ulinde ebhokisini lapho ujika kwesokudla uma uvinjelwa ukuqeda ukujika kuphela ngokuthi:

 • ithrafikhi ezayo
• ezinye izimoto ezilinde ukujika kwesokudla.

 Endaweni yokujikeleza elawulwa yisignali, AKUMELE ungene ebhokisini ngaphandle kokuthi ungakwazi ukuliwela ngokuphelele ngaphandle kokuma.

 Umthetho: I-TSRGD Isheduli 9, Izingxenye 7 no-8.

 Izindawo zokuhlangana ezilawulwa yizibani zomgwaqo

 Umthetho 175

 KUMELE ume ngemuva komugqa wokuma omhlophe ngaphesheya komgwaqo ngaphandle kokuthi isibani sethrafikhi siluhlaza.

 Uma kuvela isibani esiphuzi, ungaqhubeka kuphela uma usuvele uwele umugqa wokuma noma useduze kakhulu kangangokuthi ukuma kungabangela ukushayisana.

 Imithetho: Isigaba 36 se-RTA sika-1988 kanye neShejuli 14 le-TSRGD, Izingxenye 1 kanye no-4.

 Umthetho 176

 AKUMELE uqhubekele phambili phezu komugqa omhlophe ngenkathi isibani esibomvu sibonisa.

 Uma isibani siluhlaza, qhubeka kuphela uma kunendawo eyanele yokusula indawo ehlanganayo ngokuphephile noma uthatha indawo yokujika kwesokudla.

 Uma amarobhothi engasebenzi, phatha indawo ehlanganayo njengengaphawuliwe bese uqhubeka ngokucophelela okukhulu.

 Imithetho: Isigaba 36 se-RTA sika-1988 kanye neShejuli 14 le-TSRGD, Izingxenye 1 kanye no-4.

 Umthetho 177

 Imicibisholo yesihlungi esiluhlaza

 Umcibisholo wesihlungi esiluhlaza usebenza kuphela emzileni wawo wesihlungi. Ungangeni kulowo mzila ngaphandle kokuthi uhlose ukuhamba ngendlela yomcibisholo.

 Ungaqhubeka ngendlela yomcibisholo lapho umcibisholo oluhlaza noma ukukhanya okuluhlaza okugcwele kukhombisa.

 Nikeza abanye abantu abahamba ngezimoto, ikakhulukazi abagibeli bamabhayisikili, isikhathi esanele nendawo yokungena endleleni efanele.

 Umthetho 178

 Imigqa yokuma ethuthukisiwe

 Ezinye izindawo zokuhlangana ezilawulwa yisignali zinemigqa yokuma ethuthukisiwe evumela abagibeli bamabhayisikili ukuba balinde ngaphambi kwezinye izimoto.

 Abashayeli bezimoto, okuhlanganisa nabagibeli bamabhayisikili, KUMELE bame emgqeni wokuqala omhlophe abawufinyelelayo lapho izibani ziphuzi noma zibomvu.

 Ngezinye izikhathi, gwema ukuvimba ukufinyelela noma ukungena endaweni ephawuliwe yabahamba ngezimoto, okuhlanganisa nalapho indawo yokuhlangana engaphambili ivaliwe.

 Uma imoto yakho isiwele umugqa wokuqala omhlophe lapho isignali ishintsha ibe bomvu, yima ngokushesha okukhulu futhi KUMELE ime emgqeni wesibili omhlophe.

 Uma isignali eluhlaza ivela, nikeza abagibeli bamabhayisikili, okuhlanganisa nalabo abahambayo noma abalinde eceleni kwakho, isikhathi esanele nendawo yokuhamba.

 Abashayeli bezimoto ezinkulu kufanele bame kude ngokwanele ngemuva komugqa wokuqala omhlophe ukuze babone yonke indawo lapho abagibeli bamabhayisikili bengase balinde khona, okuvumela indawo engaboni phambi kwemoto.

 Imithetho: RTA 1988 isigaba 36 kanye ne-TSRGD Isheduli 14, Ingxenye 1.

 Ukujika kwesokudla

 Umthetho 179

 Ngaphambi kokujika kwesokudla, kufanele:

 • sebenzisa izibuko zakho ukuhlola indawo kanye nokuhamba kwethrafikhi ngemuva
• uphawu kwesokudla
• beka imoto yakho ngakwesobunxele sendawo ephakathi nomgwaqo noma endaweni ephawulwe ngakwesokudla
• shiya isikhala sokuba ezinye izimoto zidlule ngakwesobunxele lapho kungenzeka khona.

 Umthetho 180

 Lindela isikhala esiphephile emotweni ezayo. Qaphela abagibeli bamabhayisikili, abagibeli bamabhayisikili, abahamba ngezinyawo nabanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo.

 Hlola izibuko zakho nendawo engaboni futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi awufinyelelwa, bese ujika. Ungasiki ekhoneni.

 Qaphela kakhulu lapho ujika ungena emgwaqweni omkhulu. Qaphela ithrafikhi kuzo zombili izinhlangothi bese ulinda isikhala esiphephile.

 Khumbula: Izibuko – Isignali – Ukuhamba.

 Umthetho 181

 Uma wena nemoto ezayo nobabili nijika kwesokudla ezimpambanweni zemigwaqo, kunezindlela ezimbili:

 • ohlangothini lwesokudla kuya kwesokudla — gcina enye imoto ngakwesokudla sakho bese ujika ngemuva kwayo. Lokhu ngokuvamile kuphephile ngoba unombono ocacile wethrafikhi esondelayo lapho uqedela ukujika
• ohlangothini lwesobunxele kuya ohlangothini lwesobunxele — jika phambi komunye nomunye. Lokhu kungakuvimbela ukubona izimoto ezizayo, ikakhulukazi abagibeli bamabhayisikili nabagibeli bamabhayisikili, ngakho-ke qaphela kakhulu.

 Ukuhlelwa komgwaqo, izimpawu zomgwaqo noma indawo yenye imoto kunganquma ukuthi iyiphi indlela okufanele uyisebenzise.

 Ukujika kwesobunxele

 Umthetho 182

 Ngaphambi kokujika kwesobunxele:

 • sebenzisa izibuko zakho
• nika uphawu kwesokunxele ngaphambi kwesikhathi sokujika
• ungadluli ngokushesha ngaphambi kokujika
• qaphela ithrafikhi esondela kwesobunxele sakho, ikakhulukazi lapho ushayela imoto enkulu.

 Abagibeli bamabhayisikili, abagibeli bamabhayisikili nabanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo bangase bacashe ekubonweni.

 Umthetho 183

 Uma ujika:

 • hlala eduze kwesobunxele ngangokunokwenzeka futhi kuphephile
• nikeza indlela izimoto ezisebenzisa umzila wamabhasi, umzila wamabhayisikili, umzila wamabhayisikili noma i-tramway kusuka kunoma iyiphi indlela, kufaka phakathi izimoto ezidlula ithrafikhi engami noma ehamba kancane kunoma iyiphi indlela.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 9. Ukusebenzisa umgwaqo (159 kuya ku-203)
description:
Ama-Roundingout (Imithetho 184 kuya ku-190)

 Umthetho 184

 Uma usondela endaweni ezungezile, qaphela futhi wenze konke okutholakele, okuhlanganisa izimpawu zomgwaqo, izibani zomgwaqo kanye nezimpawu zomgwaqo ezikuqondisa emzileni ofanele.

 Kufanele:

 • usebenzise izibuko - isibonakaliso - ukuhamba kuyo yonke indawo
• unqume kusenesikhathi ukuthi iyiphi indlela yokuphuma oyidingayo
• unikeze isignali efanele - bheka uMthetho 186
• ubeke isikhathi sezimpawu zakho ukuze zingadideki abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo
• faka indlela efanele
• lungisa isivinini sakho nendawo ukuze ivumelane nezimo zethrafikhi
• uhlale wazi ngesivinini nendawo yabo bonke abasebenzisi bomgwaqo abakuzungezile.
Umthetho 185

 Uma ufika endaweni ezungezile, kufanele:

 • beka phambili ithrafikhi esondela ngakwesokudla ngaphandle kokuthi izimpawu, izimpawu zomgwaqo noma izibani zomgwaqo ziqondisa ngenye indlela
• hlola ukuthi izimpawu zomgwaqo zikuvumela yini ukuthi ungene ngaphandle kokuvumela indlela; uma zikwenza, qhubeka kodwa ubheke kahle ngaphambi kokujoyina
• qaphela wonke umsebenzisi womgwaqo osevele esemjikelezweni, ukhumbule ukuthi angase abonise izimpawu ezingalungile noma angabonisi izimpawu
• bheka phambili ngaphambi kokuhamba ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ithrafikhi engaphambili ihambile.

 Umthetho 186

 Izimpawu kanye nendawo

 Uma uthatha indlela yokuqala yokuphuma ngakwesobunxele, ngaphandle kokuthi izimpawu noma izimpawu zibonisa okunye:

 • bonisa kwesobunxele bese usondela emzileni wesobunxele
• hlala kwesobunxele emjikelezweni
• qhubeka ubonisa kwesobunxele ngenkathi uhamba.

 Uma uthatha indlela yokuphuma ngakwesokudla noma uhamba ngokugcwele emjikelezweni, ngaphandle kokuthi izimpawu noma izimpawu zibonisa okunye:

 • bonisa kwesokudla bese usondela emzileni ongakwesokudla
 • hlala ngakwesokudla ku-roundabout uze udinge ukushintsha imizila yokuphuma kwakho
 • bonisa kwesokunxele ngemva kokudlula indlela yokuphuma ngaphambi kwaleyo ohlose ukuyithatha.

 Uma uthatha indlela yokuphuma ephakathi, ngaphandle kokuthi izimpawu noma izimpawu zibonisa okuhlukile:

 • khetha indlela efanele lapho usondela
 • akufanele udinge ngokuvamile ukubonisa ngenkathi usondela
 • hlala kuleyo ndlela uze udinge ukushintsha indlela uye ekuphumeni
 • bonisa kwesokunxele ngemva kokudlula indlela yokuphuma ngaphambi kwaleyo ohlose ukuyithatha.

 Uma kunemizila engaphezu kwemithathu emnyango we-roundabout, sebenzisa indlela efanele kakhulu lapho usondela futhi udlule ku-roundabout.

 Nikeza kuqala abagibeli bamabhayisikili ku-roundabout. Bahamba kancane kakhulu kunezimoto ezihamba ngezimoto. Banike isikhala esiningi futhi ungazami ukubadlula ngaphakathi komzila wabo. Vumela abagibeli bamabhayisikili ukuthi badlule endleleni yakho njengoba behamba bezungeza umjikelezo.

 Abagibeli bamabhayisikili, abagibeli bamahhashi kanye nezimoto ezidonswa amahhashi zingase zihlale emzileni wesobunxele lapho ziqhubeka zidlula noma zizungeze umjikelezo. Kufanele zibonise ngakwesokudla ukukhombisa ukuthi azihambi.

 Uma ungena kumjikelezo, qaphela kakhulu ukuthi ungadluli abagibeli bamabhayisikili, abagibeli bamahhashi noma izimoto ezidonswa amahhashi eziqhubeka zizungeza emzileni wesobunxele.

 Umthetho 187

 Kuzo zonke izimo, qaphela futhi unikeze isikhala esanele:

 • abahamba ngezinyawo bewela besondela futhi bephuma emigwaqweni
• ithrafikhi ewela phambi kwakho kumjikelezo, ikakhulukazi izimoto ezihlose ukuhamba ekuphumeni okulandelayo
• ithrafikhi ehamba ngemizila noma ebekwe ngendlela engafanele
• abagibeli bamabhayisikili
• izimoto ezinde, okuhlanganisa nezimoto ezidonsa ama-trailer.

 Ngenxa yobude bazo, izimoto ezinde zingadinga ukuthatha indlela ehlukile noma zihambe ngemizila ehlukene ngenkathi zisondela noma zihamba zizungeza i-roundabout. Qaphela izimpawu zazo.

 Umthetho 188

 Ama-mini-roundabout

 Sondela kuma-mini-roundabout ngendlela efanayo nama-roundabout avamile.

 Zonke izimoto KUMELE zihambe zizungeza izimpawu eziphakathi, ngaphandle kwezimoto ezinkulu ezingakwazi ukwenza kanjalo ngokomzimba.

 Khumbula ukuthi kunendawo encane yokuqondisa kanye nesikhathi esincane sokukhombisa ku-mini-roundabout.

 Gwema ukwenza ama-U-turn kuma-mini-roundabout futhi uqaphele abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo abenza kanjalo.

 Imithetho: RTA 1988 isigaba 36 kanye ne-TSRGD Isheduli 9, Izingxenye 7 no-8.

 Umthetho 189

 Ama-mini-roundabout amabili

 Phatha i-roundabout ngayinye ngokwehlukana bese unikeza indlela ithrafikhi esondela ngakwesokudla.

 Umthetho 190

 Ama-roundabout amaningi

 Kwezinye izindawo eziyinkimbinkimbi, kungase kube nochungechunge lwama-mini-roundabout endaweni ngayinye yokuhlangana. Phatha i-mini-roundabout ngayinye ngokwehlukana bese ulandela imithetho evamile.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 9. Ukusebenzisa umgwaqo (159 kuya ku-203)
description:
Izindawo zokuwela abahamba ngezinyawo (Imithetho 191 kuya ku-199)

 Umthetho 191

 AKUMELE:

 • paka endaweni yokuwela
• paka endaweni embozwe yimigqa egobile
• dlula imoto ehambayo eseduze nendawo yokuwela
• dlula imoto eseduze nendawo yokuwela lapho isimile ukuze inike abahamba ngezinyawo indlela.

 Imithetho: Isigaba 25(5) se-RTRA kanye neShejuli 14 ye-TSRGD, Izingxenye 1 no-5.

 Umthetho 192

 Ezimotweni ezihamba kancane noma ezilandelanayo, gcina izindawo zokuwela zicacile ngokuphelele. Ukuvimba indawo yokuwela kwenza kube nzima futhi kube yingozi ngabahamba ngezinyawo ukuwela.

 Ungangeni endaweni yokuwela abahamba ngezinyawo ngaphandle kokuthi ungakwazi ukuyihlanza ngokuphelele. Ungavimbi imigqa yokuma ethuthukisiwe yabagibele amabhayisikili.

 Umthetho 193

 Qaphela kakhulu lapho umi emgqeni wezimoto noma izimoto ezipakwe ngendlela engafanele zikuvimbela ukubona kwakho uhlangothi ngalunye lwendlela yokuwela. Abahamba ngezinyawo bangase bawele phakathi kwezimoto ezimile.

 Umthetho 194

 Nikeza abahamba ngezinyawo isikhathi esanele sokuwela. Ungabahlukumezi ngokuvuselela injini yakho noma ukuqhubekela phambili.

 Umthetho 195

 I-Zebra kanye nezindlela zokuwela ezihambisanayo

 Uma usondela endaweni yokuwela i-zebra:

 • qaphela abahamba ngezinyawo abalinde ukuwela futhi ulungele ukwehlisa ijubane noma ukuma
• kufanele unikeze abahamba ngezinyawo ithuba abalinde ukuwela
• KUMELE unikezele lapho umuntu ohamba ngezinyawo esengene endaweni yokuwela
• vumela isikhathi esengeziwe sokuma emigwaqweni emanzi noma ebandayo
• unganiki uphawu, ungabaniki izibani zakho zangaphambili noma ushaye uphondo lwakho ukuze umeme abahamba ngezinyawo ukuba bawele, njengoba kungase kube khona enye imoto esondelayo
 • yiba nesineke futhi ungakhali uphondo lwakho noma ushaye injini yakho, njengoba lokhu kungaba yinto esabekayo
 • qaphela abahamba ngezinyawo abasondela eceleni.

 Indawo yokuwela i-zebra enesiqhingi esiphakathi inezindawo ezimbili zokuwela ezihlukene. Bheka Imithetho 19 no-20.

 Izindawo zokuwela ezihambisanayo zifana nezindawo zokuwela i-zebra kodwa zifaka umzila webhayisikili eceleni kwemigqa emnyama nomhlophe.

 Uma usondela endaweni yokuwela ehambisanayo:

 • qaphela abahamba ngezinyawo noma abagibeli bamabhayisikili abalinde ukuwela bese wehlisa ijubane noma ume
• kufanele unike abahamba ngezinyawo noma abagibeli bamabhayisikili abalinde ukuwela
• KUMELE uvumele lapho umuntu ohamba ngezinyawo noma ohamba ngebhayisikili esengene endaweni yokuwela
 • vumela isikhathi esengeziwe sokuma emigwaqweni emanzi noma ebandayo
• ungaphazamisi, ukhanyise izibani zakho zangaphambili noma ushayele uphondo lwakho ukuze umeme abahamba ngezinyawo noma abagibeli bamabhayisikili ukuthi bawele, njengoba kungase kube nenye imoto esondelayo
 • yiba nesineke futhi ungakhali uphondo lwakho noma ushayele injini yakho, njengoba lokhu kungaba yinto esabekayo
 • qaphela abahamba ngezinyawo noma abagibeli bamabhayisikili abasondela eceleni.

 Ukuwela okulinganayo nesiqhingi esiphakathi kuqukethe izindawo ezimbili zokuwela ezihlukene. Bheka Imithetho 19 no-20.

 Umthetho: TSRGD Ishejuli 14, Ingxenye 5.

 Ukuwela okulawulwa yisignali

 Umthetho 196

 Ukuwela kwe-Pelican

 Ukuwela kwe-Pelican yizindawo zokuwela ezilawulwa yisignali lapho i-amber ekhanyayo ilandela khona isibani sokuma esibomvu.

 KUMELE ume lapho isibani esibomvu sibonakala.

 Uma isibani esiphuzi sikhanya, KUMELE unike abahambi indlela lapho bewela khona. Uma isibani esiphuzi sikhanya futhi kungekho bahambi ngezinyawo lapho bewela khona, ungaqhubeka ngokucophelela.

 Imithetho: Umthethonqubo we-TSRGD 14 kanye nesigaba 25(5 se-RTRA).

 Umthetho 197

 Indawo yokuwela i-pelican egijima ngqo ngaphesheya komgwaqo iyindlela eyodwa yokuwela, noma ngabe inesiqhingi esiphakathi.

 KUMELE ulinde abahambi ngezinyawo bewela bevela kolunye uhlangothi lwesiqhingi.

 Umthetho: Umthethonqubo we-TSRGD 14.

 Umthetho 198

 Nikeza noma ubani osawela ngemuva kokuba isignali yemoto ishintshe ibe luhlaza. Lokhu kusebenza kuzo zonke izindawo zokuwela.

 Umthetho 199

 Ukuwela i-Toucan, i-puffin kanye ne-equestrian

 Lezi ziphambano zifana nokuwela i-pelican, kodwa azinawo umugqa okhanyayo ophuzi. Ukulandelana kwazo kokukhanya kwethrafikhi kufana nokwasezibanini zomgwaqo ezivamile.

 Uma ukuwela okulawulwa yisignali kungasebenzi, qhubeka ngokucophelela okukhulu.

 Ungangeni endaweni yokuwela ngaphandle kokuthi ungayisusa ngokuphelele, ukuze ungavimbeli abahamba ngezinyawo, abagibeli bamabhayisikili noma abagibeli bamahhashi.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 9. Ukusebenzisa umgwaqo (159 kuya ku-203)
description:
Ukubuyela emuva (Imithetho 200 kuya ku-203)

 Umthetho 200

 Khetha indawo efanele yokuqondisa.

 Uma udinga ukujika imoto yakho, linda uze uthole indawo ephephile. Zama ukungabuyeli emuva noma ukujika emgwaqweni omatasa. Esikhundleni salokho, thola umgwaqo oseceleni othule noma ushayele uzungeze ibhulokhi yemigwaqo eseceleni.

 Umthetho 201

 Ungabuyeli emuva usuka emgwaqweni oseceleni uye emgwaqweni omkhulu.

 Uma usebenzisa i-driveway, buyela emuva ungene kuyo bese ushayela uphume uma kungenzeka.

 Umthetho 202

 Bheka ngokucophelela ngaphambi kokuthi uqale ukubuyela emuva. Kufanele:

 • usebenzise zonke izibuko zakho
• hlola indawo engaboni kahle ngemuva kwakho, okuyingxenye yomgwaqo engabonakali kalula ezibukweni
• hlola ukuthi abekho abahamba ngezinyawo, ikakhulukazi izingane, abagibeli bamabhayisikili, abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo noma izithiyo ngemuva kwakho.

 Hlehla kancane ngenkathi:

 • uhlola yonke indawo
• ubheka kakhulu ngefasitela elingemuva
• ukhumbula ukuthi ingaphambili lemoto yakho lizophuma njengoba ujika.

 Cela othile ukuthi akuqondise uma ungakwazi ukubona kahle.

 Umthetho 203

 AKUMELE ubuyisele imoto yakho emuva kakhulu kunalokho okudingekayo.

 Umthetho: Umthethonqubo we-CUR 106.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 10. Abasebenzisi bomgwaqo abadinga ukunakekelwa okwengeziwe (204 kuya ku-225)
description:
Isifinyezo (Umthetho 204)

 Abasebenzisi bomgwaqo abasengozini enkulu yomgwaqo yilaba:

 • abahamba ngezinyawo, ikakhulukazi izingane, abantu abadala kanye nabantu abakhubazekile
• abagibeli bamabhayisikili
• abagibeli bamahhashi
• abagibeli bezithuthuthu.

 Kubaluleke kakhulu ukuqaphela:

 • izingane
• abantu abadala
• abantu abakhubazekile
• abashayeli nabafundi abangenalwazi kanye nabagibeli.

 Kunoma yikuphi ukuxhumana phakathi kwabasebenzisi bomgwaqo, labo abakwaziyo ukudala umonakalo omkhulu banomthwalo wemfanelo omkhulu wokunciphisa ingozi noma usongo abalubangela kwabanye.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 10. Abasebenzisi bomgwaqo abadinga ukunakekelwa okwengeziwe (204 kuya ku-225)
description:
Abahamba Ngezinyawo (Imithetho 205 kuya ku-210)

 Umthetho 205

 Abahamba Ngezinyawo, ikakhulukazi izingane, bangase bangene emgwaqweni ngokungalindelekile. Shayela ucabanga ngokuphepha kwezingane futhi ngesivinini esifanele izimo.

 Umthetho 206

 Shayela ngokucophelela futhi kancane uma:

 • uhamba emigwaqweni yezitolo egcwele abantu, Izindawo Zasekhaya, Imizila Ethule — bheka Umthetho 218 — noma izindawo zokuhlala
• ukudlula izitobhi zamabhasi noma zethilamu, lapho abahamba ngezinyawo bangaphuma khona ngokuzumayo emgwaqweni
• ukudlula izimoto ezipakiwe, ikakhulukazi amaveni e-ayisikhilimu, njengoba izingane zingase zigxile ku-ayisikhilimu kunomgwaqo bese zigijimela emgwaqweni ngokungalindelekile
• ukudlula umgwaqo ohamba ngezinyawo, umzila wamabhayisikili noma umzila wamabhayisikili ukuze ungene noma ushiye indlela yokungena noma yokungena yangasese. Nikeza indlela abahamba ngezinyawo ogwadule kanye nabahamba ngamabhayisikili abasebenzisa umzila wamabhayisikili noma umzila wamabhayisikili
• ubuyela emuva ungene emgwaqweni oseceleni. Bheka yonke indawo emotweni yakho bese unikeza abahambi ngezinyawo ithuba abangase bawele
• ujika endaweni yokuhlangana. Nikeza abahambi ngezinyawo ithuba lokuwela umgwaqo lapho ujika khona noma lapho ujika khona
• uhamba ngemigwaqo noma udlula ezimotweni zokuhlenga nezokubuyisa emgwaqweni, njengoba abantu kungenzeka basebenza emgwaqweni noma eceleni kwawo
• umgwaqo uvaliwe ukuze kulungiswe umgwaqo futhi abahambi ngezinyawo baqondiswe emgwaqweni
• ukusondela kwabahamba ngezinyawo emgwaqweni omncane wasemakhaya ongenandlela yabahamba ngezinyawo noma indlela yabahamba ngezinyawo. Yehlisa ijubane, lungela ukuma futhi ubanike isikhala esanele lapho bedlula
• ukusondela ezindaweni zokuwela ze-zebra noma ezihambisanayo. KUMELE unikeze abahambi ngezinyawo nabahamba ngamabhayisikili ithuba lapho bewela — bheka uMthetho 195
• ukusondela kwabahamba ngezinyawo asebeqalile ukuwela phambili. Abahamba ngezinyawo abawela endaweni yokuhlangana noma emgwaqweni oseceleni banezinto eziza kuqala, ngakho-ke nikeza ithuba — bheka uMthetho H2.

 Umthetho: TSRGD Isheduli 14, Ingxenye 5.

 Umthetho 207

 Abahamba ngezinyawo abasengozini kakhulu

 Abahamba ngezinyawo abasengozini kakhulu bahlanganisa:

 • izingane kanye nabahamba ngezinyawo asebekhulile, abangase bangakwazi ukwahlulela isivinini sakho futhi bangase bangene emgwaqweni
• abahamba ngezinyawo asebekhulile, abangase badinge isikhathi esengeziwe sokuwela. Yiba nesineke futhi ubavumele bawele ngejubane labo. Ungabasheshisi ngokuvuselela injini noma ukuqhubekela phambili
• abantu abakhubazekile. Abantu abanenkinga yokuzwa bangase bangazi ukuthi imoto yakho isondela, kuyilapho abantu abanenkinga yokuhamba bedinga isikhathi esengeziwe
• abantu abayizimpumputhe noma abangaboni kahle, abangase baphathe induku emhlophe noma basebenzise inja eqondisayo futhi bangase bangakuboni usondela
• abantu abayizithulu abayizimpumputhe, abangase baphathe induku emhlophe enebhande elibomvu noma basebenzise inja egqoke ibhande elibomvu nelimhlophe. Bangase bangaboni noma bezwe imiyalelo noma izimpawu.

 Ngejubane elingu-40 mph (64 km/h), imoto yakho cishe izobulala umuntu ohamba ngezinyawo emshayisa. Ngejubane elingu-20 mph (32 km/h), kunethuba elilodwa kuphela kwangama-20 lokuthi umuntu ohamba ngezinyawo uzobulawa. Ngakho-ke, yehlisa ijubane lakho.

 Umthetho 208

 Eduze kwezikole

 Shayela kancane futhi uqaphele ikakhulukazi abagibeli bamabhayisikili abasebasha kanye nabahamba ngezinyawo.

 Isibonakaliso se-amber esikhanyayo singavela ngaphansi kwesibonakaliso sesixwayiso esithi `Isikole` ukukhombisa ukuthi izingane zingase ziwele phambili. Shayela kancane kakhulu uze uqede indawo.

 Umthetho 209

 Shayela ngokucophelela futhi kancane lapho udlula ibhasi elimile elibonisa uphawu `lwebhasi lesikole`, njengoba izingane zingase zikhuphuke noma zehle.

 Umthetho 210

 KUMELE ume lapho iphoyisa lesikole libonisa uphawu oluthi ‘Stop for children’. Bheka ‘Izimpawu zabantu abagunyaziwe’ kanye ‘nezimpawu zethrafikhi’.

 Umthetho: RTRA isigaba 28.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 10. Abasebenzisi bomgwaqo abadinga ukunakekelwa okwengeziwe (204 kuya ku-225)
subcategory: Abagibeli bezithuthuthu nabagibeli bamabhayisikili (imithetho 211 kuya ku-213)
description:
Abagibeli bezithuthuthu nabagibeli bamabhayisikili (Imithetho 211 kuya ku-213)

 Umthetho 211

 Abagibeli bezithuthuthu nabagibeli bamabhayisikili kungaba nzima ukubabona, ikakhulukazi uma:

 • belinde eceleni kwemoto yakho
• besondela ngemuva
• bephuma noma besuka ezimpambanweni
• behamba bezungeza izindawo ezizungezile
• bekudlula
• behlunga phakathi kwethrafikhi.

 Njalo qaphela abagibeli bezithuthuthu nabagibeli bamabhayisikili ngaphambi kokuba baphume ezimpambanweni. Kungenzeka ukuthi basondela ngokushesha kunalokho okulindele.

 Ungajiki ezimpambanweni uma ukwenza kanjalo kungabangela ukuthi umgibeli webhayisikili ohamba phambili ame noma aphambuke. Phatha umgibeli webhayisikili njengoba ubungenza kwenye imoto.

 Uma ujika ngakwesokudla unqamula umugqa wethrafikhi ehamba kancane noma emile, qaphela futhi unike ithuba abagibeli bamabhayisikili noma abagibeli bamabhayisikili abahamba ngaphakathi kwethrafikhi oyiwelayo.

 Qaphela ngokukhethekile lapho uhamba, ujika, ushintsha indlela noma ushintsha imizila. Hlola izibuko zakho nezindawo ezingabonakali kahle ngokucophelela.

 Umthetho 212

 Nikeza abagibeli bamabhayisikili, abagibeli bamabhayisikili, abagibeli bamahhashi, izimoto ezidonswa amahhashi kanye nabahamba ngezinyawo abahamba emgwaqweni, njengalapho kungekho khona indlela, okungenani isikhala esiningi njengoba ubungenza uma udlula imoto. Bheka Imithetho 162 kuya ku-167.

 Qaphela kakhulu futhi uvumele isikhala esengeziwe lapho udlula laba basebenzisi bomgwaqo:

 • esimweni sezulu esibi, kufaka phakathi imimoya enamandla
• ebusuku.

 Uma umgibeli ebheka ngaphezu kwehlombe lakhe, angase ahlose ukuphuma, ukujika kwesokudla noma ukushintsha indlela. Banike isikhathi nesikhala esanele sokwenza kanjalo.

 Umthetho 213

 Abagibele amabhayisikili ngezinye izikhathi bangagibela phakathi komzila kunokuba bagibele eduze komgwaqo:

 • ezingxenyeni ezincane zomgwaqo
• emigwaqweni ethule noma emigwaqweni
• ezimpambanweni zomgwaqo
• ezimotweni ezihamba kancane.

 Kulezi zimo, kungaba ngcono ngamaqembu abagibele amabhayisikili ukugibela amabili alandelanayo. Bavumele benze kanjalo ukuze baphephe futhi bakwazi ukubona nokubonakala.

 Abagibele amabhayisikili nabo belulekwa ukuba bagibele okungenani ububanzi bomnyango noma imitha eli-1 ukusuka ezimotweni ezipakiwe ukuze baphephe.

 Abagibeli bamahhashi bangagibela phakathi komzila ezingxenyeni ezincane zomgwaqo. Bavumele benze kanjalo ukuze baphephe futhi bakwazi ukubona nokubonakala.

 Abagibeli bezithuthuthu, abagibeli bamabhayisikili, abagibeli bamahhashi kanye nezimoto ezidonswa amahhashi kungadingeka bashintshe indlela ngokuzumayo ukuze bagweme izindawo zomgwaqo ezingalingani noma izithiyo ezifana nalezi:

 • izembozo zokudonsa amanzi
• izindawo ezinamafutha
• izindawo ezimanzi
• izindawo ezibandayo.

 Nikeza laba basebenzisi bomgwaqo indawo eningi futhi unake kakhulu noma yikuphi ukushintsha kwendlela okungase kudingeke bakwenze.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 10. Abasebenzisi bomgwaqo abadinga ukunakekelwa okwengeziwe (204 kuya ku-225)
description:
Abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo (Imithetho 214 kuya ku-218)

 Umthetho 214

 Izilwane

 Uma udlula izilwane:

 • shayela kancane
• zinike indawo eyanele
• zilungele ukuma
• ungazithuseli ngokushaya uphondo lwakho, ukuvuselela injini yakho noma ukusheshisa ngokushesha ngemva kokudlula.

 Qaphela izilwane eziholwa, eziqhutshwayo noma ezigitshelwayo emgwaqweni futhi uqaphele kakhulu.

 Gcina ijubane lakho liphansi emajikeni nasemigwaqweni emincane yasemaphandleni.

 Uma umhlambi wezilwane uvimba umgwaqo, yima bese ucisha injini yakho kuze kube yilapho izilwane seziphumile emgwaqweni.

 Qaphela izilwane emigwaqweni engenazibiyeli.

 Umthetho 215

 Abagibeli bamahhashi nezimoto ezidonswa amahhashi

 Qaphela ngokukhethekile abagibeli bamahhashi nezimoto ezidonswa amahhashi lapho usondela, udlula, udlula noma uhamba. Dlula kabanzi futhi kancane.

 Uma ubona ihhashi emgwaqweni:

 • yehlisa ijubane lakho lingabi ngaphezu kwe-10 mph
• bekezela
• ungakhali uphondo lwakho noma ushaye injini yakho
• uma uphephile, dlula kabanzi futhi kancane, ushiye okungenani amamitha amabili esikhala.

 Amahhashi asendle noma asendle ezindaweni ezifana ne-New Forest, i-Exmoor ne-Dartmoor adinga ukucatshangelwa okufanayo namahhashi agibele uma usondela noma uwadlula.

 Abagibeli bamahhashi bavame ukuba ngabantwana, ngakho-ke qaphela kakhulu. Abagibeli bangase bahambe ngomugqa ophindwe kabili ngenkathi bephelezela ihhashi elincane noma elingenalwazi noma umgibeli.

 Qaphela izimpawu ezivela kubagibeli bamahhashi nabashayeli bezimoto ezidonswa amahhashi. Landela noma yisiphi isicelo sokunciphisa ijubane noma ukuma.

 Phatha ihhashi ngalinye njengengozi engaba khona. Amahhashi angaziphatha ngendlela engalindelekile naphezu kwemizamo yomgibeli noma yomshayeli. Khumbula ukuthi kukhona ubuchopho obuthathu obusebenzayo uma udlula ihhashi: elomgibeli, elomshayeli kanye nelehhashi.

 Amahhashi ayizilwane ezindizayo futhi angahamba ngokushesha kakhulu uma ethukile.

 Umthetho 216

 Abashayeli asebekhulile

 Abashayeli asebekhulile bangasabela kancane kunabanye abashayeli. Vumela lokhu.

 Umthetho 217

 Abafundi nabashayeli abangenalwazi

 Abafundi nabashayeli abangenalwazi bangase babe nekhono elincane lokulindela nokuphendula izenzakalo.

 Yiba nesineke ikakhulukazi ngabashayeli abafundi nabashayeli abasebasha.

 Abashayeli abasanda kudlula isivivinyo sabo bangabonisa ipuleti noma isitikha `somshayeli omusha`. Bheka `Ikhodi yokuphepha yabashayeli abasha`.

 Umthetho 218

 Izindawo Zasekhaya Nemizila Ethule

 Ezindaweni Zasekhaya Nemizila Ethule, abantu bangasebenzisa wonke umgwaqo ngemisebenzi efana nokudlala kwezingane noma imicimbi yomphakathi.

 Shayela kancane nangokucophelela. Lungela ukuma futhi unikeze abantu isikhathi esengeziwe sokwenza isikhala esanele sokuba udlule ngokuphepha.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 10. Abasebenzisi bomgwaqo abadinga ukunakekelwa okwengeziwe (204 kuya ku-225)
description:
Ezinye izimoto (Imithetho 219 kuya ku-225)

 Umthetho 219

 Izimoto eziphuthumayo nezisekela izingozi

 Bheka futhi ulalele:

 • ama-ambulensi, izinjini zomlilo, izimoto zamaphoyisa, odokotela noma ezinye izimoto eziphuthumayo ezisebenzisa izibani eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ezibomvu noma eziluhlaza okotshani, ama-siren noma izibani ezikhanyayo
• iphoyisa lomgwaqo kanye nezimoto ezisekela izingozi ezisebenzisa izibani eziphuzi ezikhanyayo.

 Uma umuntu esondela:

 • ungesabi
• cabanga ngomzila okungenzeka ukuthi uwuthathe
• thatha isinyathelo esifanele sokuwuvumela udlule ngenkathi ulandela zonke izimpawu zomgwaqo
• uma kudingeka, donsela eceleni komgwaqo bese uyama
• zama ukungami phambi kwegquma, ukugoba noma ingxenye encane yomgwaqo
• ungazifaki engozini, abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo noma abahamba ngezinyawo
• gwema ukufaka unqenqema
• ungabhuleki kakhulu uma usondela endaweni yokuhlangana noma ezungezayo, njengoba umshayeli olandelayo kungenzeka angabi nombono ofana nowakho.

 Umthetho 220

 Izimoto ezisebenzisa amandla ezisetshenziswa abantu abakhubazekile

 Lezi zimoto ezincane zinesivinini esiphezulu esingu-8 mph (12 km/h).

 Endleleni yezimoto ezimbili enomkhawulo wesivinini ongaphezu kuka-50 mph (80 km/h), KUMELE zibonise i-beacon ephuzi ekhanyayo. Kweminye imigwaqo, ungase ungasitholi lesi sixwayiso kusengaphambili. Bheka Imithetho 36 kuya ku-46.

 Umthetho: Imithethonqubo ye-RVLR 17(1) no-26.

 Umthetho 221

 Izimoto ezinkulu

 Izimoto ezinkulu zingadinga isikhala esengeziwe somgwaqo ukuze zijike noma zigweme ingozi ongeke uyibone.

 Uma ulandela imoto enkulu, njengebhasi noma iloli elinomugqa, khumbula ukuthi umshayeli wayo angase angakwazi ukukubona ezibukweni.

 Lungela ukuma ulinde uma imoto enkulu idinga indawo eyengeziwe noma isikhathi sokujika.

 Umthetho 222

 Izimoto ezinkulu zingakuvimba ukubuka kwakho. Dlula emuva bese wandisa ibanga lakho lokuhlukana ukuze uthuthukise ikhono lakho lokubona nokuhlela kusenesikhathi.

 Yiba nesineke ngoba izimoto ezinkulu zingaphansi kwemikhawulo yejubane ephansi kunezimoto nezithuthuthu.

 Izimoto eziningi ezinkulu zingaba namadivayisi okunciphisa ijubane azikhawulela ku-56 mph (90 km/h), ngisho nasemgwaqweni omkhulu.

 Umthetho 223

 Amabhasi, amabhasi kanye nama-tram

 Nika amabhasi, ama-coaches nama-tram kuqala uma ungakwenza lokho ngokuphepha, ikakhulukazi uma ekhomba ukuthi kufanele asuke ezitobhini.

 Qaphela abantu abaphuma ebhasini noma e-tram bese bewela umgwaqo.

 Umthetho 224

 Izimoto zikagesi

 Qaphela izimoto zikagesi ezifana ne-milk floats nama-tram.

 Ama-tram ahamba ngokushesha kodwa buthule futhi awakwazi ukuqondisa ukuze akugweme.

 Umthetho 225

 Izimoto ezine-beacon ezikhanyayo eziphuzi

 I-beacon ephuzi ephuzi ephuzi ixwayisa ngalokhu:

 • imoto ehamba kancane noma engashintshi, njengemoto yamaphoyisa omgwaqo, i-salt spreader, i-snowplow noma imoto yokubuyisa
• umthwalo ongajwayelekile.

 Sondela kulezi zimoto ngokucophelela.

 Ezindleleni ezimbili ezingenamkhawulo, izimoto ezisetshenziswa okokuqala ngomhlaka-1 Januwari 1947 noma ngemva kwalokho ezinesivinini esiphezulu esingu-25 mph (40 km/h) noma ngaphansi, njengetrakta, KUMELE zisebenzise i-beacon ekhanyayo ephuzi. Bheka futhi uMthetho 220.

 Umthetho: Umthethonqubo we-RVLR 17.

description:
Isimo sezulu esimanzi (Umthetho 227)

 Esimweni sezulu esimanzi, amabanga okuma okungenani aphindwe kabili kunalawo adingekayo emigwaqweni eyomile. Bheka ‘Amabanga okuma ajwayelekile’. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi amathayi awabambeki kahle emgwaqweni omanzi.

 Esimweni sezulu esimanzi:

 • gcina kude nemoto phambili ukuze uthuthukise ikhono lakho lokubona nokuhlela kusenesikhathi
• uma isiteringi singasabeli, amanzi cishe avimbela amathayi ukuthi angabambi umgwaqo. Yehlisa i-accelerator bese wehlisa ijubane kancane kancane
• khumbula ukuthi imvula kanye ne-spray evela ezimotweni kungenza kube nzima ukubona nokubonakala
• qaphela ukuthi i-diesel echithekile ingenza ubuso bomgwaqo bushelele kakhulu — bheka ‘Ukulungiswa kwezimoto, ukuphepha nokuvikeleka’
• qaphela kakhulu abantu abahamba ngezinyawo, abagibeli bamabhayisikili, abagibeli bamabhayisikili kanye nabagibeli bamahhashi.
