subcategory: Isimo sezulu esibandayo nesikhithikayo (imithetho 228 kuya ku-231)
description:
Isimo sezulu esibandayo nesikhithikile (Imithetho 228 kuya ku-231)

 Umthetho 228

 Ebusika, hlola isibikezelo sezulu sendawo ukuze uthole izixwayiso zezimo ezibandayo noma zeqhwa.

 UNGASHAYELI kulezi zimo ngaphandle kokuthi uhambo lwakho lubalulekile. Uma kufanele uhambe, qaphela kakhulu futhi uvumele isikhathi esengeziwe.

 Phatha ikhithi yezimo eziphuthumayo equkethe:

 • i-de-icer kanye ne-ice scraper
• ithoshi
• izingubo ezifudumele namabhuzu
• ikhithi yosizo lokuqala
• izintambo zokugxuma
• ifosholo
• isiphuzo esifudumele
• ukudla okuphuthumayo.

 Lezi zinto zingadingeka uma ubhajwa noma imoto yakho iphuka.

 Umthetho 229

 Ngaphambi kokuhamba:

 • KUMELE ukwazi ukubona, ngakho susa lonke iqhwa neqhwa kuwo wonke amafasitela futhi uqinisekise ukuthi i-windscreen icacile ngokuphelele
• KUMELE uqinisekise ukuthi izibani zihlanzekile
• KUMELE uqinisekise ukuthi amapuleti ezinombolo abonakala kahle futhi afundeka kalula
• qiniseka ukuthi izibuko zicacile futhi amafasitela acacile kahle
• susa lonke iqhwa elingawela endleleni yomunye umsebenzisi womgwaqo
• hlola ukuthi umzila wakho ohleliwe awunazo izithiyo nokuthi akukho qhwa elengeziwe noma isimo sezulu esibi esibikezelwayo.

 Imithetho: Umthethonqubo we-CUR 30; Umthethonqubo we-RVLR 23; Isigaba 43 se-VERA; kanye nomthethonqubo we-RV(DRM)R 11.

 Umthetho 230

 Uma ushayela ezimweni ezibandayo noma ezineqhwa:

 • shayela ngokucophelela ngisho noma imigwaqo isilungisiwe
 • gcina kude kakhulu nomsebenzisi womgwaqo ongaphambili, njengoba amabanga okuma angaba makhulu ngokuphindwe kayishumi kunasemigwaqweni eyomile
 • qaphela lapho udlula izimoto ezisakaza usawoti noma ezinye izithambisi, ikakhulukazi lapho ugibela isithuthuthu noma ibhayisikili
 • qaphela ama-snowplow, angase aphonse iqhwa kuzo zombili izinhlangothi
 • ungadluli i-snowplow ngaphandle kokuthi umzila ohlose ukuwusebenzisa usususiwe
 • lungele ukuthi izimo zomgwaqo zishintshe emabangeni amafushane
 • lalela ama-newsletter okuhamba futhi uqaphele izimpawu zemiyalezo eguquguqukayo ukuze uthole ulwazi mayelana nesimo sezulu, umgwaqo kanye nezimo zethrafikhi eziseduze.

 Umthetho 231

 Shayela ngokucophelela kakhulu emigwaqweni ebandayo futhi ugweme izenzo ezisheshayo, ezingabangela ukulahlekelwa ukulawula.

 Kufanele:

 • shayela kancane ngegiya eliphezulu ngangokunokwenzeka
• sheshisa futhi ubhuleke kancane kakhulu
• shayela kancane kakhulu lapho ugoba khona, lapho kungenzeka khona ukulahlekelwa ukulawula
• bhuleka kancane kancane ngenkathi uhamba uqonde ngaphambi kokufika endaweni egobayo
• ngemva kokunciphisa ijubane, shayela kahle uzungeze indawo egobayo futhi ugweme izenzo ezisheshayo
• hlola ukubamba kwakho eqhweni noma eqhweni ngokukhetha indawo ephephile bese ubhuleka kancane.

 Ukuqondisa okungaphenduli kungabonisa iqhwa nokulahlekelwa ukubamba kwamathayi. Amathayi awabangeli msindo cishe ngenkathi ehamba eqhweni.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 11. Ukushayela ezimweni zezulu ezimbi (226 kuya ku-237)
description:
Isimo sezulu esinomoya (Imithetho 232 kuya ku-233)

 Umthetho 232

 Izimoto ezisemaceleni aphezulu zithinteka kakhulu isimo sezulu esinomoya, kodwa izivunguvungu ezinamandla zingaphinde zishaye imoto, umgibeli webhayisikili, umgibeli wesithuthuthu noma umgibeli wehhashi aphume endleleni. Lokhu kungenzeka ezindaweni ezivulekile zomgwaqo ezivezwe emimoyeni enamandla, noma lapho kudlula amabhuloho noma izikhala ezigodini.

 Umthetho 233

 Esimweni sezulu esinomoya kakhulu, imoto yakho ingase ithintwe ukuxokozela okudalwe izimoto ezinkulu. Abagibeli bezithuthuthu bathinteka kakhulu, ngakho-ke gwema ukubagwema uma bedlula imoto emaceleni aphezulu.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 11. Ukushayela ezimweni zezulu ezimbi (226 kuya ku-237)
description:
Inkungu (Imithetho 234 kuya ku-236)

 Umthetho 234

 Ngaphambi kokungena enkunguni, hlola izibuko zakho bese wehlisa ijubane.

 Uma `inkungu` iboniswa ophawini kodwa umgwaqo ucacile, lungela inqwaba yenkungu noma inkungu ekhukhulekayo ngaphambili. Ngisho noma kubonakala sengathi iyacaca, ungazithola ngokuzumayo usenkungwini enkulu.

 Umthetho 235

 Uma ushayela enkungwini, kufanele:

 • usebenzise izibani zakho njengoba kudingeka (bheka Umthetho 226)
• gcina ibanga eliphephile ngemuva kwemoto engaphambili; izibani zangemuva zinganikeza umuzwa wokuvikeleka ongamanga
• ukwazi ukuphakamisa kahle ngaphakathi kwebanga ongalibona kahle. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu emigwaqweni emikhulu kanye nasezindleleni ezimbili, njengoba izimoto zihamba ngokushesha
• sebenzisa ama-wiper akho e-windscreen kanye nama-demister
• qaphela abanye abashayeli abangasebenzisi izibani zangaphambili
• ungasheshisi ukuze ubalekele imoto eseduze kakhulu nawe
• hlola izibuko zakho ngaphambi kokuba wehlise ijubane. Bese usebenzisa amabhuleki akho ukuze izibani zakho zamabhuleki zixwayise abashayeli abangemuva kwakho ukuthi wehlisa ijubane
• yima endaweni efanele endaweni lapho kubonakala khona okulinganiselwe bese ulalela ithrafikhi. Uma uqiniseka ukuthi kuphephile ukuphuma, yenza lokho ngendlela enhle futhi ungangabazi endaweni ekubeka ngqo endleleni yokusondela ezimotweni.

 Umthetho 236

 AKUMELE usebenzise izibani zangaphambili noma zangemuva ngaphandle kokuthi ukubonakala kunciphe kakhulu (bheka Umthetho 226), njengoba zikhazimulisa abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo futhi zingasitha izibani zakho zamabhuleki. KUMELE uzicime lapho ukubonakala kuthuthukiswa.

 Umthetho: Imithethonqubo ye-RVLR 25 kanye no-27.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 11. Ukushayela ezimweni zezulu ezimbi (226 kuya ku-237)
description:
Isimo sezulu esishisayo (Umthetho 237)

 Umthetho 237

 Gcina imoto yakho inomoya omuhle ukuze ugweme ukozela.

 Qaphela ukuthi umgwaqo ungase uthambe noma, uma lina ngemva kwemvula eyomile, ungase ushelele. Lezi zimo zingathinta isiteringi sakho kanye nokubhuleka.

 Uma ukhangwa ukukhanya kwelanga okukhanyayo, yehlisa ijubane, futhi uma kudingeka, yeka.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 12. Ukulinda nokupaka (238 kuya ku-252)
description:
Okujwayelekile (Umthetho 238)

 Umthetho 238

 AKUMELE ulinde noma upake emigqeni ephuzi ngesikhathi sokusebenza esiboniswe kuma-timeplate aseduze, noma ezimpawini zokungena endaweni uma useNdaweni Yokupaka Elawulwayo. Bheka ‘Izimpawu zethrafikhi’ kanye ‘nezimpawu zomgwaqo’.

 Imigqa ephuzi ephindwe kabili ikhombisa ukuthi ukulinda akuvunyelwe ngaso sonke isikhathi, noma ngabe azikho izimpawu eziqondile.

 AKUMELE ulinde, upake noma ume ukuze ubeke phansi noma uthwale abagibeli ezimpawini zokungena esikoleni lapho izimpawu eziqondile zibonisa ukuthi ukuma akuvunyelwe.

 Umthetho: Izigaba 5 no-8 ze-RTRA.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 12. Ukulinda nokupaka (238 kuya ku-252)
description:
Ukupaka (Imithetho 239 kuya ku-247)

 Umthetho 239

 Sebenzisa izindawo zokupaka ezingaphandle komgwaqo, noma ama-bay aphawulwe ngemigqa emhlophe emgwaqweni njengezindawo zokupaka, noma kuphi lapho kungenzeka khona.

 Uma kufanele ume eceleni komgwaqo:

 • ungapaki ubheke eduze nokuhamba kwethrafikhi
• yima eduze ngangokunokwenzeka eceleni
• ungami eduze kakhulu nemoto ephethe ibheji eliluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka; khumbula, umuntu ogibele imoto angase adinge indawo eyengeziwe yokungena noma yokuphuma
• KUMELE ucime injini, izibani zangaphambili kanye nezibani zenkungu
• KUMELE ubambe ibhuleki lesandla ngaphambi kokuphuma emotweni
• KUMELE uqinisekise ukuthi awushayi muntu uma uvula umnyango wakho. Hlola abagibeli bamabhayisikili noma abanye abantu ngokubuka nxazonke bese usebenzisa izibuko zakho
• lapho ukwazi khona ukwenza kanjalo, kufanele uvule umnyango usebenzisa isandla sakho ohlangothini oluphambene nomnyango owuvulayo; isibonelo, sebenzisa isandla sakho sobunxele ukuvula umnyango ohlangothini lwakho lwesokudla. Lokhu kuzokwenza uphendule ikhanda lakho ukuze ubheke ngaphesheya kwehlombe lakho. Uzobe usugwema ukubangela ukulimala kwabagibeli bamabhayisikili noma abagibeli bezithuthuthu abadlula emgwaqweni, noma kubantu abasemgwaqweni
 • kuphephile ngabagibeli bakho, ikakhulukazi izingane, ukuphuma emotweni eseceleni komgwaqo
 • beka zonke izinto eziyigugu kude nokubonakala futhi uqinisekise ukuthi imoto yakho iphephile
 • khiya imoto yakho.

 Ngaphambi kokusebenzisa idivayisi ephathwa ngesandla ukuze ikusize upake, KUMELE uqiniseke ukuthi kuphephile ukwenza kanjalo. Kufanele-ke uhambise imoto endaweni yokupaka ngendlela ephephile nangendlela emfushane kakhulu.

 Uma usebenzisa idivayisi ephathwa ngesandla ukuze ikusize upake, KUMELE uhlale ulawula imoto ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ungasebenzisi idivayisi ephethwe ngesandla kunoma yini enye ngenkathi uyisebenzisa ukuze ikusize upake, futhi ungabeki muntu engozini. Sebenzisa idivayisi ngokwemiyalelo yomenzi.

 Uma usebenzisa indawo yokushaja yemoto kagesi, kufanele upake eduze nendawo yokushaja futhi ugweme ukudala ingozi yokuwa kwabahamba ngezinyawo ngezintambo ezilandelanayo. Veza uphawu lwesixwayiso uma ukwazi. Ngemva kokusebenzisa indawo yokushaja, kufanele ubuyisele izintambo zokushaja nezixhumi kahle ukuze unciphise ingozi kwabahamba ngezinyawo futhi ugweme ukudala isithiyo kwabanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo.

 Imithetho: Imithethonqubo ye-CUR 98, 105, 107 kanye ne-110; Umthethonqubo we-RVLR 27; kanye ne-RTA 1988 Isigaba 42.

 Umthetho 240

 AKUMELE ume noma upake ku:

 • umgwaqo wezimoto, indawo ephuthumayo noma ihlombe eliqinile lomgwaqo omkhulu, ngaphandle kwesimo esiphuthumayo (bheka Imithetho 270 no-271)
 • indawo yokuwela abahamba ngezinyawo, kufaka phakathi indawo ephawulwe ngemigqa egobile (bheka Umthetho 191)
 • umgwaqo ovulekile (bheka ‘Izimpawu zethrafikhi’)
• izindawo zokupaka amatekisi, njengoba kuboniswe yizimpawu eziqondile kanye nezimpawu
• umgwaqo ovulekile wasemadolobheni phakathi namahora okusebenza kwawo, ngaphandle kokuthatha noma ukusetha abagibeli (bheka ‘Izimpawu zethrafikhi’)
• umgwaqo ophawulwe ngemigqa emhlophe ephindwe kabili, noma ngabe umugqa omhlophe ophukile useceleni kwakho komgwaqo, ngaphandle kokuthatha noma ukusetha abagibeli noma ukulayisha noma ukulayisha izimpahla
• umzila wethilamu noma wamabhayisikili ngesikhathi sokusebenza kwawo
• umzila wamabhayisikili
• imigqa ebomvu ‘emizileni ebomvu’ eqokwe ngokukhethekile, ngaphandle kokuthi izimpawu zikhomba okunye.

 Noma iyiphi imoto ingangena emzileni wamabhasi ukuze ime, ilayishe noma yehlise lapho lokhu kungavunyelwe khona (bheka uMthetho 141).

 Imithetho: Imithethonqubo ye-MT(E&W)R 7 no-9 njengoba ichitshiyelwe yi-MT(E&W)(A)(E)R; Imithethonqubo ye-MT(S)R 6 no-8; Izigaba ze-RTRA 5, 6 no-8; kanye neShejuli ye-TSRGD 7, Izingxenye 2, 3, 4, 5 no-7, iShejuli 9, Ingxenye 6, kanye neShejuli 14, Izingxenye 1 no-5.

 UMthetho 241

 AKUMELE upake ezindaweni ezigcinelwe abasebenzisi abathile, njengabaphethe iBlue Badge, izakhamuzi noma izithuthuthu, ngaphandle kokuthi unelungelo lokwenza kanjalo.

 Imithetho: Isigaba se-CSDPA 21 kanye nezigaba ze-RTRA 5 no-8.

 Umthetho 242

 AKUMELE ushiye imoto yakho noma i-trailer isesimweni esiyingozi noma lapho ibangela noma yikuphi ukuvimba okungadingekile komgwaqo.

 Imithetho: RTA 1988 Isigaba 22 kanye noMthethonqubo we-CUR 103.

 Umthetho 243

 Ngaphandle kokuthi uphoqeleke ukwenza kanjalo ngenxa yethrafikhi engami, UNGAMI noma upake:

 • eduze komnyango wesikole
• noma kuphi lapho ungavimbela khona ukufinyelela kwezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo
• esitobhini sebhasi noma se-tram noma erenki yamatekisi
• lapho usondela endaweni yokuwela eqondile noma endaweni yokuwela i-tram
• ngaphesheya noma ngaphakathi kwamamitha ayi-10 (32 izinyawo) ye-junction, ngaphandle kwendawo yokupaka egunyaziwe
• eduze kwekhanda legquma noma ibhuloho eliyi-hump
• ngaphesheya kwesiqhingi sethrafikhi noma, uma lokhu kungadala ukuvimba, enye imoto epakiwe
• lapho ungaphoqa abanye abantu ukuthi bangene emzileni wethilamu
• lapho unqenqema lwehliswe khona ukusiza abasebenzisi bezitulo ezinamasondo kanye nezimoto zokuhamba ezihambayo ezinamandla
• phambi komnyango wokungena endaweni
• ekhoneni
• lapho ungavimbela khona ukusetshenziswa kwabagibeli bamabhayisikili ezindaweni zokugibela amabhayisikili.

 EScotland, AKUMELE upake kabili noma upake noma kuphi lapho unqenqema lwehliswe khona ukusiza abahamba ngezinyawo noma abagibeli bamabhayisikili. Ukwehluka kuyavunyelwa ezimweni ezilinganiselwe.

 Umthetho: T(Scot)A Ingxenye 6.

 Umthetho 244

 AKUMELE upake ingxenye noma yonke emgwaqweni eLondon noma eScotland. Ukwehluka kuyavunyelwa ezimweni ezilinganiselwe. Kwenye indawo, akufanele upake ingxenye noma yonke emgwaqweni ngaphandle kokuthi izimpawu zikuvumela.

 Ukupaka emgwaqweni kungavimbela futhi kuphazamise kakhulu abahamba ngezinyawo, abantu abasezihlalweni zabakhubazekile noma abangaboni kahle, kanye nabantu abanezinqola zokugibela noma izihlalo zokugibela.

 Imithetho: GL(GP)A Isigaba 15 kanye ne-T(Scot)A Ingxenye 6.

 Umthetho 245

 Izindawo Zokupaka Ezilawulwayo

 Izimpawu zokungena endaweni zibonisa izikhathi lapho imikhawulo yokulinda ngaphakathi kwendawo isebenza khona. Ukupaka kungavunyelwa kwezinye izindawo ngezinye izikhathi. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ukupaka kuzoba ngaphakathi kwezindawo ezisayinwe futhi eziphawulwe ngokwehlukana.

 Umthetho 246

 Izimoto zezimpahla

 Izimoto ezinesisindo esiphezulu esingaphezu kwamathani angu-7.5, kufaka phakathi noma iyiphi i-trailer, AKUMELE zipakwe eceleni, emgwaqweni noma kunoma iyiphi indawo ephakathi kwemigwaqo ngaphandle kwemvume yamaphoyisa.

 Okuwukuphela komehluko lapho ukupaka kubalulekile ekulayisheni noma ekulayisheni izimpahla, lapho imoto AKUMELE ishiywe inganakekelwe.

 Umthetho: RTA 1988 Isigaba 19.

 Umthetho 247

 Ukulayisha nokukhipha izimpahla

 Ungalayishi noma ukukhulula izimpahla lapho kunezimpawu eziphuzi khona eceleni futhi izimpawu eziqondile zeluleka ukuthi kunemikhawulo (bheka `Izimpawu zomgwaqo`). Ukulayisha noma ukukhulula izimpahla kungavunyelwa lapho ukupaka kuvinjelwe ngenye indlela.

 Emizileni ebomvu, izindawo eziphawulwe ngokukhethekile nezisayiniwe zibonisa ukuthi ukulayisha nokukhulula izimpahla kuvunyelwe kuphi futhi nini.

 Umthetho: Izigaba ze-RTRA 5 no-8.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 12. Ukulinda nokupaka (238 kuya ku-252)
description:
Ukupaka ebusuku (Imithetho 248 kuya ku-252)

 Umthetho 248

 AKUMELE upake emgwaqweni ebusuku ubheke ngakwesokunene kokuhamba kwezimoto ngaphandle kokuthi usesikhundleni sokupaka esaziwayo.

 Imithetho: Umthethonqubo we-CUR 101 kanye noMthethonqubo we-RVLR 24.

 Umthethonqubo 249

 Zonke izimoto KUMELE zibonise izibani zokupaka lapho zipakwe emgwaqweni noma endaweni evulekile emgwaqweni onomkhawulo wejubane elingaphezu kwama-30 mph (48 km/h).

 Umthetho: Umthethonqubo we-RVLR 24.

 Umthethonqubo 250

 Izimoto, izimoto zezimpahla ezingadluli ku-2,500 kg isisindo esithwalwayo, izinqola ezingasebenzi, izithuthuthu kanye namabhayisikili ephedali kungapakwa ngaphandle kwezibani emgwaqweni noma endaweni evulekile enomkhawulo wejubane ongu-30 mph (48 km/h) noma ngaphansi uma:

 • okungenani amamitha ayi-10 (32 amamitha ) kude nanoma iyiphi indawo yokuhlangana, eduze komgwaqo futhi kubheke ohlangothini lokuhamba kwezimoto
• endaweni yokupaka eyaziwayo noma evulekile.

 Ezinye izimoto nama-trailer, kanye nazo zonke izimoto ezinemithwalo evelele, AKUMELE zishiywe emgwaqweni ebusuku ngaphandle kwezibani.

 Imithetho: Umthethonqubo we-RVLR 24 kanye noMthethonqubo we-CUR 82(7).

 Umthetho 251

 Ukupaka enkungwini

 Kuyingozi kakhulu ukupaka emgwaqweni kunenkungu. Uma kungenakugwenywa, shiya izibani zakho zokupaka noma izibani eziseceleni zivuliwe.

 Umthetho 252

 Ukupaka emagqumeni

 Uma upaka egqumeni, kufanele:

 • upake eduze komgwaqo bese ufaka ibhuleki lesandla ngokuqinile
• khetha igiya eliya phambili bese uphendula isondo lakho lokuqondisa lisuke komgwaqo uma ubheke phezulu
• khetha igiya elibuyela emuva bese uphendulela isondo lakho lokuqondisa liye komgwaqo uma ubheke phansi
• sebenzisa `ukupaka` uma imoto yakho inebhokisi legiya elizenzakalelayo.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 12. Ukulinda nokupaka (238 kuya ku-252)
description:
Umthetho Wokuphoqelelwa Kokupaka Okungavunyelwe (i-DPE)

 I-DPE iya ngokuya ivame njengoba iziphathimandla eziningi zithatha le ndima. Ngaphansi kwe-DPE, iziphathimandla zethrafikhi zasendaweni zithatha umthwalo wemfanelo wokuphoqelela ukwephulwa okuningi kokupaka esikhundleni samaphoyisa.

 Imininingwane eyengeziwe nge-DPE ingatholakala ku:

 • I-Traffic Penalty Tribunal (ngaphandle kweLondon): http://www.trafficpenaltytribunal.gov.uk/
• I-London Tribunals (ngaphakathi kweLondon): http://www.londontribunals.gov.uk/

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 13. Imigwaqo Emikhulu (253 kuya ku-274)
description:
Okujwayelekile (Imithetho 253 kuya ku-254)

 Umthetho 253

 Izimoto ezivinjelwe

 Imigwaqo emikhulu AKUMELE isetshenziswe yi:

 • abahamba ngezinyawo
• abanamalayisense ezithuthuthu zesikhashana
• abagibeli bezithuthuthu ezingaphansi kuka-50 cc (4 kW)
• abagibeli bamabhayisikili
• abagibeli bamahhashi
• ezinye izimoto ezihamba kancane
• izimoto ezithwala imithwalo emikhulu, ngaphandle kwemvume ekhethekile
• izimoto zezolimo
• izihlalo zabakhubazekile ezisebenzisa amandla kanye nama-scooter okunyakaza asebenzisa amandla (bheka Imithetho 36 kuya ku-46 kufaka phakathi).

 Abanikazi bamalayisense ezithutha zesikhashana AKUMELE bashayele emgwaqweni omkhulu ngaphandle kokuthi:

 • baphelekezelwa ngumqeqeshi wokushayela ovunyiwe yi-DVSA (ADI)
• bashayela imoto ekhombisa amapuleti abomvu e-L, noma amapuleti e-D eWales
• bashayela imoto enezinto zokulawula ezimbili.

 Imithetho: Izigaba 16 no-17 ze-HA 1980 kanye neShejuli 4; Imithethonqubo ye-MT(E&W)R 3(d), 4 kanye no-11 njengoba ichitshiyelwe yi-MT(E&W)(A)R 2004 kanye ne-MT(E&W)(A)R 2018; Izigaba ze-R(S)A 7 no-8 kanye neShejuli 3; Isigaba se-RTRA 17; kanye ne-MT(S)R Regulation 10 njengoba ichitshiyelwe yi-MT(S)(A)R 2018.

 Umthetho 254

 Ithrafikhi emigwaqweni emikhulu ivame ukuhamba ngokushesha kunakweminye imigwaqo, ngakho-ke unesikhathi esincane sokusabela. Kubaluleke kakhulu ukusebenzisa izibuko zakho kusenesikhathi futhi ubheke phambili kakhulu kunakweminye imigwaqo.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 13. Imigwaqo Emikhulu (253 kuya ku-274)
description:
Izimpawu zomgwaqo omkhulu (Imithetho 255 kuya ku-258)

 Umthetho 255

 Izimpawu nezimpawu (bheka ‘Izimpawu zokukhanya ezilawula ithrafikhi’) zisetshenziselwa ukukuxwayisa ngezingozi ezizayo. Isibonelo, kungase kube nesigameko, inkungu, ukuchitheka noma abasebenzi bomgwaqo emgwaqweni ongase ungakwazi ukukubona ngokushesha.

 Umthetho 256

 Uphawu noma isignali eyodwa ingabonisa iseluleko, imikhawulo kanye nezixwayiso zazo zonke izindlela.

 Izimpawu nezimpawu ezithile zomzila zingabonisa iseluleko, imikhawulo kanye nezixwayiso ezisebenza emizileni ngayinye.

 Umthetho 257

 Izibani ezikhanyayo eziphuzi

 Lezi zimpawu zixwayisa ngengozi ezayo. Kufanele:

 • wehlise isivinini sakho
• ulungele ingozi
• khulisa isivinini sakho kuphela uma udlula isignali engakhanyi, noma isibonakaliso esibonisa umkhawulo wejubane kazwelonke noma igama elithi ‘END’, futhi uyaqiniseka ukuthi kuphephile ukwenza kanjalo.

 Umthetho 258

 Izimpawu zokukhanya ezibomvu ezikhanyayo kanye no-‘X’ obomvu ophawini zikhomba umzila ovaliwe lapho kukhona khona abantu, izimoto ezimile noma ezinye izingozi.

 Wena:

 • KUMELE ulandele imiyalelo ezimpawini ngaphambi komzila ovaliwe ukuze uhambe ngokuphepha uye emgwaqweni ovulekile
• AKUMELE ushayele emgwaqweni ovaliwe.

 Isibonakaliso sizokwazisa uma umzila ungasavaliwe ngokubonisa umkhawulo wejubane noma igama elithi ‘END’.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 13. Imigwaqo Emikhulu (253 kuya ku-274)
description:
Ukujoyina umgwaqo omkhulu (Umthetho 259)

 Umthetho 259

 Uma ujoyina umgwaqo omkhulu, uzovame ukuwusondela usuka emgwaqweni ongakwesobunxele, obizwa ngokuthi umgwaqo oshelelayo, noma usuka emgwaqweni omkhulu oseduze.

 Kufanele:

 • unikeze kuqala ithrafikhi esevele ikhona emgwaqweni omkhulu
• hlola ithrafikhi emgwaqweni omkhulu bese ufanisa isivinini sakho ukuze silingane ngokuphephile nokugeleza kwethrafikhi emzileni wesobunxele
• ungaweli imigqa emhlophe eqinile ehlukanisa imizila noma usebenzise ihlombe eliqinile
• uhlale emgwaqweni oshelelayo uma uqhubeka njengomzila owengeziwe emgwaqweni omkhulu
• uhlale emgwaqweni wesobunxele isikhathi eside ngokwanele ukuze uvumelane nesivinini sethrafikhi ngaphambi kokucabangela ukudlula.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 13. Imigwaqo Emikhulu (253 kuya ku-274)
description:
Emgwaqweni omkhulu (Imithetho 260 kuya ku-263)

 Umthetho 260

 Uma ubona kahle ngaphambili futhi izimo zomgwaqo zinhle, kufanele:

 • ushayele ngesivinini esizinzile wena nemoto yakho eningasiphatha ngokuphepha futhi esingaphakathi komkhawulo wejubane (bheka Umthetho 124 kanye nethebula lemikhawulo yejubane)
• gcina ibanga eliphephile ukusuka emotweni engaphambili futhi wandise igebe emigwaqweni emanzi noma ebandayo, noma enkungwini (bheka Imithetho 126 no-235).

 Umthetho 261

 AKUMELE weqe:

 • umkhawulo wejubane oboniswa ngaphakathi kwendilinga ebomvu ophawini
• umkhawulo wejubane omkhulu womgwaqo kanye nemoto yakho (bheka Umthetho 124).

 Imikhawulo yesivinini iphoqelelwa ngamaphoyisa (bheka uMthetho 124).

 Umthetho: Izigaba ze-RTRA 17, 86 kanye no-89 kanye noShejuli 6.

 Umthetho 262

 Ukuzilibazisa kokushayela emigwaqweni emikhulu nakweminye imigwaqo eshesha kakhulu kungakwenza uzizwe ulele. Ukuze unciphise ingozi, landela iseluleko esikuMthetho 91 mayelana nokuqinisekisa ukuthi ukulungele ukushayela nokuthatha amakhefu.

 Izindawo zesevisi zitholakala emigwaqweni emikhulu ukuze zikuvumele ukuthi uthathe amakhefu futhi uthole ukudla okulula. Izindawo zokuphumula nokuphumula kunethiwekhi yemigwaqo yendawo nazo zingatholakala ezindaweni zokuphuma emigwaqweni emikhulu.

 Umthetho 263

 Ngaphandle kokuthi uqondiswe yiphoyisa noma iphoyisa lomgwaqo, AKUMELE:

 • buyela emuva nganoma iyiphi ingxenye yomgwaqo omkhulu, kufaka phakathi imigwaqo eshelelayo, amahlombe aqinile nezindawo eziphuthumayo
• weqa indawo yokubhukha ephakathi
• shayela uphambene nokuhamba kwethrafikhi.

 Uma uphuthelwe indlela yakho yokuphuma noma uthathe umzila ongalungile, qhubeka uye endaweni yokuphuma elandelayo.

 Imithetho: Isigaba 35 se-RTA sika-1988 njengoba sichitshiyelwe yiSigaba 6 se-TMA; Imithethonqubo ye-MT(E&W)R 6, 8 kanye no-10; kanye neMithethonqubo ye-MT(S)R 4, 5, 7 kanye no-9.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 13. Imigwaqo Emikhulu (253 kuya ku-274)
description:
Ukuqondiswa komgwaqo (Imithetho 264 kuya ku-266)

 Umthetho 264

 Hlala emgqeni wesobunxele ngaphandle kokuthi weqe.

 Uma weqa, kufanele ubuyele emgqeni wesobunxele uma kuphephile ukwenza kanjalo (bheka futhi Imithetho 267 no-268).

 Qaphela izinsizakalo eziphuthumayo, izikhulu zomgwaqo, izisebenzi zokulungisa kanye nabanye abantu noma izimoto ezimiswe ehlombe eliqinile noma endaweni ephuthumayo. Uma ushayela emgwaqweni wesobunxele futhi kuphephile ukwenza kanjalo, kufanele ungene emgwaqweni oseduze ukuze udale isikhala esengeziwe phakathi kwemoto yakho nabantu kanye nezimoto ezimisiwe.

 Umthetho 265

 Umzila ongakwesokudla womgwaqo omkhulu onemizila emithathu noma ngaphezulu AKUMELE usetshenziswe, ngaphandle kwezimo ezibekiwe, uma ushayela:

 • noma iyiphi imoto edonsa i-trailer
• imoto yezimpahla enesisindo esiphezulu esingaphezu kwamathani angu-3.5 kodwa engadluli amathani angu-7.5 okudingeka ifakwe umkhawulo wejubane
• imoto yezimpahla enesisindo esiphezulu esingaphezu kwamathani angu-7.5
• imoto yabagibeli enesisindo esiphezulu esingaphezu kwamathani angu-7.5, eyakhiwe noma elungiselelwe ukuthwala abagibeli abangaphezu kwabayisishiyagalombili abahleli ngaphezu komshayeli
• imoto yabagibeli enesisindo esiphezulu esingaphezu kwamathani angu-7.5, eyakhiwe noma elungiselelwe ukuthwala abagibeli abangaphezu kwabayisishiyagalombili abahleli ngaphezu komshayeli, okudingeka ifakwe umkhawulo wejubane.

 Imithetho: Umthethonqubo we-MT(E&W)R 12, Umthethonqubo we-MT(E&W)(A)R, Umthethonqubo we-MT(S)R 11 kanye no-MT(S)(A)R.

 Umthetho 266

 Ukusondela endaweni yokuhlangana

 Bheka phambili izimpawu, izimpawu kanye nezimpawu zomgwaqo. Izimpawu zokuqondisa zingabekwa phezu komgwaqo. Uma kudingeka, kufanele ushintshe imizila ngaphambi komgwaqo ohlangana kuwo.

 Kwezinye izindawo ezihlangana kuwo, umzila ungaholela ngqo ngaphandle komgwaqo. Ngena kulowo mzila kuphela uma ufisa ukuhamba ngendlela eboniswe yizimpawu noma izimpawu zomgwaqo.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 13. Imigwaqo Emikhulu (253 kuya ku-274)
description:
Ukudlula (Imithetho 267 kuya ku-268)

 Umthetho 267

 Ungadluli ngaphandle kokuthi uqinisekile ukuthi kuphephile futhi kusemthethweni ukwenza kanjalo. dlula kuphela ngakwesokudla.

 Kufanele:

 • hlola izibuko zakho
• zinike isikhathi sokwahlulela ijubane ngendlela efanele
• qiniseka ukuthi umzila ozowujoyina ucacile ngokwanele ngaphambili nangemuva
• bheka ngokushesha eceleni endaweni engaboni ukuze uqinisekise indawo yemoto okungenzeka ukuthi inyamalele ekubukeni kwakho esibukweni
• khumbula ukuthi ithrafikhi ingase ivele ngemuva kwakho ngokushesha okukhulu. Hlola zonke izibuko zakho ngokucophelela futhi ubheke abagibeli bezithuthuthu. Uma kuphephile ukwenza kanjalo, bonisa isikhathi esiningi bese uphuma
• qiniseka ukuthi awuyiphazamisi imoto osuyidlulile
• qaphela kakhulu ebusuku futhi lapho kungabonakali kahle, lapho kunzima khona ukwahlulela isivinini kanye nebanga.

 Umthetho 268

 Ungadluli ngakwesobunxele noma uye emzileni ongakwesobunxele sakho ukuze udlule.

 Ezimweni eziminyene, lapho imizila yethrafikhi eseduze ihamba ngesivinini esifanayo, ithrafikhi emigqeni yesobunxele ngezinye izikhathi ingahamba ngokushesha kunethrafikhi eya kwesokudla. Kulezi zimo, ungahambisana nethrafikhi emzileni wakho noma ngabe lokhu kusho ukudlula ithrafikhi emzileni ongakwesokunene sakho.

 Ungangeni futhi uphume emigqeni ukuze udlule.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 13. Imigwaqo Emikhulu (253 kuya ku-274)
description:
Ihlombe eliqinile (Umthetho 269)

 Ihlombe eliqinile lapho likhona

 AKUMELE usebenzise ihlombe eliqinile ngaphandle kwalokhu:

 • esimweni esiphuthumayo
• lapho uqondiswa amaphoyisa
• lapho uqondiswa amaphoyisa
• lapho uqondiswa uphawu lomgwaqo.

 Ihlombe eliqinile lapho lisetshenziswa njengomzila owengeziwe

 Ihlombe eliqinile lisetshenziswa njengomzila owengeziwe kweminye imigwaqo emikhulu ngezikhathi zokuminyana.

 Uphawu olubomvu `X` noma olungenalutho ngaphezu kwehlombe eliqinile lusho ukuthi AKUMELE usebenzise ihlombe eliqinile ngaphandle uma kunesimo esiphuthumayo.

 Ungasebenzisa ihlombe eliqinile kuphela njengomzila owengeziwe uma umkhawulo wejubane uboniswe ngenhla kwalo.

 Lapho ihlombe eliqinile lisetshenziswa njengomzila owengeziwe, izindawo eziphuthumayo zinikezwa ukusetshenziswa esimweni esiphuthumayo (bheka uMthetho 270).

 Imithetho: Imithethonqubo ye-MT(E&W)R 5 kanye no-9; Imithethonqubo ye-MT(S)R 4 kanye no-8; kanye ne-RTA 1988 Izigaba 35 kanye no-36 njengoba zichitshiyelwe yi-TMA Isigaba 6.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 13. Imigwaqo Emikhulu (253 kuya ku-274)
description:
Ukuma (Imithetho 270 kuya ku-272)

 Umthetho 270

 Izindawo eziphuthumayo zitholakala eceleni kwemigwaqo emikhulu engenalo ihlombe eliqinile noma lapho ihlombe eliqinile lingasetshenziswa khona njengomzila owengeziwe (bheka Umthetho 269). KUMELE zisetshenziswe kuphela esimweni esiphuthumayo.

 Izindawo eziphuthumayo zimakwe ngezimpawu eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ezinophawu lwefoni lwe-SOS oluphuzi futhi zingase zibe nobuso obuphuzi.

 Landela izidingo nezeluleko ku:

 • Umthetho 277 uma imoto yakho iba nenkinga emgwaqweni omkhulu
• Umthetho 278 lapho ujoyina kabusha umgwaqo omkhulu usuka endaweni ephuthumayo.

 Imithetho: Umthethonqubo we-MT(E&W)R 9 njengoba uchitshiyelwe yi-MT(E&W)(A)(E)R, kanye ne-MT(S)R Umthethonqubo 8.

 Umthetho 271

 AKUMELE ume kunoma iyiphi indlela yezimoto, indawo ephuthumayo, ihlombe eliqinile, umgwaqo oshelelayo, indawo yokubhukha ephakathi noma onqenqemeni ngaphandle kwalokhu:

 • esimweni esiphuthumayo
• lapho utshelwa ukuthi wenze kanjalo ngamaphoyisa
• lapho utshelwa ukuthi wenze kanjalo ngamaphoyisa omgwaqo
• lapho utshelwa uphawu oluphuthumayo
• lapho utshelwa izimpawu zokukhanya ezibomvu ezikhanyayo.

 Ungami kunoma iyiphi ingxenye yomgwaqo omkhulu ukuze wenze noma wamukele izingcingo zeselula, ngaphandle uma kunesimo esiphuthumayo.

 Imithetho: Imithethonqubo ye-MT(E&W)R 7, 9, 10 kanye no-16 njengoba ichitshiyelwe yi-MT(E&W)(A)(E)R; Imithethonqubo ye-MT(S)R 6(1), 8, 9 kanye no-14; Isigaba 41 se-PRA kanye noHlelo 5(8); Izigaba 35, 36 kanye no-163 ze-RTA zango-1988 njengoba zichitshiyelwe yiSigaba 6 se-TMA; kanye noMthethonqubo we-CUR 110 njengoba zichitshiyelwe yi-CUR(A)(No. 4)R.

 Umthetho 272

 AKUMELE ugibe noma ubeke noma ubani phansi, noma uhambe emgwaqweni omkhulu, ngaphandle uma kunesimo esiphuthumayo.

 Imithetho: Isigaba se-RTRA 17 kanye noMthethonqubo we-MT(E&W)R 15.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 13. Imigwaqo Emikhulu (253 kuya ku-274)
description:
Ukushiya umgwaqo omkhulu (Imithetho 273 kuya ku-274)

 Umthetho 273

 Ngaphandle kokuthi izimpawu zibonisa ukuthi umzila uholela ngqo emgwaqweni omkhulu, ngokuvamile uzoshiya umgwaqo omkhulu ngomgwaqo oshelelayo ngakwesobunxele sakho.

 Kufanele:

 • qaphela izimpawu ezikwazisa ukuthi usondela ekuphumeni kwakho
• ngena emzileni ongakwesobunxele ngaphambi kokufika ekuphumeni kwakho
• bonisa uphawu lwesokunxele ngesikhathi esifanele futhi wehlise ijubane lakho emgwaqweni oshelelayo njengoba kudingeka.

 Umthetho 274

 Uma ushiya umgwaqo omkhulu noma usebenzisa umgwaqo oxhumanisayo phakathi kwemigwaqo emikhulu, isivinini sakho singase sibe phezulu kunalokho ocabanga ngakho. Isibonelo, isivinini esingu-50 mph singase sizwakale njengama-30 mph.

 Hlola i-speedometer yakho bese ulungisa isivinini sakho ngokufanele. Eminye imigwaqo eshelelayo kanye nemigwaqo exhumanisayo inamajika abukhali, ngakho kuzodingeka wehlise ijubane.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 14. Ukuwohloka kwezimoto kanye nezigameko (275 kuya ku-287)
description:
Indawo yokuphepha okulinganiselwe (Umthetho 275)

 Umthetho 275

 Uma udinga ukumisa imoto yakho ngenxa yokuphazamiseka noma isigameko, zama ukuma endaweni yokuphepha okulinganiselwe.

 Indawo yokuphepha okulinganiselwe yindawo lapho wena, abagibeli bakho kanye nemoto yakho ningenawo amathuba amaningi okuba sengozini yokuhamba kwezimoto.

 Indawo ephephile yokuma yindawo eyenzelwe ukupaka. Emigwaqweni emikhulu nakweminye imigwaqo enesivinini esikhulu, indawo ephephile yokuma yindawo yesevisi.

 Ezinye izindawo zokuphepha okulinganiselwe zifaka:

 • izindawo zokubeka izinto
• izindawo eziphuthumayo (bheka Umthetho 270)
• amahlombe aqinile (bheka Umthetho 269).

 Qaphela ukuthi amahlombe aqinile ahlinzeka ngokuvikeleka okuncane kunezinye izindawo zokuphepha okulinganiselwe ngoba aseduze kakhulu nezimoto ezinesivinini esikhulu.

 Lapho kungenzeka khona, wena nabagibeli bakho kufanele nihlale kude kakhulu nemoto yakho kanye nethrafikhi ehambayo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ithrafikhi ehambayo ingashayisana nemoto yakho bese iphoqa wena nabagibeli bakho.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 14. Ukuwohloka kwezimoto kanye nezigameko (275 kuya ku-287)
description:
Ukonakala (Umthetho 276)

 Umthetho 276

 Uma imoto yakho iphuka, cabanga kuqala ngabo bonke abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo. Susa imoto yakho emgwaqweni uma kungenzeka. Uma kubangela ukuvinjelwa, xwayisa abanye abantu ngezibane zakho zokuxwayisa ngengozi. Emini, gqoka izingubo ezinombala okhanyayo noma ezikhanyayo; ebusuku noma lapho kungabonakali kahle, gqoka izingubo ezikhanyayo. Beka unxantathu wokuxwayisa okungenani amamitha angu-45 (147 izinyawo ) ngemuva kwemoto ephukile ohlangothini olufanayo lomgwaqo, noma sebenzisa amanye amadivayisi okuxwayisa avunyelwe uma etholakala. Qaphela kakhulu lapho ubeka noma ulanda amadivayisi okuxwayisa, futhi ungalokothi uwasebenzise emigwaqweni emikhulu. Uma kungenzeka, gcina izibani zakho ezisemaceleni zivuliwe lapho kumnyama noma lapho kungabonakali kahle. Ungami noma uvumele omunye umuntu ame phakathi kwemoto yakho nezimoto ezizayo. Ebusuku noma lapho kungabonakali kahle, ungami lapho ungavimbela abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo ukuthi babone izibani zakho.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 14. Ukuwohloka kwezimoto kanye nezigameko (275 kuya ku-287)
subcategory: Imithetho eyengeziwe yemigwaqo emikhulu (imithetho 277 kuya ku-279)
description:
Imithetho eyengeziwe yemigwaqo emikhulu (Imithetho 277 kuya ku-279)

 Umthetho 277

 Uma imoto yakho iba nenkinga, shiya indlela yemoto endaweni yokuphuma elandelayo noma ungene endaweni yesevisi uma kungenzeka (bheka Umthetho 275 ukuze uthole izindawo zokuphepha okulinganiselwe). Uma ungakwazi, landela lesi siqondiso.

 Hamba kwesobunxele

 • hamba uye emzileni wesobunxele
• ngena endaweni yezimo eziphuthumayo noma ehlombe eliqinile uma ungakwazi
• hamba uye kude ngakwesobunxele ngangokunokwenzeka, ushiye isikhala sokuphuma emotweni yakho futhi amasondo akho ephendukele kwesobunxele
• uma ungakwazi, hamba uye ngale kocingo oluphuthumayo
• vula izibani zakho zokuxwayisa ngengozi
• uma kumnyama noma ukubonakala kukubi, sebenzisa izibani eziseceleni.

 Zivikele

 Phuma emotweni yakho eceleni kakhulu kwethrafikhi uma kuphephile futhi kungenzeka ukwenza kanjalo, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi abagibeli benza okufanayo.

 Uma ningakwazi nobabili ukuhambisa imoto yenu emzileni wesobunxele noma endaweni ephephile (bheka uMthetho 275) futhi niphume ngokuphephile ukuze niphume kahle emotweni yenu nasekuhambeni kwethrafikhi, kufanele:

 • nihlale emotweni yenu
• nigcine amabhande ezihlalo zenu nezibani zokuxwayisa ngengozi zivuliwe
• shayela u-999 ngokushesha bese ucela amaphoyisa. Ngaphandle kwalokho, cindezela inkinobho ye-SOS yemoto yakho, uma inayo, bese ucela amaphoyisa.

 Uma ungaphuma emotweni ngokuphephile:

 • gqoka izingubo ezibonakala kakhulu uma unayo futhi iseduze kakhulu
• phuma ngemuva kwesithiyo sokuphepha lapho ikhona khona, kodwa qaphela izingozi ezingabonakali njengokuwa okungazelelwe, umhlabathi ongalingani noma imfucumfucu
• UNGAMI lapho imoto yakho ingaphoqeleka khona ukuthi ingene kuwe uma ithrafikhi ehambayo ishayisana nayo
 • UNGABUYI emotweni yakho, noma ngabe lina, kubanda noma kumnyama
 • hlala uqaphile futhi uqaphele izimoto noma imfucumfucu eza kuwe
 • gcina abagibeli kude nomgwaqo futhi ugcine izingane zilawulwa
 • UNGAZAMI ukulungisa imoto yakho
 • UNGABEKI unxantathu oyisixwayiso endleleni
 • Izilwane KUMELE zigcinwe emotweni noma, uma kunesimo esiphuthumayo, zilawulwe onqenqemeni.

 Thola usizo

• sebenzisa ucingo lwamahhala oluphuthumayo ukuthola iseluleko nosizo
 • xhumana nensizakalo yokubuyisela umonakalo
 • hlala ubhekene nomgwaqo ngenkathi ukhuluma ukuze uhlale wazi ngezimoto noma imfucumfucu eza kuwe
 • tshela insizakalo uma ungumshayeli osengozini, njengomuntu okhubazekile, osekhulile noma ohamba wedwa
 • linda kude nemoto yakho kanye nethrafikhi ehambayo, ngemuva kwesithiyo sokuphepha lapho kukhona khona
 • uma ungakwazi ukuphuma emotweni yakho noma ungakami eduze kocingo oluphuthumayo lwamahhala, shayela u-999 ngokushesha bese ucela amaphoyisa. Ngaphandle kwalokho, cindezela inkinobho ye-SOS yemoto yakho, uma inayo, bese ucela amaphoyisa.

 Ukuxhumana nendawo okuyo nezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo

 • i-eCall: cindezela inkinobho ye-SOS uma imoto yakho inayo
• uhlelo lokusebenza: sebenzisa uhlelo lokusebenza lokumapha ucingo oluphathwayo
• uphawu lweposi lomaka noma lwendawo yomshayeli: caphuna izinombolo nezinhlamvu eziboniswe ezingosini zomaka noma izimpawu zendawo yomshayeli ezitholakala eceleni komgwaqo.

 Imithetho: Umthethonqubo we-MT(E&W)R 14 kanye noMthethonqubo we-MT(S)R 12.

 Umthetho 278

 Ukuze uphinde ujoyine umgwaqo ngemuva kokuphazamiseka kwehlombe eliqinile, yakha isivinini, ubonise futhi uqaphele igebe eliphephile emotweni. Qaphela ukuthi izimoto, izithiyo noma imfucumfucu zingase zibe khona ehlombe eliqinile.

 Ukuze uphinde ujoyine usuka endaweni ephuthumayo, KUMELE usebenzise ucingo oluphuthumayo olunikeziwe futhi ulandele iseluleko somqhubi. Umzila kungadingeka uvalwe ukuze ukwazi ukujoyina umgwaqo ngokuphephile.

 Umthetho: RTA 1988 Isigaba 36.

 Umthetho 279

 Abashayeli abakhubazekile

 Uma unesifo sokukhubazeka esikuvimbela ukuthi ulandele iseluleko esiseMithethweni 277 no-278, kufanele:

 • uvule izibani zakho zokuxwayisa ngengozi
• uhlale emotweni yakho futhi ugcine ibhande lakho lesihlalo livuliwe
• shayela u-999 ngokushesha bese ucela amaphoyisa. Ngaphandle kwalokho, cindezela inkinobho ye-SOS yemoto yakho, uma inayo, bese ucela amaphoyisa.

 Uma uyisithulu, ungezwa kahle noma unenkinga yokukhuluma, kunconywa ukuthi ubhalisele isevisi yombhalo engu-999 ku-emergencySMS.net ngaphambi kokuthatha uhambo.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 14. Ukuwohloka kwezimoto kanye nezigameko (275 kuya ku-287)
description:
Izithiyo (Umthetho 280)

 Umthetho 280

 Uma kukhona okuwela emotweni kuwela emgwaqweni omkhulu noma komunye umgwaqo ohamba ngesivinini esikhulu, UNGASUSI lokho okuvimbile wena. Yima endaweni ephephile (bheka Umthetho 275) bese ushayela izinsizakalo eziphuthumayo ku-999.

 Kweminye imigwaqo, kufanele ususe kuphela into evimbile uma kuphephile ukwenza kanjalo.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 14. Ukuwohloka kwezimoto kanye nezigameko (275 kuya ku-287)
description:
Izigameko (Imithetho 281 kuya ku-283)

 Umthetho 281

 Izimpawu zokuxwayisa noma izibani ezikhanyayo

 Uma ubona izimoto eziphuthumayo noma ezisekela isigameko zibonisa izibani ezikhanyayo kude, qaphela ukuthi kungase kube nesigameko esingaphambili (bheka Umthetho 219). Kufanele wehlise ijubane futhi ulungele ukuhamba ngokuphepha uye komunye umzila noma ume.

 Abasebenzi bezimo eziphuthumayo, izikhulu zomgwaqo kanye nabasebenzi bokulungisa izimoto kungadingeka basebenze endleleni; isibonelo, ukubhekana nodoti noma ukushayisana noma ukwenza izithiyo zomgwaqo ezigobhozayo.

 KUMELE ulandele noma yiziphi iziqondiso ezinikezwa ngamaphoyisa noma izikhulu zomgwaqo mayelana nokuthi ungadlula yini ngokuphephile kulesi sigameko noma isiphazamiso.

 Imithetho: RTA 1988 Izigaba 35 no-163 njengoba zichitshiyelwe yi-TMA Isigaba 6.

 Umthetho 282

 Uma udlula endaweni yesigameko, hlala uqaphele izingozi ezifana nemfucumfucu noma izimoto ezihamba kancane. Ungehlisi ijubane ngokungadingekile; isibonelo, uma isigameko sikwelinye icala lendlela yezimoto ezimbili.

 Gxila emgwaqweni ongaphambili lapho udlula isigameko. Ukunganaki kungabangela esinye isigameko, ukushayisana noma ukuminyana (bheka futhi uMthetho 283).

 UMthetho 283

 Uma uhilelekile esigamekweni noma engozini, noma yeka ukunikeza usizo:

 • uma kungenzeka, yeka endaweni ephephile (bheka uMthetho 275)
• sebenzisa izibani zakho zokuxwayisa ngengozi ukuxwayisa abanye abagibeli
• gqoka izingubo ezibonakala kakhulu uma unazo
• cela abashayeli ukuthi bacime izinjini zabo
• cela abashayeli nabagibeli ukuthi bayeke ukubhema
• xhumana nezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo ku-999 futhi unikeze imininingwane egcwele yendawo yesigameko kanye nanoma yibaphi abalimele. Sebenzisa ucingo oluphuthumayo, ucingo oluphathwayo noma inkinobho ye-SOS yemoto yakho, uma inayo. Bheka uMthetho 277 ukuze uthole indlela yokubona indawo okuyo emgwaqweni omkhulu noma komunye umgwaqo ohamba ngesivinini esikhulu
 • susa abantu abangalimele ezimotweni baye endaweni ephephile (bheka uMthetho 275)
 • UNGASUSI abantu abalimele ezimotweni zabo ngaphandle kokuthi basengozini esheshayo
 • UNGASUSI isigqoko somshayeli wesithuthuthu ngaphandle kokuthi kubalulekile futhi uqeqeshwe ukwenza kanjalo
 • lungela ukunikeza usizo lokuqala (bheka `Usizo lokuqala emgwaqweni` kanye `namawebhusayithi awusizo`)
 • hlala endaweni yesehlakalo kuze kufike izinsizakalo eziphuthumayo
 • lungela ukushintshana ngemininingwane (bheka uMthetho 286).

 Uma uhileleke kunoma yisiphi esinye isimo esiphuthumayo sezokwelapha, xhumana nezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo ngendlela efanayo.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 14. Ukuwohloka kwezimoto kanye nezigameko (275 kuya ku-287)
subcategory: Izigameko ezihilela izimpahla eziyingozi (imithetho 284 kuya ku-285)
description:
Izigameko ezihilela izimpahla eziyingozi (Imithetho 284 kuya ku-285)

 Umthetho 284

 Izimoto ezithwala izimpahla eziyingozi emaphaketheni zizophawulwa ngamapuleti akhanyayo anombala ophuzi okhanyayo.

 Amathangi omgwaqo kanye nezimoto ezithwala izitsha zamathangi ezimpahla eziyingozi zizoba namapuleti esixwayiso sengozi (bheka ‘Izimpawu zezimoto’).

 Umthetho 285

 Uma kwenzeka isigameko esihilela imoto equkethe izimpahla eziyingozi, landela iseluleko esikuMthetho 283 futhi, ikakhulukazi:

 • cima izinjini futhi UNGABHEMI
• hlala kude nemoto. Ungalingeki ukuzama ukusindisa abalimele, njengoba nawe ungaba yisisulu
• shayela izinsizakalo eziphuthumayo futhi unikeze ulwazi oluningi ngangokunokwenzeka mayelana namalebula nezimpawu emotweni
• UNGASEBENZISI ifoni ephathekayo eduze kwemoto ethwele imithwalo evuthayo.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 14. Ukuwohloka kwezimoto kanye nezigameko (275 kuya ku-287)
description:
Imibhalo (Imithetho 286 kuya ku-287)

 Umthetho 286

 Uma uhilelekile engozini ebangela umonakalo noma ukulimala komunye umuntu, imoto, isilwane noma impahla, KUMELE:

 • ume. Uma kungenzeka, ume endaweni ephephile (bheka Umthetho 275)
• unikeze igama lakho nekheli, igama nekheli lomnikazi wemoto, kanye nenombolo yokubhalisa yemoto kunoma ubani onezizathu ezizwakalayo zokuyifuna
• uma unganikezi igama lakho nekheli ngesikhathi sengozi, bika ingozi emaphoyiseni ngokushesha okukhulu futhi, kunoma yikuphi, zingakapheli amahora angama-24.

 Umthetho: RTA 1988 Isigaba 170.

 Umthetho 287

 Uma omunye umuntu elimele futhi ungalethi isitifiketi sakho somshuwalense ngesikhathi sengozi ephoyiseni noma kunoma ubani onezizathu ezizwakalayo zokusicela, KUMELE:

 • ubike ingozi emaphoyiseni ngokushesha okukhulu futhi, noma kunjalo, zingakapheli amahora angama-24
• ulethe isitifiketi sakho somshuwalense emaphoyiseni zingakapheli izinsuku eziyisikhombisa.

 Umthetho: RTA 1988 Isigaba 170.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 15. Imisebenzi yomgwaqo, izindawo zokuwela ezilinganayo kanye nemigwaqo yesitimela (288 kuya ku-307)
description:
Imisebenzi yomgwaqo (Umthetho 288)

 Umthetho 288

 Uma kuboniswa uphawu oluthi ‘Imisebenzi Yomgwaqo Ngaphambili’, qaphela kakhulu futhi ubheke izimpawu ezengeziwe ezinikeza imiyalelo ecacile. Qaphela zonke izimpawu, njengoba zikhona ukuze uphephe futhi uvikele abasebenzi bomgwaqo.

 AKUMELE weqe umkhawulo wesivinini esiphezulu sesikhashana.

 Gcina ibanga eliphephile ukusuka emotweni engaphambili (bheka Umthetho 126).

 Sebenzisa izibuko zakho bese ungena emzileni ofanele wemoto yakho ngesikhathi esifanele futhi njengoba izimpawu ziqondisa.

 Ungashintsha imizila ukuze udlule ithrafikhi emugqeni.

 Qaphela kakhulu eduze kwabagibeli bamabhayisikili nabagibeli bamabhayisikili, njengoba besengozini yokushelela phezu kwenhlabathi, udaka noma olunye udoti emisebenzini yomgwaqo.

 Lapho imizila ivinjelwe ngenxa yomsebenzi womgwaqo, hlangana ngokulandelana (bheka uMthetho 134).

 Ungashayeli endaweni ephawulwe ngamakhoni omgwaqo.

 Qaphela izimoto ezingenayo noma eziphumayo endaweni yokusebenza. Lapho izimoto zihamba emgwaqweni futhi zibonisa izibani zesixwayiso eziphuzi, shiya isikhala esengeziwe bese ulindela ukuthi zehlise ijubane noma ziphenduke indawo yokusebenza.

 Gxila emgwaqweni ongaphambili, hhayi emisebenzini yomgwaqo.

 Khumbula ukuthi umgwaqo ongaphambili ungase uvinjelwe imisebenzi noma ukuhamba kancane noma ukunyakaza okungami.

 Umthetho: Isigaba 16 se-RTRA.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 15. Imisebenzi yomgwaqo, izindawo zokuwela ezilinganayo kanye nemigwaqo yesitimela (288 kuya ku-307)
subcategory: Imithetho eyengeziwe yemigwaqo enesivinini esikhulu (imithetho 289 kuya ku-290)
englishSubcategory: Additional rules for high-speed roads (rules 289 to 290)
description:
Imithetho eyengeziwe yemigwaqo yesivinini esikhulu (Imithetho 289 kuya ku-290)

 Umthetho 289

 Qaphela kakhulu imigwaqo emikhulu kanye neminye imigwaqo yesivinini esikhulu.

 Imizila ingase ivalwe ukuze ithrafikhi ihambe futhi kungasebenza umkhawulo wejubane ophansi.

 Izimoto zomsebenzi zingasetshenziswa ukuvala imizila noma imigwaqo yesitimela ukuze kulungiswe. Lapho kuboniswa khona izimpawu ezinkulu ezithi `Hlala Kwesobunxele` noma `Hlala Kwesokudla` ngemuva, KUMELE udlule imoto yokusebenza ohlangothini olubonisiwe. Ungabuyeli emzileni ovaliwe uze ubone ukuthi kuphephile ukwenza kanjalo.

 Lapho imoto ibonisa uphawu oluthi `ISIMOTO ESIKHULU AKUKHO KUDLULA`, AKUMELE udlule imoto.

 Umcibisholo wokukhanya okhanyayo noma obomvu othi `X` ungasetshenziswa futhi ukwenza imoto yokusebenza ibonakale kakhulu kude futhi unikeze abashayeli isixwayiso sangaphambilini.

 Imithetho: Isigaba 36 se-RTA sika-1988, Umthethonqubo 3 we-TSRGD kanye noHlelo 13.

 Umthetho 290

 Imisebenzi yomgwaqo ingaqukatha izici ezidinga ukunakekelwa okwengeziwe.

 Imizila emincane

 Imizila ingaba mincane kunokujwayelekile futhi izophawulwa ngama-stud noma izimpawu zomgwaqo zesikhashana. Gcina ibanga eliphephile ukusuka emotweni engaphambili (bheka Umthetho 126) futhi uqiniseke ukuthi ubona kahle imiphetho yomzila ongaphambili.

 Izinhlelo ze-contraflow

 Ohlelweni lwe-contraflow, ungahamba ngomzila omncane kunokujwayelekile ngaphandle kwesithiyo esihlala njalo phakathi kwakho nethrafikhi ezayo.

 Ekuqaleni nasekupheleni kwe-contraflow, yehlisa ijubane bese wandisa ibanga ukusuka emotweni engaphambili ngoba izinguquko ku-camber yomgwaqo zingathinta ukuzinza kwemoto.

 Iseluleko sokuphuka kwezimoto

 Uma imoto yakho iphuka emsebenzini womgwaqo, landela Imithetho 275, 277 kanye no-278, kodwa qaphela ukuthi izindawo eziphawulwe ngamakhoni ziqukethe izingozi ezinkulu.

 Lapho kutholakala khona, hambisa imoto yakho endaweni yokuphephela yomsebenzi womgwaqo esayiniwe. Izimpawu zibonisa lapho kunikezwa khona izinsizakalo zokubuyisa ezinikezelwe.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 15. Imisebenzi yomgwaqo, izindawo zokuwela ezilinganayo kanye nemigwaqo yesitimela (288 kuya ku-307)
description:
Ukuwela ngezitezi (Imithetho 291 kuya ku-299)

 Umthetho 291

 Ukuwela ngezitezi yilapho umgwaqo uwela khona umzila wesitimela noma we-tramway. Sondela bese uwuwela ngokucophelela.

 Ungalokothi ushayele endaweni yokuwela kuze kube yilapho umgwaqo usucacile ngakolunye uhlangothi, futhi ungasondeli kakhulu emotweni engaphambili. Ungalokothi ume noma upake endaweni yokuwela noma eduze kwayo.

 Umthetho 292

 Imigqa kagesi edlulayo

 Kuyingozi ukuthinta imigqa kagesi ephezu kwentaba. KUMELE ulalele izimpawu zomgwaqo ezixwayisayo eziphakeme futhi akufanele uqhubeke nomzila wesitimela uma imoto yakho ithinta noma yiluphi uthango lokuphakama noma izinsimbi.

 Indawo evulekile ivame ukuba ngamamitha ama-5 (16 izinyawo 6 amayintshi), kodwa ingaba ngaphansi.

 Imithetho: Isigaba 36 se-RTA sika-1988 kanye neShejuli 2 ye-TSRGD, Ingxenye 7.

 Umthetho 293

 Izindawo zokuwela ezilawulwayo

 Izindawo eziningi zokuwela ezilawulwayo zinezimpawu zokukhanya kwethrafikhi ezinokukhanya okuphuzi okuqinile, izibani ezimbili zokuma ezibomvu ezikhanyayo (bheka `Izimpawu zokukhanya ezilawula ithrafikhi` kanye `nezimpawu zethrafikhi`) kanye ne-alamu ezwakalayo yabahamba ngezinyawo. Zingase zibe nezithiyo ezigcwele, izithiyo eziyingxenye noma zingabi nazo izithiyo.

 • KUMELE uhlale ulalela izibani zokuma ezibomvu ezikhanyayo
• KUMELE ume ngemuva komugqa omhlophe ngaphesheya komgwaqo
• qhubeka uma usuvele uwele umugqa omhlophe lapho ukukhanya okuphuzi kukhanya
• ungabuyeli emuva ungene noma udlule endaweni yokuwela elawulwayo
• KUMELE ulinde uma isitimela sidlula futhi izibani ezibomvu ziqhubeka nokukhanya, njengoba esinye isitimela sizodlula maduze
• nqamula kuphela lapho izibani zicima futhi izithiyo zivuleka
• ungalokothi uzulazule eduze kwezithiyo eziyingxenye; zehla ngokuzenzakalelayo ngoba isitimela sisondela
• lapho kuwela ngaphandle kwezithiyo, isitimela sisondela lapho izibani zibonakala.

 Imithetho: RTA 1988 Isigaba 36 kanye ne-TSRGD Isheduli 14, Izingxenye 1 kanye no-4.

 Umthetho 294

 Izingcingo zesitimela

 Uma ushayela imoto enkulu noma ehamba kancane, imoto ende, ephansi esengozini yokuma, noma ulusa izilwane, isitimela singafika ngaphambi kokuba uphume lapho kuwela.

 KUMELE ulalele noma yiluphi uphawu olukutshela ukuthi usebenzise ucingo lwesitimela ukuze uthole imvume yokuwela. KUMELE futhi ushayele ucingo lapho ungaphandle lapho kuwela uma uceliwe ukwenza kanjalo.

 Imithetho: Isigaba 36 se-RTA sika-1988 kanye neShejuli 9, Izingxenye 7 no-8.

 Umthetho 295

 Ukuwela ngaphandle kwezibani zomgwaqo

 Izimoto kufanele zime futhi zilinde esivimbelweni noma esangweni lapho liqala ukuvala. Ungaweli kuze kube yilapho isivimbelo noma isango livuleka.

 Umthetho 296

 Amasango noma izithiyo ezisetshenziswa ngumsebenzisi

 Ezinye izithiyo zinezimpawu `zokuma` kanye nezibani ezincane ezibomvu neziluhlaza. AKUMELE uwele lapho isibani esibomvu sibonisa; wela kuphela lapho isibani esiluhlaza sivuliwe.

 Uma wela nemoto, kufanele:

 • uvule amasango noma izithiyo ezinhlangothini zombili zokuwela
• hlola ukuthi isibani esiluhlaza sisavuliwe bese wela ngokushesha
• vala amasango noma izithiyo uma usuphumile endaweni yokuwela.

 Imithetho: TWA 1992 Isigaba 55 kanye ne-PC(SB)R 1996.

 Umthetho 297

 Uma kungekho zibani, landela inqubo eMthethweni 296. Yima, bheka macala omabili bese ulalela ngaphambi kokuwela.

 Uma kukhona ucingo lwesitimela, lusebenzise njalo ukuxhumana nomqhubi wesignali futhi uqiniseke ukuthi kuphephile ukuwela. Yazisa umqhubi wesignali futhi uma usuphumile endaweni yokuwela.

 Umthetho 298

 Izindawo zokuwela ezivulekile

 Izindawo zokuwela ezivulekile azinamasango, izithiyo, abasizi noma izibani zomgwaqo, kodwa zinophawu oluthi `Give Way`. Bheka macala omabili, lalela futhi uqiniseke ukuthi akukho sitimela esiza ngaphambi kokuwela.

 Umthetho 299

 Izehlakalo kanye nokuphahlazeka kwezimoto

 Uma imoto yakho iphuka noma unengozi endaweni yokuwela, kufanele:

 • khipha wonke umuntu emotweni bese uphuma endaweni yokuwela ngokushesha
• sebenzisa ucingo lwesitimela, uma lukhona, ukutshela umqhubi wesignali bese ulandela imiyalelo enikeziwe
• susa imoto endaweni yokuwela uma kunesikhathi ngaphambi kokuba isitimela sifike
• uma i-alamu ikhala noma ukukhanya okuphuzi kukhanya, shiya imoto bese uphuma endaweni yokuwela ngokushesha.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 15. Imisebenzi yomgwaqo, izindawo zokuwela ezilinganayo kanye nemigwaqo yesitimela (288 kuya ku-307)
description:
Ama-tramway (Imithetho 300 kuya ku-307)

 Umthetho 300

 AKUMELE ungene emgwaqweni, emzileni noma komunye umzila obekelwe ama-tramway. Qaphela kakhulu lapho ama-tramway egijima khona emgwaqweni.

 Gwema ukushayela ngqo phezu kwezitimela. Qaphela lapho ama-tramway eshiya khona umgwaqo omkhulu ukuze angene emzileni obekelwe wona, futhi uqiniseke ukuthi awuwalandeli.

 Ububanzi obusetshenziswa ama-tramway buvame ukuboniswa yimizila yama-tramway ephawulwe ngemigqa emhlophe, amachashazi aphuzi noma uhlobo oluhlukile lomgwaqo.

 Izimpawu ezimise okwedayimane kanye nezimpawu zokukhanya ezimhlophe zinikeza imiyalelo kubashayeli bama-tramway kuphela.

 Umthetho: Izigaba ze-RTRA 5 no-8.

 Umthetho 301

 Qaphela kakhulu lapho umzila uwela khona usuka kolunye uhlangothi lomgwaqo uye kolunye, nalapho umgwaqo uncipha khona futhi imizila isondela eduze komgwaqo.

 Abashayeli be-tram bavame ukuba nezimpawu zabo zomgwaqo futhi bangavunyelwa ukuhamba uma ungekho.

 Njalo vumela ama-tram ukuthi angene. Ungazami ukubagijimisa noma ukubadlula noma ukubadlula ngaphakathi ngaphandle kokuthi basesitobhini se-tram noma bemiswe izimpawu ze-tram futhi kukhona umzila we-tram oqokiwe ukuze udlule.

 Umthetho 302

 AKUMELE upake lapho imoto yakho ingavimba ama-tram noma iphoqe abanye abashayeli ukuba bawavimbele.

 Ungami kunoma iyiphi ingxenye yomzila we-tram, ngaphandle kwase-bay eqokiwe enikeziwe eceleni komzila futhi ikude nomzila. Uma usebenzisa i-bay enjalo, qiniseka ukuthi yonke ingxenye yemoto yakho ingaphandle kwendlela ye-tram echazwe ngenhla.

 Khumbula ukuthi i-tram ayikwazi ukuqondisa i-bay.

 Umthetho: Izigaba 5 no-8 ze-RTRA.

 Umthetho 303

 Isitimela siyama

 Lapho isitimela sima khona epulatifomu ephakathi noma eceleni komgwaqo, KUMELE ulandele umzila oboniswa izimpawu zomgwaqo kanye nezimpawu.

 Ezitobhini ezingenazo iziteshi, AKUMELE ushayele phakathi kwesitimela kanye nomgwaqo ongakwesobunxele lapho isitimela sima ukuze sithathe abagibeli.

 Uma kungekho ndlela ehlukile esayiniwe, ungayidluli isitimela. Linda kuze kube yilapho sisuka.

 Umthetho: Izigaba 5 no-8 ze-RTRA.

 Umthetho 304

 Qaphela abahamba ngezinyawo, ikakhulukazi izingane, abagijimayo ukuze babambe isitimela esisondela esitobhini.

 Umthetho 305

 Njalo nikeza ama-tram kuqala, ikakhulukazi uma ekhomba ukuthi asuke ezitobhini, ngaphandle kokuthi kungaba okuphephile ukwenza kanjalo.

 Khumbula ukuthi ama-tram angase athwale inani elikhulu labagibeli abamile abangalimala uma i-tram kufanele ime endaweni ephuthumayo.

 Qaphela abantu abehla ebhasini noma e-tram bese bewela umgwaqo.

 Umthetho 306

 Bonke abasebenzisi bomgwaqo, ikakhulukazi abagibeli bamabhayisikili nabagibeli bamabhayisikili, kufanele baqaphele kakhulu lapho behamba eduze noma bewela imizila ye-tram, ikakhulukazi lapho imizila imanzi.

 Qaphela ngokukhethekile lapho bewela imizila ngama-engeli angajulile, emajikeni nasezinhlakeni. Kuphephile ukuwela imizila ngqo ngama-engeli angakwesokudla.

 Abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo kufanele baqaphele ukuthi abagibeli bamabhayisikili nabagibeli bamabhayisikili bangadinga isikhala esengeziwe ukuze bawele imizila ngokuphepha.

 Umthetho 307

 Izintambo zikagesi ezihamba ngaphezulu

 Izintambo eziphezulu ze-tramway zivame ukuba ngamamitha angu-5.8 ngaphezu komgwaqo kodwa zingase zibe ngaphansi. Ngaphambi kokushayela ngaphansi kocingo oluhamba phezulu, qiniseka ukuthi kunesikhala esanele semoto yakho, okuhlanganisa noma yimuphi umthwalo ewuthwele.

 Abashayeli bezimoto ezinama-crane anwebekayo, ama-boom, imishini yokugoqa noma eminye imishini yokuphakama okuguquguqukayo kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi imishini yehlisiwe ngokuphelele.

 Lapho izintambo eziphezulu zingaphansi kwamamitha angu-5.8, kuzovezwa izimpawu zokuphakama ezifana nezimpawu `zebhuloho eliphansi`. Qaphela ngokucophelela futhi ulalele izikhala eziboniswe kula mapuleti.

 Uma ungaqiniseki ukuthi imoto yakho ingadlula ngokuphephile ngaphansi kwezintambo, xhumana namaphoyisa endawo noma umqhubi we-tramway. Ungalokothi uthathe ithuba, njengoba ukwenza kanjalo kungaba yingozi kakhulu.

description:
Izimpawu zokukhanya kwethrafikhi

 OKUBOMVU kusho `Ukuma`. Linda ngemuva komugqa wokuma endleleni yemoto.

 OKUBOMVU NO-AMBER nakho kusho `Ukuma`. Ungadluli noma uqale kuze kuvele i-GREEN.

 OKUBOMVU kusho ukuthi ungaqhubeka uma indlela icacile. Qaphela ngokukhethekile uma uhlose ukujika ngakwesobunxele noma kwesokudla, bese unikeza abahamba ngezinyawo abawela indlela.

 OKUBOMVU kusho `Ukuma` emgqeni wokuma. Ungaqhubeka kuphela uma i-AMBER ivela ngemva kokuthi uwele umugqa wokuma noma uma useduze kakhulu nawo kangangokuthi ukuma kungabangela ingozi.

 UMCIBISHOLO OLUHLAZA unganikezwa ngaphezu kwesignali eluhlaza egcwele uma ukunyakaza endaweni ethile kuvunyelwe ngaphambi noma ngemva kwesigaba esiluhlaza esigcwele. Uma indlela icacile, ungaqhubeka kuphela endaweni eboniswe umcibisholo. Ungakwenza lokhu kungakhathaliseki ukuthi yiziphi ezinye izibani eziboniswayo.

 Izimpawu zokukhanya ezimhlophe zingase zinikezwe kuma-tram.

 Izibani ezibomvu ezikhanyayo

 Okunye, izibani ezibomvu ezikhanyayo zisho ukuthi KUMELE UME. Lezi zingasetshenziswa ezindaweni zokuwela ezilinganayo, amabhuloho okuphakamisa, ama-airfield, iziteshi zomlilo nakwezinye izindawo.

 Izimpawu zokulawula umzila

 • umcibisholo oluhlaza: umzila uyatholakala kuthrafikhi ebheke uphawu
• iziphambano ezibomvu: umzila uvaliwe kuthrafikhi ebheke uphawu
• umcibisholo omhlophe ovundlile: shintsha imizila ohlangothini olubonisiwe.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 16. Izimpawu zokukhanya ezilawula ithrafikhi
description:
Izimpawu zomgwaqo omkhulu

 Lezi zibonakaliso zisetshenziswa nakweminye imigwaqo yesivinini esikhulu.

 Izibani ezibomvu ezikhanyayo kanye no-`X` obomvu

 AKUMELE uqhubekele phambili emzileni ongaphansi ko-`X` obomvu. Umzila uvaliwe.

 Umcibisholo omhlophe ovundlile

 Shintsha imizila ngendlela ekhonjiswe umcibisholo.

 Ukubonakala okunciphile phambili

 Isibonakaliso esibonisa `Inkungu` sixwayisa ngokubonakala okunciphile phambili.

 Umzila ongaphambili uvaliwe

 Umdwebo obonisa ukuphela komzila uxwayisa ukuthi umzila ongaphambili uvaliwe futhi ukhombisa indlela lapho ithrafikhi kufanele ihambe khona.

 Isivinini esiphezulu sesikhashana esinconywayo kanye nomyalezo wolwazi

 Isivinini esiboniswa ngaphandle kwesiyingi esibomvu, esihambisana nezibani eziphuzi ezikhanyayo, sicebisa isivinini esiphezulu sesikhashana. Umlayezo ofana nokuthi ‘INGOZI ENGAPHAMBILI’ ungase uchaze ingozi.

 Umzila ovaliwe, umkhawulo wesivinini esiphezulu ophoqelekile wesikhashana kanye nomyalezo wolwazi

 U-`X` obomvu usho ukuthi AKUFANELE ungene noma uqhubeke emzileni ongaphansi kwawo. Imicibisholo ikhombisa imizila ehlala ivulekile. Isivinini esiboniswa ngaphakathi kwendilinga ebomvu siwumkhawulo wesivinini esiphezulu ophoqelekile wesikhashana. Umlayezo wolwazi, njengokuthi ‘Ukuvimbela’, ungase ukhombe ingozi.

 Isivinini esiphezulu sesikhashana esinconywayo

 Isivinini esiboniswa ngaphandle kwendilinga ebomvu futhi esihambisana nezibani ezikhanyayo ze-amber yisivinini esiphezulu sesikhashana esinconywayo.

 Ukuphela komkhawulo

 Isignali ebonisa ‘Ukuphela’ ikhombisa ukuphela komkhawulo.

description:
Izimpawu zesikhombisi sokukhomba

 • isibonakaliso sokukhomba sokukhomba kwesokudla sisho ukuthi: ‘Ngihlose ukuphuma ngiye kwesokudla noma ngijike kwesokudla’
• isibonakaliso sokukhomba sokukhomba kwesobunxele sisho ukuthi: ‘Ngihlose ukungena kwesobunxele, ngijike kwesobunxele noma ngime kwesobunxele’.

 Lezi zimpawu akufanele zisetshenziswe ngaphandle kwezinjongo ezichazwe.

 Izimpawu zokukhanya kwebhuleki

 Izibani zebhuleki ezikhanyisiwe zisho ukuthi: ‘Ngifaka amabhuleki’.

 Lesi sibonisi akufanele sisetshenziswe ngaphandle kwenhloso echazwe.

 Izimpawu zokukhanya ezibuyisela emuva

 Isibani esikhanyayo esimhlophe esibuyisela emuva sisho ukuthi: ‘Ngihlose ukubuyela emuva’.

 Lesi sibonisi akufanele sisetshenziswe ngaphandle kwenhloso echazwe.

 Izimpawu zengalo

 Izimpawu zengalo zingasetshenziswa lapho izinkomba zokuqondisa zingasetshenziswa noma lapho kudingeka ukuqinisa izimpawu zokuqondisa kanye nezibani zokuma. Zingasetshenziswa futhi ngabagibeli bamabhayisikili abaphambili kanye nabantu abaphethe amahhashi.

 Izimpawu zengalo zingabonisa:

 • `Ngihlose ukungena ngakwesobunxele noma ngijike ngakwesobunxele`
• `Ngihlose ukuphuma ngiye kwesokudla noma ngijike kwesokudla`
• `Ngihlose ukwehlisa ijubane noma ngime`.

 Imifanekiso ikhombisa umshayeli esebenzisa ingalo yesokudla ukukhombisa kwesokudla, kwesobunxele noma ukwehlisa ijubane nokuma. Zibonisa futhi umgibeli welula ingalo ngakwesobunxele noma kwesokudla ukukhombisa isiqondiso esihlosiwe, kanye nokuhambisa ingalo phezulu naphansi ukukhombisa ukwehlisa ijubane noma ukuma.

 Lezi zimpawu akufanele zisetshenziswe ngaphandle kwezinjongo ezichazwe.

 Izibani zengozi

 Izibani zokuxwayisa ngengozi zisho ukuthi: ‘Ngivimba okwesikhashana ithrafikhi noma ngixwayisa ngengozi noma isithiyo esingaphambili’ (bheka uMthetho 116). Zombili izinkomba zokuqondisa ziyakhanya ndawonye lapho izibani zokuxwayisa ngengozi zisebenza.

englishSubcategory: Police officers. Arm signals to persons controlling traffic. Driver and Vehicle Standards Agency officers and traffic officers. School crossing patrols
description:
Izikhulu zamaphoyisa

 Izimpawu zokuma zingaqondiswa ku:

 • ithrafikhi esondela isuka phambili
• ithrafikhi esondela isuka phambili nangemuva
• ithrafikhi esondela isuka ngemuva.

 Iphoyisa lingabonisa ukuthi ithrafikhi ime ngokubheka ithrafikhi efanele bese liphakamisa isandla isandla sibheke kuso. Iphoyisa lingamisa ithrafikhi esondela isuka phambili nangemuva ngokwelula izingalo njengoba kuboniswe.

 Ukuze libonise ukuthi ithrafikhi ivuliwe, iphoyisa lingabonisa ukuthi:

 • ohlangothini
• ngaphambili
• ngemuva.
Iphoyisa lisebenzisa ukunyakaza kwesandla noma kwezingalo okuphindaphindiwe ukukhomba ukuthi ithrafikhi iye phambili.

 EWales, izimpawu zezilimi ezimbili zivela ezimotweni zezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo nasezingubo.

 Izimpawu zezingalo kubantu abalawula ithrafikhi

 Abashayeli bangasebenzisa izimpawu zengalo ukuxhumana:

 • `Ngifuna ukuqhubeka ngqo`
• `Ngifuna ukujika kwesobunxele`; noma yisiphi isandla singasetshenziswa
• `Ngifuna ukujika kwesokudla`.

 Izikhulu ze-Agency Yezindinganiso Zabashayeli Nezimoto kanye nezikhulu zethrafikhi

 Izikhulu zethrafikhi kanye nezikhulu ze-DVSA zinamandla okumisa noma ukuqondisa izimoto. Zisebenzisa izimpawu zesandla kanye nezimpawu zokukhanya ezifana nalezo ezisetshenziswa ngamaphoyisa. KUMELE ulalele noma yiziphi izimpawu abazinikezayo (bheka Imithetho 107 no-108).

 Amaphoyisa okuwela izikole

 Indawo yesibonakaliso sokuhamba ikhombisa:

 • uphawu lubanjwe phezulu uphawu lubheke phansi: alulungele ukuwela abahamba ngezinyawo
• uphawu lubanjwe ngokuvundlile ngaphesheya komgwaqo: isithiyo sokumisa abahamba ngezinyawo ukuwela
• uphawu luphakanyiswe ngokuvundlile uphawu lubonakala: lulungele ukuwela abahamba ngezinyawo; izimoto kumele zilungele ukuma
• uphawu lubekwe luqonde futhi luboniswe ngasemgwaqweni, kanti enye ingalo yesikhulu sezokuqapha yeluliwe: zonke izimoto kumele zime.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 19. Izimpawu zomgwaqo
description:
Izimpawu ezinikeza ama-oda

 Izimpawu ezinezindilinga ezibomvu zivame ukwenqabela. Amapuleti angezansi kwezimpawu afanela umyalezo wazo.

 Izimpawu zokuvimbela kanye nezivimbelo

 • ukungena endaweni engama-20 mph
• ukuphela kwendawo engama-20 mph
• isivinini esiphezulu; umfanekiso ukhombisa ama-40 mph njengesibonelo
• umkhawulo wejubane kazwelonke uyasebenza
• ukuqapha ukuwela isikole
• YIMA bese unikeza indlela
• nikeza indlela ithrafikhi emgwaqweni omkhulu
• izimpawu zesikhashana ze-STOP ne-GO eziqhutshwa ngesandla
• akukho ukungena kwethrafikhi yezimoto
• akukho zimoto ngaphandle kwamabhayisikili aqhutshwayo
• akukho ukugibela ibhayisikili
• akukho zimoto
• akukho mabhasi anezihlalo zabagibeli ezingaphezu kweziyisishiyagalombili
• akukho ukudlula
• akukho amakharavani adonswayo
• azikho izimoto ezithwala iziqhumane
• azikho izimoto noma inhlanganisela yezimoto ezingaphezu kobude obubonisiwe; umfanekiso uhlanganisa izibonelo zama-32 izinyawo amasentimitha angu-6 kanye namamitha angu-9.9
• azikho izimoto ezingaphezu kobude obubonisiwe; umfanekiso ubonisa amamitha angu-4.4 noma angu-14 izinyawo amasentimitha angu-6
• azikho izimoto ezingaphezu kobubanzi obubonisiwe; umfanekiso ubonisa amamitha angu-2.0 noma angu-6 izinyawo amasentimitha angu-6
• nikeza kuqala izimoto ezivela kolunye uhlangothi
• azikho ukujika kwesokudla
• azikho ukujika kwesobunxele
• azikho izimoto zezimpahla ezingaphezu kwesisindo esiphezulu esibonisiwe, ngamathani, ngaphandle kokulayisha nokukhulula; umfanekiso ubonisa amathani angu-7.5
• azikho izimoto ezingaphezu kwesisindo esiphezulu esibonisiwe, ngamathani; umfanekiso ubonisa umkhawulo webhuloho elibuthakathaka wamathani angu-18 isisindo esiphezulu esibonisiwe
• indawo yokupaka inqunyelwe kubanikazi bezimvume
• akukho ukuma phakathi nesikhathi esibonisiwe ngaphandle kwamabhasi
• akukho ukuma ngezikhathi ezibonisiwe ngaphandle kwesikhathi esidingekayo sokubeka phansi noma ukuqoqa abagibeli. Isibonelo sendlela yasedolobheni esibonisayo sisebenza ngoMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu kusukela ngo-8:00 ekuseni kuya ku-9:30 ekuseni kanye kusukela ngo-4:30 ntambama kuya ku-6:30 ntambama
• akukho ukulinda
• akukho ukuma noma indlela evulekile.

 Izimpawu ezinezindilinga eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kodwa ezingenawo umngcele obomvu ngokuvamile zinikeza imiyalelo emihle.

 Izimpawu zemiyalelo emihle

 • phambili kuphela
• jika kwesobunxele phambili; jika kwesokudla uma uphawu lubuyiselwe emuva
• jika kwesobunxele; jika kwesokudla uma uphawu lubuyiselwe emuva

• umzila we-pedal-cycle ohlukanisiwe kanye nomzila wabahamba ngezinyawo

• ukuphela kwesivinini esincane
• amabhasi namabhayisikili kuphela
• ama-tram kuphela
• indawo yokuwela yabahamba ngezinyawo phezu kwe-tramway; bheka zombili izindlela
• ithrafikhi yendlela eyodwa; qhathanisa lolu phawu oluyindilinga nophawu oluyindilinga oluthi `Phambili kuphela`
• umzila webhasi ohambayo kanye nomzila wamabhayisikili
• umzila webhasi ohambayo ohambayo

description:
Izimpawu zokuxwayisa

 Izimpawu zokuxwayisa zivame ukuba ngunxantathu onemingcele ebomvu. Ipuleti elingaphansi kophawu lokuxwayisa linganikeza ulwazi olwengeziwe, njengebanga noma ubude bengozi.

 Ukuhlangana, ukwakheka komgwaqo kanye nezixwayiso zethrafikhi

 • ibanga eliya emgqeni `WE-STOP` ngaphambili; umfanekiso ubonisa amayadi ayi-100
• iziphetho zendlela ezimbili
• umgwaqo uncipha ngakwesokudla; uphawu luyabuyiselwa emuva lapho umgwaqo uncipha ngakwesobunxele
• umgwaqo uncipha nhlangothi zombili
• ibanga eliya emgqeni `we-Give Way` ngaphambili; umfanekiso ubonisa amayadi angu-50
• izimpambano
• ukuhlangana endaweni egobile phambili
• Ukuhlangana okungu-T okubaluleke kakhulu kunezimoto ezisondela ngakwesokudla
• ukuhlangana okugxilile
• ukuhlangana kwethrafikhi kusuka kwesobunxele phambili
• ukubaluleka komzila kuboniswa umugqa obanzi
• ukugoba okuphindwe kabili, kuqala ngakwesobunxele; uphawu lungabuyiselwa emuva
• ukugoba ngakwesokudla; uphawu lubuyiselwa emuva ngokugoba ngakwesobunxele
• ukuzungeza
• ithrafikhi enezindlela ezimbili iwela umgwaqo onendlela eyodwa
• ithrafikhi enezindlela ezimbili iqonde phambili
• izimpawu zethrafikhi
• izimpawu zethrafikhi ezingasetshenziswa
• imigqa yethrafikhi cishe phambili
• ukuphambuka okubukhali komzila oya ngakwesobunxele; ama-chevron abuyiselwa emuva ngokuphambuka kwesokudla
• izixwayiso ezinamagama, kufaka phakathi `YENCIPHISA Ijubane MANJE`.

 Izixwayiso zesimo somgwaqo kanye nezemvelo

 • umgwaqo ongalingani
• umgwaqo oshelelayo
• igquma eliqongo eliya phansi
• igquma eliqongo eliya phezulu
• ama-gradients angaboniswa njengephesenti noma isilinganiso; isibonelo, u-20% ulingana no-1:5. Umfanekiso uphinde ubonise i-gradient ehla ngo-10% kanye ne-gradient ekhuphuka ngo-20%
• umhubhe phambili
• amadwala awile noma awile
• ingozi yeqhwa; ipuleti lingasho ukuthi `Iqhwa`
• ibanga lapho ama-humps omgwaqo adlula khona; umfanekiso ubonisa `Ama-Humps amamayela angu-2`
• enye ingozi; ipuleti libonisa uhlobo lwengozi
• imiphetho ethambile; umfanekiso ubonisa `Imiphetho ethambile yamamayela angu-2`
• imimoya eseceleni
• ibhuloho eligobile
• ibhuloho eligobile noma usebe lomfula
• ingozi yokuma phansi
• ipuleti elibhalwe ngamagama lingakhomba izingozi ezifana ne-dip efihliwe noma i-ford.

 Izexwayiso zesitimela, i-tramway, ibhuloho kanye nezindiza

 • ibhuloho elivula noma elijikayo phambili
• izindiza ezindiza phansi noma umsindo wendiza ozumayo
• ama-tram awela phambili
• ukuwela ngezinga elilinganayo okunesithiyo noma isango ngaphambili
• ukuwela ngezinga elilinganayo ngaphandle kwesithiyo noma isango ngaphambili
• ukuwela ngezinga elilinganayo ngaphandle kwesithiyo, okukhonjiswa ngophawu lwe-crossbuck
• izimpawu zokukhanya phambili endaweni yokuwela ngezinga elilinganayo, enkundleni yezindiza noma ebhulohweni
• izibani ezincane zokuxwayisa ezindaweni zokuwela ngezinga elilinganayo. Okubomvu kusho ukuthi ‘YIMA’, okuluhlaza kusho ukuthi ‘Kucacile’, futhi uma kungekho ukukhanya okubonakalayo, shayela umqhubi wokuwela
• ukukhanya okukhanyisa ngokushintshana kusho ukuma lapho izibani zibonakala.

 Izixwayiso zabahamba ngezinyawo nabawela

 • ukuwela esikoleni kugada phambili; ezinye izimpawu zinezibani eziphuzi ezikhanya lapho ukuwela kusetshenziswa
• abahamba ngezinyawo ababuthakathaka abangase bawele; esikhundleni salokho kungaboniswa abahamba ngezinyawo abayizimpumputhe noma abakhubazekile
• abahamba ngezinyawo emgwaqweni ongaphambili; ipuleti lingabonisa ukuthi ayikho indlela yabahamba ngezinyawo yebanga elishiwo, elikhonjiswa njengamayadi angu-400 emfanekisweni
• ukuwela i-zebra.

 Izexwayiso zokuphakama kanye nogesi

 • ikhebula likagesi elingaphezulu; ipuleti libonisa ukuphakama okuphezulu kwemoto okungadlula ngokuphephile. Umfanekiso ubonisa ukuphakama okuphephile okungu-16 izinyawo 6 amayintshi noma amamitha angu-5.0
• igumbi elitholakalayo elibonisiwe; umfanekiso ubonisa amasentimitha angu-14 izinyawo 6 noma amamitha angu-4.4.

 Izexwayiso zezilwane kanye nomjikelezo

 • izinkomo
• izilwane zasendle
• amahhashi asendle noma amaponi
• amahhashi noma amaponi ahambisanayo
• umzila webhayisikili ongaphambili.

description:
Izimpawu zokuqondisa

 Izimpawu zokuqondisa ikakhulukazi ziyisikwele.

 Izimpawu zokuqondisa umgwaqo omkhulu zinezindilinga eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kg .

 • uphawu olusekuhlanganeni oluholela ngqo emgwaqweni omkhulu lungabonisa inombolo yokuhlangana ku-bac emnyama kg nxazonke
 • izimpawu ezindleleni zokuhlangana komgwaqo omkhulu zingabonisa inombolo yokuhlangana ku-bac emnyama kg nxazonke
 • uphawu lokuqinisekisa umzila ngemuva kokuhlangana lubala izindawo nebanga
• imicibisholo ekhomba phansi isho ukuthi `Ngena emzileni`. Zingabonisa ukuthi umzila wesobunxele uholela endaweni ehlukile kweminye imizila
• iphaneli elinomcibisholo othambekele libonisa izindawo ezingafinyelelwa ngokushiya umgwaqo omkhulu ku-bac elandelayo.

 Imifanekiso ifaka phakathi izibonelo ze-M1, izinombolo zokuhlangana 23 no-25, kanye namabanga okuqinisekisa umzila angamamayela angu-32 ukuya eSheffield kanye namamayela angu-59 ukuya eLeeds.

 Izimpawu emizileni eyinhloko

 Izimpawu zomzila oyinhloko zinezindilinga eziluhlaza kg .

 • amaphaneli aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka abonisa ukuthi umgwaqo omkhulu uqala endaweni yokuhlangana engaphambili
• umgwaqo omkhulu oboniswe kubakaki ungafinyelelwa ngokulandela umzila obonisiwe
• amaphaneli amhlophe abonisa imizila yendawo noma engeyona eyinhloko eholela kusukela endaweni yokuhlangana engaphambili
• amaphaneli ansundu abonisa imizila eya ezindaweni zokuvakasha
• igama lokuhlangana lingavela phezulu kophawu
• uphawu lwendiza lubonisa umzila oya esikhumulweni sezindiza
• uphawu lungaxwayisa ngengozi noma imingcele endleleni.

 Izimpawu zomzila oyinhloko zingabekwa ezindleleni eziya ezimpambanweni, ezimpambanweni kanye nangemuva kwezimpambano njengezimpawu zokuqinisekisa umzila. Lo mfanekiso uhlanganisa isixwayiso somzila somkhawulo wokuphakama wamamitha angu-4.4 (14-foot-6-inch) imayela elilodwa phambili.

 Izimpawu ezindleleni eziya ezimpambanweni eWales zingaba nezilimi ezimbili.

 Umzila oyinhloko owakha ingxenye yomgwaqo oyindilinga uboniswa yizimpawu zokuqondisa eziluhlaza ezinamaphaneli `omgwaqo oyindilinga`. Isikwele esiluhlaza esiqukethe u-`R` omhlophe sibonisa nomzila oyindilinga.

 Izimpawu emizileni engeyona eyinhloko kanye neyasendaweni

 Lezi zimpawu zinemingcele emnyama.

 • Amaphaneli aluhlaza abonisa ukuthi umzila oyinhloko uqala empambanweni engaphambili
• Izinombolo zomzila ezungezayo eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kg zibonisa indlela eya emgwaqweni omkhulu
• izinombolo zomzila oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kg zikhombisa indlela eya emzileni oyinhloko
 • izimpawu zingase zinikezwe ezindleleni eziya ezimpambanweni nasemaphambanweni
 • uphawu olubonisa `WC` kanye nophawu lwesihlalo sabakhubazekile olunikeza indlela eya ezindlini zangasese ezinokufinyelela kwabantu abakhubazekile.

 Ezinye izimpawu zokuqondisa

 • indawo yepikiniki
• isikhumbuzo sasendulo esinakekelwa yi-English Heritage
• indlela eya endaweni yokupaka izimoto; iphaneli efanelekile inganciphisa ukutholakala kwayo, njengokuthi `ngoMgqibelo kuphela`
• indawo yokuheha izivakashi; kusetshenziswa izimpawu ezinsundu, nezibonelo ezifaka phakathi i-zoo
• indlela eya endaweni yokukhempa kanye ne-caravan; umfanekiso ubonisa eyodwa engamamitha angu-300 ukusuka lapha
• indlela yokweluleka yamaloli
• indlela yamabhayisikili e-pedal akha ingxenye yenethiwekhi; isiqephu senombolo yomzila obomvu singakhomba indlela enenombolo, njengomzila 4
• indlela enconywayo yamabhayisikili e-pedal eya endaweni ebonisiwe; umfanekiso ukhombisa uMarton ngamamayela amathathu ukusuka lapha
 • indlela yabahamba ngezinyawo; izibonelo zifaka phakathi izikhombisi-ndlela eziya kulabhulali yomphakathi noma emahhovisi kamasipala
 • izimpawu ezibonisa indlela ephuthumayo yokuphambuka komgwaqo omkhulu kanye neminye imigwaqo emikhulu. Izimpawu ezibonisiwe ziyisikwele, unxantathu, indilinga kanye nedayimane ezindizeni eziphuzi kg
 • indlela yesikhashana yokuphambuka iboniswa uphawu olumnyama noma indawo oya kuyo ophawini oluphuzi.

description:
Izimpawu zolwazi

 Izimpawu zolwazi ziyisikwele.

 Ulwazi lokupaka, ukushaja kanye nokuvinjelwa

 • ukungena endaweni yokupaka elawulwayo. Isibonelo esiboniswe sibonisa ukusebenza ngoMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu kusukela ngo-8:30 ekuseni kuya ku-6:30 ntambama kanye noMgqibelo kusukela ngo-8:30 ekuseni kuya ku-1:30 ntambama
• ukungena endaweni yokushaja okuxineneyo. Isibonelo se-Central Zone esiboniswe sibonisa ukusebenza ngoMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu kusukela ngo-7:00 ekuseni kuya ku-6:30 ntambama
• ukuphela kwendawo yokupaka elawulwayo
• isexwayiso kusengaphambili somkhawulo noma ukuvinjelwa okuzayo. Isibonelo esiboniswe sibonisa isixwayiso ngebhuloho eliphansi elihamba ngamamayela amabili ngaphambili elinokuphakama okuphezulu kwamamitha angu-4.4 noma amasentimitha angu-14 izinyawo angu-6
• indawo yokupaka yezithuthuthu ezihamba zodwa.

 Imizila yamabhasi kanye nemizila yezimoto ezinabantu abaningi

 • umzila webhasi ohambayo ngaphambili lapho amabhayisikili ahambayo namatekisi angasebenzisa khona
• umzila oqokelwe izimoto ezinabantu abaningi (ama-HOV); bheka uMthetho 142. Isibonelo esiboniswe ngenhla singesezimoto ezithwala abantu ababili noma ngaphezulu futhi sisebenza ngoMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu kusukela ngo-7:00 ekuseni kuya ku-9:00 ekuseni kanye no-4:00 ntambama kuya ku-6:00 ntambama
• izimpawu zibonisa ukuthi yiziphi izimoto ezingasebenzisa umzila we-HOV ngaphambili. Isibonelo esiboniswe ngenhla sivumela izimoto ezinabantu ababili noma ngaphezulu, amabhasi, izithuthuthu kanye namabhayisikili ahambayo, kodwa sivimbela izimoto zezimpahla ezingaphezu kwamathani angu-7.5
• umzila webhasi emgwaqweni endaweni yokuhlangana engaphambili. Iphaneli ethi `Ngaphandle kwamabhasi` ingabonisa ukuthi amabhasi akhululiwe emkhawulweni oqondisayo.

 Ulwazi lomgwaqo omkhulu

 • ukuphela komgwaqo omkhulu
• ukuqala komgwaqo omkhulu kanye nendawo lapho imithetho yomgwaqo omkhulu isebenza khona; umfanekiso ubonisa i-M62
• imizila yethrafikhi efanele endaweni yokuhlangana engaphambili
• ithrafikhi emgwaqweni omkhulu ovela kwesokudla ibaluleke kakhulu kunokujoyina ithrafikhi
• ukuhlangana okwengeziwe kwethrafikhi kusuka kwesobunxele phambili; ithrafikhi emgwaqweni omkhulu ibaluleke kakhulu kunokujoyina ithrafikhi kusuka emzileni wesokudla womgwaqo oshelelayo
• ithrafikhi emgwaqweni wesokudla womgwaqo oshelelayo ojoyina umgwaqo omkhulu ibaluleke kakhulu kunokugijima emgwaqweni wesokhohlo
• umkhawulo wejubane oguquguqukayo ngokuphoqelelwa kwekhamera.

 Amamaki okubala phansi

 Ekuphumeni komgwaqo omkhulu, ibha ngayinye kumaki wokubala phansi imele amayadi ayi-100 ekuphumeni. Amabha amathathu abonisa amayadi angu-300, amabha amabili abonisa amayadi angu-200 kanti ibha eyodwa ikhombisa amayadi ayi-100.

 Amamaki okubala phansi aluhlaza angasetshenziswa emizileni eyinhloko. Amamaki amhlophe angemuva anemigoqo emnyama angasetshenziswa kweminye imizila.

 Amamaki amhlophe ngemuva anezingodo ezibomvu angasetshenziswa ezindleleni zokuwela ezifihliwe. Nakuba la mamaki ebekwe amabanga alinganayo, izingodo zawo azimeli izikhawu zamayadi ayi-100.

 Ezinye izimpawu zolwazi

 • uphawu lwendawo yesevisi yomgwaqo omkhulu olubonisa igama lomqhubi. Isibonelo esiboniswe sibonisa izinsizakalo zasePuddleworth eziqhele ngamakhilomitha ayisithupha ngaphambili kanye nezimpawu ze-LPG, ukudla okulula, ukudla, izikhungo zabakhubazekile, ulwazi, indawo yokuhlala kanye nophethiloli
• ithrafikhi ibaluleke kakhulu kunezimoto ezizayo
• isibhedlela singaphambili ngezindawo zezingozi nezimo eziphuthumayo. Isibonelo esiboniswe sithi i-A&E ayivuliwe amahora angama-24
• indawo yolwazi lwezivakashi
• akukho mgwaqo odlulayo wezimoto
• umzila onconywayo wamabhayisikili ahamba ngezinyawo
• Ukungena eHome Zone
• indawo lapho amakhamera asetshenziswa khona ukuphoqelela imithetho yethrafikhi.

description:
Izimpawu zomsebenzi womgwaqo

 • imisebenzi yomgwaqo
• ama-chippings axegayo
• ingozi yesikhashana emisebenzini yomgwaqo. Umfanekiso uhlanganisa isexwayiso esibhalwe ngamagama athi ‘SLOW WET TAR’
• ukuvalwa kwemizila okwesikhashana. Inombolo nendawo yemicibisholo kanye nemigoqo ebomvu kungahluka ngokuya ngokuthi yimiphi imizila evulekile nevaliwe. Isibonelo esiboniswe sinikeza isexwayiso samayadi angu-800
• imoto esebenza kancane noma engashintshi ivimba umzila wethrafikhi. Dlula ohlangothini oluboniswe ngumcibisholo; uphawu oluboniswe lumqondisa ithrafikhi ukuthi idlule ngakwesobunxele
• imisebenzi yomgwaqo imayela elilodwa phambili. Umlayezo owengeziwe unganikeza ulwazi olwengeziwe, njengokuthi ‘Kungenzeka ukubambezeleka kuze kube uMashi 08’
• umkhawulo wejubane ophoqelekile phambili. Umfanekiso uxwayisa ngomkhawulo wama-50 mph amakhilomitha amathathu kwezine ngaphambili
• uphawu olusengaphambili oluhlanganisa isexwayiso somsebenzi womgwaqo kanye nokuvalwa kwemizila okwesikhashana; isibonelo esiboniswe sinikeza isexwayiso samayadi angu-800
• ukuphela komsebenzi womgwaqo kanye nayo yonke imikhawulo yesikhashana, kufaka phakathi imikhawulo yesivinini yesikhashana. Umfanekiso ufaka umlayezo othi ‘Uxolo nganoma yikuphi ukubambezeleka’
 • izimpawu eziboniswe ngemuva kwezimoto ezihamba kancane noma ezimile ezixwayisa ngokuthi imoto esebenzayo ivala umzila ongaphambili. Azikho izikhonkwane emgwaqweni. Isibonelo esiboniswe sinikeza isixwayiso samayadi angu-450
 • imikhawulo yomzila emsebenzini womgwaqo ongaphambili. Isibonelo esiboniswe sibonisa imikhawulo emayadi angu-800 ngaphambili kwe-M1 ne-A617 ekuxhumaneni 29, kufaka phakathi izindawo zomzila kanye nomkhawulo wezimoto ezingaphezu kwamathani angu-7.5
 • ukuwela komzila owodwa emsebenzini womgwaqo we-contraflow. Uphawu oluboniswe lumyala abashayeli ukuthi bahlale emzileni futhi lubonisa isivinini esiphezulu sama-30 mph.
