• umugqa wokuma ophawini `lokuma`
• umugqa wokuma wabahamba ngezinyawo endaweni yokuwela esezingeni eliphezulu
• ukunikeza indlela izimoto emgwaqweni omkhulu; lokhu kuphawula kungasetshenziswa nasezindaweni ezincane ezizungezile
• ukunikeza indlela izimoto ezisondela ngakwesokudla endaweni ezungezile
• ukunikeza indlela izimoto ezisondela ngakwesokudla endaweni ezungezile encane.

 Eceleni komgwaqo

 • umugqa onqenqemeni
• umugqa ophakathi; bheka uMthetho 127
• umugqa oyisixwayiso sengozi; bheka uMthetho 127
• imigqa emhlophe ephindwe kabili; bheka iMithetho 128 no-129
• ukuphela kohlelo lwemigqa emhlophe ephindwe kabili; bheka uMthetho 130
• umugqa womzila; bheka uMthetho 131.

 Eceleni kwendlela

 Imikhawulo yokulinda

 Imigqa yokulinda ephuzi iyasebenza endleleni, endleleni kanye naseceleni. Ungama ukuze ulayishe noma wehlise imithwalo, ngaphandle kokuthi kusebenza nemikhawulo yokulayisha, noma ngenkathi abagibeli begibela noma behla.

 Imigqa ephuzi ephindwe kabili isho ukuthi akukho ukulinda nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ngaphandle kokuthi izimpawu zikhomba ngqo imikhawulo yesizini. Umugqa ophuzi owodwa usho ukuthi akukho ukulinda ngezikhathi eziboniswe ophawini oluseduze noma ezimpawini zokungena endaweni yokupaka elawulwayo.

 Uma kungekho zinsuku eziboniswayo, umkhawulo usebenza nsuku zonke, kufaka phakathi amaSonto namaholide aseBhange. Izimpawu ze-white bay kanye nezimpawu eziqondile zibonisa lapho ukupaka kuvunyelwe khona futhi zingase zichaze ubude, izinsuku nezikhathi ezivunyelwe.

 Izilawuli zokuma komzila obomvu

 Eminye imigwaqo isebenzisa imigqa ebomvu esikhundleni semigqa ephuzi. Imigqa ebomvu eyodwa nephindwe kabili ivimbela ukuma ukuze upake, ulayishe noma wehlise imithwalo, noma ivumele abagibeli ukuthi bagibele noma behle, kuncike ezimweni ezishiwoyo zamatekisi anelayisensi kanye nabanikazi beBlue Badge. Imikhawulo isebenza emgwaqweni, emgwaqweni kanye naseceleni.

 Imigqa ebomvu emibili isho ukuthi akumi noma nini. Imigqa ebomvu eyodwa isho ukuthi akumi ngesikhathi esiboniswe ezimpawini eziseduze.

 Emizileni Ebomvu, ukuma ukupaka noma ukulayisha kungavunyelwa ezindaweni eziphawulwe ngokukhethekile. I-bay ebomvu itholakala kuphela ngenhloso eshiwo ngezikhathi ezibonisiwe, okungaba yingxenye yosuku kuphela. I-bay emhlophe iyatholakala usuku lonke, kuye ngophawu lwayo.

 Imigqa ebomvu nephuzi eyodwa inikeza umhlahlandlela kuphela wemikhawulo esebenzayo. Njalo bheka izimpawu eziseduze noma izimpawu zokungena endaweni.

 Izibonelo ze-Red Route eziboniswe zibonisa:

 • akumi noma nini
• akumi ngoMsombuluko kuya ngoMgqibelo kusukela ngo-7 ekuseni kuya ku-7 ntambama
• ukupaka ngoMsombuluko kuya ngoMgqibelo kusukela ngo-7 ekuseni kuya ku-7 ntambama kuze kube yihora elilodwa, ngaphandle kokubuya kungakapheli amahora amabili
• ukulayisha phakathi kuka-10 ekuseni no-4 ntambama kuze kube yimizuzu engama-20
• ukupaka ngoMsombuluko kuya ngoMgqibelo kusukela ngo-8 ekuseni kuya ku-7 ntambama kuze kube yimizuzu engama-20, ngaphandle kokubuya kungakapheli imizuzu engama-40.

 Eceleni komgwaqo noma emaphethelweni omgwaqo

 Imikhawulo yokulayisha emigwaqweni engaphandle kweMigwaqo Ebomvu

 Amamaki aphuzi eceleni komgwaqo noma emaphethelweni omgwaqo avimbela ukulayisha nokukhulula ngesikhathi esiboniswe kumapuleti amnyama namhlophe aseduze. Ungama ngenkathi abagibeli begibela noma behla.

 Amamaki aphuzi aphindwe kabili asho ukuthi akukho ukulayisha noma ukukhulula nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Umamaki owodwa ophuzi usho ukuthi akukho ukulayisha noma ukukhulula ngesikhathi esiboniswe. Uma kungekho zinsuku eziboniswayo, umkhawulo usebenza nsuku zonke, kufaka phakathi amaSonto namaholide aseBhange. Hlola njalo izikhathi eziboniswe kumapuleti.

 Indawo yokulayisha iphawulwe nge-bay emhlophe enamagama athi ‘Loading Only’ kanye nesibonakaliso esiqondile esibonisa uphawu lwe-trolley olumhlophe-on-blue. Isibonakaliso sibonisa ukuthi i-bay ikhawulelwe ezimotweni zezimpahla nokuthi ingasetshenziswa nini. Uma kungekho zinsuku noma izikhathi eziboniswayo, ingasetshenziswa nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Imoto akumelwe ipake lapho ngaphandle kokuthi ilayishwa noma ithululwa.

 Ezinye izimpawu zomgwaqo

 • uphawu lokungena esikoleni: gcina umnyango ungenazo izimoto ezimile, ngisho nalapho uthatha noma ubeka izingane phansi
• unxantathu oyisixwayiso omude: isixwayiso sophawu oluthi ‘Give Way’ oluphambi nje
• izindawo zokupaka ezigcinelwe izimoto eziqanjwe ngamagama, njengodokotela; bheka uMthetho 243
• uphawu lomgwaqo ovulekile phakathi kwebhasi; bheka uMthetho 243
• uphawu lomgwaqo ophakathi kwebhasi; bheka uMthetho 141
• ukuhlangana kwebhokisi eliphuzi; bheka uMthetho 174
• Ukumaka okuthi ‘Gcina Kucacile’: ungavimbi ingxenye ekhonjisiwe yendlela yokuhamba
 • Imicibisholo kanye nezimpawu zokuya endaweni ethile zibonisa imizila okufanele isetshenziswe.

description:
Izimpawu zangemuva zezimoto ezinkulu

 Izimpawu zangemuva kumele ziboniswe ezimotweni ezinesisindo esiphezulu esingaphezu kuka-7,500 amakhilogremu kanye nama-trailer anesisindo esiphezulu esingaphezu kuka-3,500 amakhilogremu .

 Izimpawu zisebenzisa imivimbo ebomvu ekhanyayo ekhanyayo ekhanyayo. Zingahlelwa njengophawu oluphakathi olugcwele ububanzi, izimpawu ezimbili ezivundlile ezibekwe kwesobunxele nakwesokudla, noma izimpawu eziqondile ezibekwe kwesobunxele nakwesokudla.

 Izimpawu ezibomvu neziphuzi eziqondile kumele futhi zifakwe kuma-skip abakhi ababekwe emgwaqweni kanye nasezimotweni zezentengiselwano noma ezinhlanganisweni zezimoto ezinde kunamamitha angu-13. Zingakhethwa ekuhlanganisweni okuphakathi kwamamitha angu-11 no-13 ubude.

 Amapuleti esixwayiso sengozi

 Izimoto ezithile zamathangi ezithwala izimpahla eziyingozi kumele zibonise amaphaneli olwazi lwengozi. Iphaneli eboniswe ngemifanekiso ingeyoketshezi oluvuthayo futhi ifaka:

 • ikhodi yesenzo esiphuthumayo ‘2YE’
• inombolo yezinto zeZizwe Ezihlangene ‘1089’
• idayimane eliyingozi elivutha umlilo
• inombolo yocingo yokwelulekwa ngochwepheshe.

 Iphaneli eliphuzi elicacile liboniswa yizimoto ezithwala izimpahla ezithile eziyingozi emaphaketheni.

 Izimpawu zesixwayiso ezimise okwedayimane zikhomba izingozi ezithile. Izimpawu eziboniswe lapha zibonisa:

 • into enobuthi, isigaba 6
• into exosha i-oxidative, isigaba 5.1
• igesi ecindezelwe engashi, isigaba 2
• into ekhipha imisebe, isigaba 7
• into evuthayo ngokuzenzekelayo, isigaba 4
• into ebolile, isigaba 8.

 Amamaki okubikezela

 Amamaki okubonisa ohlangothini nangemuva axwayisa abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo ngomthwalo olengayo noma imishini evezayo, njenge-crane jib.

 Zombili izimpawu zohlangothi nangemuva ziyadingeka lapho umthwalo noma imishini iveza okungaphezu kwamamitha amabili ngaphezu kwangaphambili noma ngemuva kwemoto.

 Okunye

 Uphawu oluphuzi oluyisikwele olubonisa izingane ezimbili lukhomba ibhasi lesikole. Lingaboniswa efasiteleni langaphambili noma langemuva lebhasi noma ibhasi.

description:
Wena nebhayisikili lakho

 Ngaphambi kokugibela emgwaqweni, qiniseka ukuthi uzizwa uqiniseka ngekhono lakho lokugibela ngokuphephile.

 Ukukhetha nokugcina umjikelezo wakho

 Qiniseka ukuthi:

 • unosayizi ofanele kanye nohlobo lomjikelezo ukuze uthole induduzo nokuphepha
• izibani nama-reflector ahlanzekile futhi asebenza kahle
• amathayi asesimweni esihle futhi afuthwe ngomfutho oboniswe ethayini
• amasondo ajikeleza ngokukhululeka
• amagiya asebenza kahle
• uchungechunge lulungiswe kahle futhi lugcotshwe ngamafutha
• isihlalo sehhashi kanye nezibambo zilungiswe ukuphakama okufanele.

 Kufanele ufake insimbi kumjikelezo wakho.

 Izidingo zomthetho

 KUMELE:

 • qinisekisa ukuthi amabhuleki akho asebenza kahle
• khanyisa isibani sangaphambili esimhlophe kanye nesibani sangemuva esibomvu uma ugibela ibhayisikili ebusuku.

 Imithetho Imithethonqubo ye-PCUR 6 kanye ne-10 kanye nomthethonqubo we-RVLR 18.

 Ukuqeqeshwa ngebhayisikili

 Uma ungumgibeli webhayisikili ongenalwazi noma ungakaze ugibele isikhathi esithile, cabanga ngokuthatha inkambo yokuqeqeshwa ngebhayisikili. Amanye amakhansela ahlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okujwayelekile kuzwelonke njengokugibela ibhayisikili, futhi kumahhala ezindaweni ezithile. Ukuqeqeshwa kungasiza ekuthuthukiseni amakhono akho okugibela ibhayisikili kanye nokuzethemba.

 Ukugibela ibhayisikili kunamazinga amathathu. Kuqala ngamakhono ayisisekelo njengokulinganisela, ukuma nokuqala ngokuphephile futhi kuqhubekela ekusingatheni iziphambano eziyinkimbinkimbi nezimatasa.

 Ukuqeqeshwa kungaphinde kufake:

 • izimpawu zomgwaqo kanye nemithetho yomgwaqo
• ukuhlela umzila
• ukubeka umgwaqo okuphephile
• ukusayina, ikakhulukazi eziphambanweni
• ukulungiswa okuyisisekelo komjikelezo.

 Ulwazi olwengeziwe luyatholakala ku-www.bikeability.org.uk kanye ne-www.cycling.scot.

description:
Izidingo zelayisensi yesithuthuthu

 Uma unelayisensi yesithuthuthu yesikhashana, KUMELE uqedele ngokwanele ikhosi yoQeqesho Oluyisisekelo Oluphoqelekile (i-CBT).

 Ngemva kokuphothula i-CBT, ungagibela ungaphelekezelwa emgwaqweni womphakathi iminyaka emibili ngesithuthuthu:

 • esinomthamo wenjini ongaphezu kuka-125 cc
• esinomphumela wamandla ongadluli ku-11 kW
• ekhombisa amapuleti e-L. EWales, amapuleti e-D, amapuleti e-L noma kokubili kungasetshenziswa.

 Umthetho we-RTA 1988 isigaba 97(3).

 Ukufunda ukugibela i-moped

 Ukuze ugibele i-moped njengomfundi, KUMELE:

 • ube neminyaka engu-16 okungenani
• ube nelayisensi ye-moped yesikhashana
• i-CBT ephelele.

 Izigaba 97(3) zoMthetho we-RTA ka-1988 97(3) kanye no-101.

 Ungabe usugibela wedwa emgwaqweni womphakathi kuze kube yiminyaka emibili emotweni enamasondo amabili enesivinini esikhulu sokuklama esingu-45 km/h (28 mph), uma nje ubonisa amapuleti e-L. EWales, amapuleti e-D, amapuleti e-L noma kokubili kungasetshenziswa.

 Ukuze uthole ilayisensi ephelele ye-moped, KUMELE uqale uphase isivivinyo sethiyori yesithuthuthu bese kuba isivivinyo esisebenzayo se-moped.

 Umthethonqubo we-MV(DL)R 38(4).

 Abashayeli abaphase isivivinyo semoto ngaphambi komhla lu-1 kuNhlolanja 2001

 Uma uphase isivivinyo sakho sokushayela imoto ngaphambi komhla lu-1 kuNhlolanja 2001, uyafaneleka ukugibela i-moped engenamapuleti e-L noma, eWales, amapuleti e-D. Noma kunjalo, kunconywa ukuqeda i-CBT ngaphambi kokugibela emgwaqweni.

 Uma uphumelele ukuhlolwa kokushayela imoto yakho ngomhlaka-1 kuNhlolanja 2001 noma ngemuva kwalokho, KUMELE uqedele i-CBT ngaphambi kokugibela i-moped emgwaqweni.

 Umthetho we-RTA 1988 isigaba 97(3).

 Izigaba zamalayisense ama-moped nezithuthuthu

 Isigaba AM — ubuncane beminyaka engu-16

 • imoto enamasondo amabili enesivinini esikhulu sokuklama esingu-45 km/h (28 mph)
• imoto enamasondo amathathu noma amane enesivinini esikhulu sokuklama esingaphezu kuka-25 km/h (15.5 mph), amandla enjini angedluli ku-50 cc kanye namandla angadluli ku-4 kW.

 Isigaba A1 — ubuncane beminyaka engu-17

 • izithuthuthu ezinomthamo wenjini ongaphezu kuka-125 cc kanye nomthamo wamandla ongaphezu kuka-11 kW
 • amabhayisikili amathathu anomthamo wamandla ongaphezu kuka-15 kW.

 Isigaba A2 — ubuncane beminyaka engu-19

 • izithuthuthu ezinomthamo wamandla ongaphezu kuka-35 kW.

 Isigaba A

 • noma yisiphi isithuthuthu. Ubuncane beminyaka engu-21 ngokufinyelela okuqhubekayo noma engu-24 ngokufinyelela okuqondile
• amabhayisikili amathathu anomthamo wamandla ongaphezu kuka-15 kW; ubuncane beminyaka engu-21.

 Ukufinyelela okuqhubekayo

 Ukufinyelela okuqhubekayo kuvumela umgibeli ukuthi athathe isivivinyo esisebenzayo sesigaba selayisensi ephezulu ngemuva kokuthola okungenani iminyaka emibili yesipiliyoni esigabeni esiphansi sesithuthuthu.

 Isibonelo, umgibeli obenelayisensi yesigaba A2 okungenani iminyaka emibili angathatha isivivinyo esisebenzayo sesigaba A eneminyaka engu-21. Akudingeki olunye isivivinyo sethiyori.

 Ukufunda ngesithuthuthu esikhulu kune-125 cc

 Ukuze ufunde ukugibela isithuthuthu esinamandla enjini angaphezu kwe-125 cc kanye nokukhishwa kwamandla angaphezu kwe-11 kW, KUMELE:

 • uhlangabezane nezidingo zobudala obuncane ezifanele
• uqedele i-CBT ngokwanelisayo
• uhambisane nomqeqeshi ogunyaziwe ogibela esinye isithuthuthu futhi agcine ukuxhumana komsakazo.

 Umthetho MV(DL)R imithethonqubo 9 kanye no-16(7), kanye nesigaba 97(3 se-RTA ka-1988.
Ukuthola ilayisensi ephelele

 Ukuze uthole ilayisensi ephelele ye-moped noma yesithuthuthu, KUMELE uphumelele:

 • ukuhlolwa kwethiyori yesithuthuthu
• ukuhlolwa okusebenzayo kweModule 1
• ukuhlolwa okusebenzayo kweModule 2.

 Ukuhlolwa okusebenzayo kumele kwenziwe ngesithuthuthu esinamasondo amabili.

 Umthethonqubo we-MV(DL)R 38.

 Kuze kube yilapho usuphumelele ukuhlolwa kwakho, AKUMELE:

 • ukuthwala umgibeli we-pillion
• ukudonsa i-trailer.

 Bheka futhi uMthetho 253 ophathelene nezimoto ezivinjelwe emigwaqweni emikhulu.

 Umthethonqubo we-MV(DL)R 16.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 24. Isithasiselo 3. Imibhalo yemoto kanye nezidingo zomshayeli ofundayo
description:
Imibhalo

 Ilayisense yokushayela

 KUMELE ube nelayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni yesigaba semoto oyishayelayo. KUMELE wazise i-Agency yokushayela neyokunikeza Amalayisense Ezimoto (i-DVLA) uma igama lakho noma ikheli lakho lishintsha.

 Umthetho we-RTA 1988 izigaba 87 kanye no-99(4).

 Amalayisense e-Non-European Community

 Umnikazi welayisensi ye-Non-European Community ohlala e-UK angashayela esebenzisa leyo layisensi isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinyanga ezingu-12 kusukela ngosuku aba ngumhlali ngalo.

 Ukuze aqhubeke enelungelo lokushayela, umshayeli kufanele, ngaphambi kokuba isikhathi sezinyanga ezingu-12 siphele, athole ilayisensi yesikhashana yaseBrithani futhi aphumelele ukuhlolwa noma izivivinyo zokushayela ezidingekayo
• ashintshe ilayisensi efanelekile yelayisensi yaseBrithani uma ikhishwe yizwe eliqokwe ngokomthetho ngezinjongo zokushintshana ngelayisensi.

 MOT

 Izimoto nezithuthuthu KUMELE ziphumelele ukuhlolwa kwazo kokuqala kwe-MOT eminyakeni emithathu ngemuva kokubhaliswa kwazo kokuqala kanye njalo ngonyaka ngemva kwalokho.

 AKUMELE ushayele imoto ngaphandle kwesitifiketi se-MOT uma kudingeka. Okuhlukile kukuvumela ukuthi ushayele uye endaweni yokulungisa i-MOT ehlelwe kusengaphambili noma egaraji ukuze kulungiswe okudingekayo ukuze kuhlolwe. Ukushayela imoto engafanele ukuhamba emgwaqweni kungenza umshwalense wakho ungasebenzi.

 Izimoto, amaveni, izithuthuthu nezinye izimoto zabagibeli ezilula ezenziwe noma ezibhaliswe okokuqala eminyakeni engaphezu kwengu-40 edlule azivunyelwe ukuhlolwa kwe-MOT ngaphandle kokuthi zishintshwe kakhulu eminyakeni engama-30 edlule. Isiqondiso mayelana nezinguquko ezinkulu sitholakala ku-www.gov.uk/historic-vehicles.

 Uma imoto ekhululiwe kwi-MOT ishintshwa kakhulu, umgcini wayo akakwazi ukuqhubeka nokufaka isicelo sokukhululwa.

 Umthetho we-RTA ka-1988 izigaba 45, 47, 49 kanye no-53.

 Umshuwalense

 Ukuze usebenzise imoto emgwaqweni, KUMELE ube nenqubomgomo yomshuwalense esebenzayo. KUMELE ihlinzeke okungenani ngesembozo somuntu wesithathu ngokulimala komunye umuntu noma umonakalo empahleni yomunye umuntu.

 Ngaphambi kokushayela noma iyiphi imoto, qiniseka ukuthi noma iyiphi inqubomgomo yemoto ikumboza noma umshuwalense wakho uhlinzeka ngesembozo esanele. AKUMELE ushayele ngaphandle komshuwalense. Ngisho noma isigameko sethrafikhi yomgwaqo singeyona iphutha lakho, inkampani yomshuwalense ingase ikubophezele.

 Umthetho we-RTA ka-1988 isigaba 143.

 Amakhamera aseceleni komgwaqo angathola ngokuzenzakalelayo izimoto ezingenayo inshuwalense. Ngaphezu kwezinye izinhlawulo, amaphoyisa angabamba, asuse futhi aphihlize imoto yesaphulamthetho esinganayo inshuwalense.

 Umthetho we-RTA ka-1988 izigaba 165A no-165B.

 Izinhlobo zomshuwalense

 Umshuwalense weqembu lesithathu uvame ukuba uhlobo olushibhile kakhulu futhi luyikhava elincane kakhulu elidingekayo ngokomthetho. Uhlanganisa ukulimala okubangelwe abanye abantu kanye nomonakalo obangelwe impahla yabo. Awumbozi umonakalo emotweni yakho noma ukulimala komuntu siqu kuwe.

 Umshuwalense womlilo noweba weqembu lesithathu uhlinzeka ngekhava yomuntu wesithathu futhi uhlanganisa imoto yakho uma yebiwe noma yonakaliswe ngumlilo.

 Umshuwalense ophelele uhlinzeka ngekhava yomuntu wesithathu futhi uhlanganisa nomonakalo emotweni yakho, kuze kufike enanini layo emakethe, kanye nokulimala komuntu siqu kuwe. Ngokuvamile uhlobo lwekhava olubanzi kakhulu nolubiza kakhulu.

 Isitifiketi sokubhalisa

 Izitifiketi zokubhalisa, ezibizwa nangokuthi izitifiketi zokubhalisa ezivumelanisiwe, zikhishwa ezimotweni ezisetshenziswa emgwaqweni. Zichaza imoto, kufaka phakathi uhlobo lwayo kanye nomodeli wayo, futhi zikhomba umgcini wayo obhalisiwe.

 KUMELE wazise i-DVLA eSwansea ngokushesha okukhulu uma uthenga noma uthengisa imoto noma ushintsha igama lakho noma ikheli lakho.

 Umthengi nomthengisi banesibopho sokugcwalisa isitifiketi sokubhalisa. Umthengisi unesibopho sokusithumela ku-DVLA. Izinqubo zichazwe ngemuva kwesitifiketi.

 Imithethonqubo ye-Law RV(R&L)R 21, 22, 23 kanye no-24.

 I-Vehicle Excise Duty

 I-Vehicle Excise Duty (VED) KUMELE ikhokhelwe yonke imoto esetshenziswa noma egcinwe emgwaqweni womphakathi.

 Umthetho i-VERA izigaba 29 no-33.

 Isaziso Esisemthethweni Sangaphandle Komgwaqo

 Isaziso Esisemthethweni Sangaphandle Komgwaqo (SORN) sazisa i-DVLA ukuthi imoto ayisetshenziswa emgwaqweni.

 Uma ungumgcini obhalisiwe futhi uhlose ukugcina imoto ingakhokhiswa intela futhi ingekho emgwaqweni womphakathi, KUMELE umemezele i-SORN. Ukwehluleka ukwenza kanjalo kuyicala. I-SORN ihlala isebenza kuze kube yilapho imoto ithengiswa, ikhokhiswa intela noma ilahliwe.

 Imoto engasetshenziswanga noma egcinwe ngaphandle komgwaqo KUMELE ibe nesimemezelo se-SORN noma umshwalense osebenzayo.

 Umthetho we-RV(RL)R umthethonqubo 26 kanye noSheduli 4.

 Ukukhiqizwa kwamadokhumenti

 Uma ucelwa yiphoyisa, KUMELE ukwazi ukuveza:

 • ilayisense yakho yokushayela
• isitifiketi somshwalense esisebenzayo
• isitifiketi se-MOT esisebenzayo, uma sisebenza.

 Uma ungakwazi ukuveza amadokhumenti ngokushesha, kungadingeka ukuthi uwayise esiteshini samaphoyisa zingakapheli izinsuku eziyisikhombisa.

 Umthetho we-RTA ka-1988 izigaba 164 no-165.

 Abashayeli abafundi

 Umfundi oshayela imoto KUMELE abe nelayisensi yesikhashana esebenzayo.

 Umfundi KUMELE aqashwe ngumuntu:

 • okungenani uneminyaka engu-21 ubudala
• unelayisensi ephelele ye-EC noma ye-EEA yohlobo lwemoto olufanele, kungaba oluzenzakalelayo noma oluqhutshwa ngesandla
• ube nelayisensi leyo okungenani iminyaka emithathu.

 Imithetho MV(DL)R umthethonqubo 16 kanye nesigaba se-RTA ka-1988 87.

 Izimoto zabafundi

 Imoto eshayelwa ngumfundi KUMELE ibonise amapuleti e-L abomvu. EWales, amapuleti e-D abomvu, amapuleti e-L abomvu noma kokubili kungasetshenziswa.

 Amapuleti KUMELE ahambisane nezimfuneko zomthetho futhi abonakale ngokucacile kwabanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo kusukela ngaphambili nangemuva kwemoto.

 Amapuleti abafundi kufanele asuswe noma ambozwe lapho imoto ingashayelwa ngumfundi, ngaphandle kwezimoto zesikole sokushayela.

 Umthethonqubo we-MV(DL)R 16 kanye noShejuli 4.

 Ukushayela ungaphelekezelwe

 Ngaphambi kokushayela ungaphelekezelwe, KUMELE uphumelele isivivinyo sethiyori, lapho sidingeka, kulandelwe isivivinyo sokushayela esisebenzayo sesigaba semoto ofuna ukuyishayela.

 Umthethonqubo we-MV(DL)R 40.

description:
Umthetho wethrafikhi yomgwaqo

 Imithetho kanye neMithethonqubo ebhalwe ngezansi ifinyeziwe kuyo yonke i-Highway Code. Lokhu akuyona isiqondiso esiphelele somthetho wethrafikhi yomgwaqo. Ukuze uthole amagama aqondile, bheka umthetho ofanele, kufaka phakathi noma yiziphi izichibiyelo.

 Ukusetshenziswa kanye nencazelo `yomgwaqo`

 Iningi lezimiso lisebenza kuyo yonke imigwaqo kulo lonke elaseGreat Britain, yize kukhona okuhlukile.

 ENgilandi naseWales, umgwaqo uchazwa ngokuthi `yimuphi umgwaqo omkhulu nanoma yimuphi omunye umgwaqo umphakathi onokufinyelela kuwo futhi uhlanganisa amabhuloho lapho umgwaqo udlula khona`; bheka isigaba se-RTA sika-1988 192(1).

 IScotland inencazelo efanayo, enwetshiwe ukuze ifake noma iyiphi indlela umphakathi onelungelo lokudlula kuyo; bheka isigaba se-R(S)A sika-1984 151(1).

 Ngakho-ke izinkomba zomgwaqo ngokuvamile zifaka:

 • izindlela zabahamba ngezinyawo
• imigwaqo yamabhuloho
• imizila yamabhayisikili
• imigwaqo eminingi kanye nemigwaqo yokungena ezweni elizimele
• izindawo eziningi zokupaka izimoto.

 Umthetho wethrafikhi yomgwaqo uvame ukusebenza kulezi zindawo, yize imithetho eyengeziwe ingabusa izindlela noma izindlela ezithile. Amanye amacala amakhulu, okuhlanganisa namacala okushayela uphuzile, ayasebenza kuzo zonke izindawo zomphakathi, njengezindawo zokupaka izimoto zomphakathi.

 Izindawo eziphuthumayo

 `Indawo ephuthumayo` ku-Highway Code isho `indawo yokuphephela ephuthumayo` njengoba kuchazwe yiMithethonqubo ye-Motorways Traffic (England and Wales) ka-1982, njengoba kushintshwe yiMithethonqubo ye-Motorways Traffic (England and Wales) (Amendment) (England) ka-2015.

description:
Izijeziso kanye neKhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu

 IPhalamende libeka izinhlawulo eziphezulu zokwephulwa komthetho womgwaqo. Inhlawulo ephezulu ibonisa ubucayi becala, kodwa izinkantolo zinquma isigwebo esibekwa icala ngalinye ngokwezimo.

 Ithebula lesijeziso libala ezinye zezenzo zokwephulwa komthetho eziyinhloko kanye nezijeziso ezihlobene nazo. Amanye amacala amaningi athile awafakiwe.

 Amaphuzu esijeziso kanye nokungafaneleki

 Uhlelo lwamaphuzu esijeziso luhloselwe ukuvimbela abashayeli nabagibeli bezithuthuthu emikhubeni engaphephile. Amanye amacala angewona awokushayela izimoto, njengokwehluleka ukulungisa amaphutha ezimoto, angadonsela namaphuzu esijeziso.

 Inkantolo KUMELE ikhiphe umyalelo wokuthi inani lamaphuzu amiswe yiPhalamende, noma inombolo engaphakathi kobubanzi obubekiwe, kufanele ivunyelwe kulayisensi yomenzi wobubi. Amaphuzu aqongelelwe axwayisa abashayeli nabagibeli bezithuthuthu ukuthi amanye amacala angabangela ukungafaneleki.

 Umthetho we-RTOA izigaba 44 no-45.

 Umshayeli noma umshayeli wesithuthuthu oqoqa amaphuzu esijeziso angu-12 noma ngaphezulu zingakapheli iminyaka emithathu KUMELE angavunyelwa okungenani izinyanga eziyisithupha. Isikhathi singase sibe side uma umuntu owenze icala eseke wangavunyelwa ngaphambilini.

 Umthetho we-RTOA isigaba 35.

 Kuzo zonke izenzo zobugebengu eziphethe amaphuzu esijeziso, inkantolo inelungelo lokungavunyelwe umnikazi welayisensi. Inkantolo ingakhetha noma yisiphi isikhathi esifanele, nakuba ngokuvamile sizoqala kusukela esontweni elilodwa kuya ezinyangeni eziningana.

 Emacaleni amakhulu njengokushayela okuyingozi nokushayela uphuzile, inkantolo KUMELE ikhiphe umyalelo wokungavunyelwa. Isikhathi esincane ngokuvamile siyizinyanga ezingu-12, kodwa singase sibe side kulabo abenza izenzo zobugebengu eziphindaphindayo noma lapho izinga lotshwala liphezulu. Icala lesibili lokushayela uphuzile zingakapheli iminyaka eyishumi liholela ekungavunyelweni okungenani iminyaka emithathu.

 Umthetho we-RTOA isigaba 34.

 Ithebula lesijeziso

 Okubangela ukufa ngokushayela okuyingozi

 • isijeziso esiphezulu: ukuboshwa kwempilo yonke kanye nenhlawulo engenamkhawulo
• ukungafaneleki okuphoqelekile okungenani iminyaka emihlanu
• Amaphuzu ezijeziso angu-3 kuya kwangu-11 uma umuntu owenze icala engafaneleki kakhulu.

 Ukushayela okuyingozi

 • isijeziso esiphezulu: ukuboshwa iminyaka emibili kanye nenhlawulo engenamkhawulo
• ukungafaneleki okuphoqelekile
• Amaphuzu ezijeziso angu-3 kuya kwangu-11 uma umuntu owenze icala engafaneleki kakhulu.

 Ukudala ukufa ngokushayela ngokunganaki ngenkathi uphuze utshwala noma izidakamizwa

 • isijeziso esiphezulu: ukuboshwa kwempilo yonke kanye nenhlawulo engenamkhawulo
• ukungafaneleki okuphoqelekile okungenani iminyaka emihlanu
• Amaphuzu ezijeziso angu-3 kuya kwangu-11 uma umuntu owenze icala engafaneleki kakhulu.
Ukushayela ngokunganaki nokungacabangeli

 • inhlawulo engenamkhawulo
• ukungafaneleki okuzimele
• Amaphuzu ezijeziso angu-3 kuya ku-9.

 Ukushayela ungafaneleki ngenxa yokuphuza utshwala noma izidakamizwa, ukushayela uphuze utshwala ngokweqile, noma ukwehluleka ukunikeza isibonelo sokuhlaziywa

 • inhlawulo ephezulu: ukuboshwa izinyanga eziyisithupha kanye nenhlawulo engenamkhawulo
• ukungafaneleki okuphoqelekile
• Amaphuzu ezijeziso angu-3 kuya ku-11 uma umuntu owenze icala engafaneleki kakhulu.

 Ukwehluleka ukuma ngemva kwengozi noma ukwehluleka ukubika ingozi

 • inhlawulo ephezulu: ukuboshwa izinyanga eziyisithupha kanye nenhlawulo engenamkhawulo
• ukungafaneleki okuqondile
• Amaphuzu ezijeziso angu-5 kuya ku-10.

 Ukushayela ungafaneleki

 • inhlawulo ephezulu: ukuboshwa izinyanga eziyisithupha, noma izinyanga ezingu-12 eScotland, kanye nenhlawulo engenamkhawulo
• ukungafaneleki okuqondile
• Amaphuzu ezijeziso angu-6.
Ukushayela ngemuva kokwenqatshwa noma ukususwa kwelayisensi ngenxa yezizathu zezokwelapha

 • inhlawulo ephezulu: ukuboshwa izinyanga eziyisithupha kanye nenhlawulo engenamkhawulo
• ukungafaneleki okuvunyelwene ngakho
• amaphuzu ezinhlawulo angu-3 kuya kwangu-6.

 Ukushayela ngaphandle komshuwalense

 • inhlawulo engenamkhawulo
• ukungafaneleki okuvunyelwene ngakho
• amaphuzu ezinhlawulo angu-6 kuya kwangu-8.

 Ukusebenzisa imoto esimweni esiyingozi

 • inhlawulo engenamkhawulo yemoto enkulu yezimpahla noma imoto ethwala abagibeli
• inhlawulo ephezulu engu-£2,500 kwezinye izimoto
• ukungafaneleki okuphoqelelwe okungenani izinyanga eziyisithupha uma icala lenziwa zingakapheli iminyaka emithathu yokulahlwa yicala langaphambilini ngecala elifanayo; ngaphandle kwalokho ukungafaneleki kuvunyelwene ngakho
• amaphuzu ezinhlawulo angu-3 esimweni ngasinye.

 Ukwehluleka ukulawula imoto ngendlela efanele noma ukubona umgwaqo kanye nethrafikhi engaphambili

 • inhlawulo ephezulu engu-£1,000, noma u-£2,500 uma ushayela imoto ethwala abagibeli noma yezimpahla
• ukungafaneleki ngokuthanda kwakho
• amaphuzu ezijeziso angu-3.

 Ukusebenzisa ifoni ephathekayo ephathwa ngesandla ngenkathi ushayela

 • inhlawulo ephezulu engu-£1,000, noma u-£2,500 uma ushayela imoto ethwala abagibeli noma yezimpahla
• ukungafaneleki ngokuthanda kwakho
• amaphuzu ezijeziso angu-6.
• ukungabi nalungelo lokushayela ngokuthanda kwakho
• amaphuzu ezijeziso angu-3 kuya kwangu-6.

 Ukuhamba ngesivinini esikhulu

 • inhlawulo ephezulu engu-£1,000, noma u-£2,500 ngecala lomgwaqo omkhulu
• ukungafaneleki ngokuthanda kwakho
• amaphuzu ezijeziso angu-3 kuya kwangu-6, noma amaphuzu angu-3 ngenhlawulo eqondile.

 Amacala omgwaqo

 • inhlawulo ephezulu engu-£1,000
• ukungafaneleki ngokuthanda kwakho
• amaphuzu ezijeziso angu-3.

 Akukho sitifiketi se-MOT

 • inhlawulo ephezulu engu-£1,000
• akukho amaphuzu ezijeziso aboniswe etafuleni.

 Amacala ebhande lesihlalo

 • inhlawulo ephezulu engu-£500
• akukho amaphuzu ezijeziso aboniswe etafuleni.

 Ukugibela ibhayisikili okuyingozi

 • inhlawulo ephezulu engu-£2,500
• akukho maphuzu enhlawulo aboniswe etafuleni.

 Ukugibela ibhayisikili ngokunganaki

 • inhlawulo ephezulu engu-£1,000
• akukho maphuzu enhlawulo aboniswe etafuleni.

 Ukugibela ibhayisikili emgwaqweni

 • inhlawulo ephezulu engu-£500
• akukho maphuzu enhlawulo aboniswe etafuleni.

 Ukwehluleka ukuhlonza umshayeli wemoto

 • inhlawulo ephezulu engu-£1,000
• ukungafaneleki ngokuzikhethela
• amaphuzu enhlawulo ayi-6.

 Ukuhlolwa kabusha ngemva kokungafaneleki

 Lapho inkantolo isusa umuntu owenze icala ngemuva kokulahlwa yicala eliphawulwe njengelidinga ukuhlolwa kabusha okwedlulele, kumele ikhiphe umyalelo wokuthi kuphinde kuhlolwe.

 Inkantolo ingaphinde ikhiphe umyalo:

 • ukuhlolwa kabusha kwanoma yiliphi elinye icala eliphethe amaphuzu esijeziso
• ukuhlolwa okweluliwe lapho ukungafaneleki kuyimpoqo
• ukuhlolwa okuvamile lapho ukungafaneleki kungaphoqelekile.

 Kwamanye amacala angathi sína, inkantolo KUMELE ibeke isikhathi esinqunyiwe sokungafaneleki bese iqhubeka nokungafaneleki kuze kube yilapho umuntu owenze icala ephumelela ukuhlolwa kokushayela. Kwamanye amacala, inkantolo inokuzikhethela kokwenza umyalo onjalo. Kuye ngecala, ukuhlolwa okudingekayo kungaba ukuhlolwa okuvamile noma okweluliwe.

 Umthetho we-RTOA isigaba 36.

 Abashayeli abasha

 Imithetho ekhethekile isebenza iminyaka emibili kusukela ngosuku umshayeli noma umshayeli wesithuthuthu aphumelela ngalo ukuhlolwa kwabo kokuqala kokushayela. Isebenza ku:

 • abantu abavela e-UK, EU noma e-EEA, e-Isle of Man, e-Channel Islands noma e-Gibraltar abaphumelele ukuhlolwa kwabo kokuqala kunoma iyiphi yalezo zindawo
• abashayeli abavela kwamanye amazwe okumele baphumelele ukuhlolwa kwe-UK ukuze bathole ilayisensi yase-UK; ukuhlolwa kwe-UK kuphathwa njengokuhlolwa kwabo kokuqala
• abashayeli abashintsha ilayisensi yangaphandle ngelayisensi yase-UK ngaphandle kokwenza ukuhlolwa bese kamuva baphumelela ukuhlolwa kwe-UK kwesinye isigaba semoto; lokho kuhlolwa kwe-UK kuphathwa njengokuhlolwa kwabo kokuqala.

 Isibonelo, umuntu oshintsha ilayisensi yemoto yangaphandle ngelayisensi yemoto yase-UK bese kamuva ephumelela ukuhlolwa kwe-HGV uba ngaphansi kwemithetho ekhethekile.

 Uma umshayeli omusha eqoqa amaphuzu ayisithupha noma ngaphezulu ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi seminyaka emibili, ilayisensi yakhe iyahoxiswa ngokuzenzakalelayo. Lokhu kufaka amaphuzu atholwe ngaphambi kokuba aphumelele ukuhlolwa.

 Ukuze athole ilayisensi, umuntu kumele afake isicelo selayisensi entsha yesikhashana futhi angashayela kuphela njengomfundi aze aphumelele ukuhlolwa kokushayela okwengeziwe. Bheka futhi iSithasiselo 8, Ikhodi Yokuphepha yabashayeli abasha.

 Umthetho RT(ND)A.

 Le mithetho iyasebenza nalapho amaphuzu ephuma ezenzweni ezibhekene nezijeziso ezihleliwe.

 Umshayeli e-UK, EU noma e-EEA, e-Isle of Man, e-Channel Islands noma eqenjini laseGibraltar osevele enelayisensi ephelele yohlobo olulodwa lwemoto akakho ngaphansi kwemithetho ekhethekile ngoba nje kamuva ephumelela ukuhlolwa kohlobo olunye lwemoto.

 Eminye imiphumela yokwephula umthetho

 Uma icala lijeziswa ngokuboshwa, imoto esetshenzisiwe ukulenza ingathathwa.

 Izigaba zoMthetho we-SA 152, 153, 154 kanye no-155.

 Ukulahlwa yicala lokushayela okungathi sína kungenzeka futhi kwandise izindleko zomshuwalense kakhulu ngoba abahlinzeki bomshuwalense babheka abashayeli abalahlwe yicala ukuthi bangase bahileleke engozini.

 Ngaphambi kokuba ilayisensi yabo ibuyiselwe, abanye abenzi bobubi abasengozini enkulu yokushayela bephuzile kumele bahlangabezane ne-DVLA Medical Branch ukuthi abanankinga yotshwala futhi bakulungele ukushayela. Lokhu kusebenza kubashayeli:

 • abangavunyelwe ukushayela bephuzile kabili phakathi neminyaka eyishumi
• abavunyelwe kanye uma benomthamo wotshwala ongaphezu kokuphindwe kabili nesigamu kunomkhawulo osemthethweni
 • benqaba ukunikeza isampula.

 Ukusetshenziswa kabi kwezidakamizwa noma utshwala njalo kungabangela ukuhoxiswa kwelayisensi yokushayela.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 27. Isithasiselo 6. Ukugcinwa, ukuphepha kanye nokuphepha kwezimoto
description:
Ukulungiswa kwezimoto

 Qaphela kakhulu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi okulandelayo kusebenza kahle:

 • izibani
• amabhuleki
• isiteringi
• uhlelo lokukhipha umoya
• amabhande esihlalo
• ama-demister
• ama-wiper nama-washer e-windscreen
• izinhlelo zokuxwayisa ezizwakalayo.

 KUMELE ugcine izibani, izinkomba, ama-reflector nama-number plate ehlanzekile futhi engaphazanyiswa.

 Izikrini zangemuva namafasitela KUMELE zihlanzeke futhi zingaphazamisi noma yini evimbela ukubuka kwakho.

 Izibani KUMELE zilungiswe kahle ukuze zingakhangi abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo. Naka kakhulu ukulungiswa kwazo lapho imoto ilayishwe kakhulu.

 Ukukhishwa komoya AKUMELE kudlule amazinga anqunyiwe.

 Ngaphambi kokushayela, lungisa kahle isihlalo sakho, ibhande lesihlalo, isithiyo sekhanda kanye nezibuko. Qiniseka ukuthi imithwalo igcinwe kahle.

 Imithetho ye-RVLR 1989 imithethonqubo 23 no-27, kanye nemithethonqubo ye-CUR 30 no-61.

 Izibonisi zesexwayiso

 Qonda incazelo yazo zonke izibonisi zesexwayiso kuphaneli yezinsimbi. Ungalokothi ungasinaki isixwayiso ngoba singase sibonise ukuthi kukhona iphutha eliyingozi elivelayo.

 Izibani zesexwayiso zivame ukukhanya lapho ukushaja kuvuliwe futhi kucime lapho injini iqala, ngaphandle kwesibani sesexwayiso sebhuleki lesandla ngenkathi ibhuleki lesandla lisebenza.

 Uma isibani sesexwayiso singacimi noma sikhanya ngenkathi ushayela, yima bese uphenya ngoba imoto ingaba nephutha elikhulu.

 Isibani sesexwayiso sokushaja esibonakala ngenkathi ushayela singasho ukuthi ibhethri alishaji. Hlola inkinga ngokushesha ngangokunokwenzeka ukuze ugweme ukulahlekelwa amandla ezibani nakwezinye izinhlelo zikagesi.

 Ama-tint amafasitela

 AKUMELE usebenzise imoto enombala omnyama kakhulu esikrinini sangaphambili noma efasiteleni elingaphambili. Umbala osetshenziswa ngesikhathi sokukhiqiza uhambisana nezindinganiso ezisebenzayo ze-Visual Light Transmittance (VLT).

 Akukho mingcele ye-VLT yamafasitela angemuva noma abagibeli bangemuva.

 Imithetho ye-RTA 1988 isigaba 42 kanye nomthethonqubo we-CUR 32.

 Amathayi

 Amathayi KUMELE afuthwe kahle ngokwencazelo yomenzi wemoto ngomthwalo othwalwayo. Bheka incwadi yesandla semoto noma idatha yobuchwepheshe. Amathayi kufanele angabi nokusikeka okuvinjelwe kanye nezinye izinkinga.

 Izimoto, amaveni alula kanye nama-trailer alula KUMELE abe nobude obungu-1.6 mm bokuhamba phakathi kwezingxenye ezintathu kwezine zobubanzi bomgwaqo kanye nokuzungeza wonke umjikelezo wawo.

 Izithuthuthu, izimoto ezinkulu kanye nezimoto ezithwala abagibeli KUMELE zibe nobude obungu-1 mm bokuhamba ngezinyawo kuzo zonke izingxenye ezintathu kwezine zobubanzi bokuhamba ngezinyawo kanye nebhande eliqhubekayo nxazonke.

 Amathayi e-moped kufanele abe nokuhamba ngezinyawo okubonakalayo.

 Amanye amaphutha emoto angabangela amaphuzu okujeziswa.

 Ubudala bamathayi

 Amathayi angaphezu kweminyaka eyishumi ubudala AKUMELE asetshenziswe kuma-axle angaphambili:

 • izimoto zezimpahla ezinesisindo esiphezulu esingaphezu kwamathani angu-3.5
• izimoto zabagibeli ezinezihlalo zabagibeli ezingaphezu kweziyisishiyagalombili.

 AKUMELE zisetshenziswe kuma-axle angemuva ezimoto zabagibeli ezinezihlalo zabagibeli ezingu-9 kuya kwezingu-16 ngaphandle kokuthi i-axle inamasondo amabili.

 Uphawu olubonisa usuku lokwenziwa kwethayi KUMELE luhlale lufundeka ukuze kutholakale ubudala balo.

 Izimoto ezingafakwanga emithethweni yokufaneleka komgwaqo ngamathayi kanye nezimoto ezindala ezingasetshenziswa kwezentengiselwano azinazo lezi zidingo zokufaneleka komgwaqo ngamathayi.

 Umthethonqubo we-CUR 27.

 Ukwehluleka kwamathayi

 Uma ithayi liqhuma ngenkathi ushayela, bamba isiteringi ngokuqinile, zama ukulawula bese uvumela imoto ukuthi ime eceleni komgwaqo.

 Uma unethayi eliphambukile, yima ngokushesha nje lapho liphephile. Lishintshe kuphela uma ungakwenza lokho ngaphandle kokuzifaka engozini wena noma omunye umuntu. Ngaphandle kwalokho, shayela isevisi yokuphazamiseka kwethayi.

 Ukucindezeleka kwamathayi kanye nokuguguleka

 Hlola ukucindezeleka kwamathayi njalo ngesonto, ngaphambi kohambo kanye nalapho amathayi ebanda. Amathayi afudumele noma ashisayo angabangela ukufundwa kokucindezeleka okudukisayo.

 Amathayi angenawo umoya noma angenawo umoya ngokweqile athinta kabi ukubhuleka kanye nokuqondisa.

 Ukuguga ngokweqile noma okungalingani kwamathayi kungabangelwa yilokhu okulandelayo:

 • amaphutha ohlelweni lokubhuleka
• amaphutha okumiswa
• ukulungiswa kwesondo okungalungile.

 Lungisa la maphutha ngokushesha okukhulu.
Amazinga oketshezi kanye nokulungiswa kwasebusika

 Hlola amazinga oketshezi emotweni yakho okungenani masonto onke. Amazinga aphansi oketshezi lwamabhuleki angabangela ukwehluleka kwamabhuleki kanye nokushayisana. Yazi incazelo yanoma yiziphi izibani zesixwayiso ezinoketshezi oluphansi ezifakwe emotweni yakho.

 Ngaphambi kobusika, qiniseka ukuthi ibhethri ligcinwe kahle nokuthi kukhona i-antifreeze efanele ku-radiator kanye nebhodlela lokuwasha i-windscreen.

 Ezinye izinkinga

 Uma imoto idonsa eceleni ngenkathi ibhuleka, imbangela engaba khona yiphutha lamabhuleki noma amathayi akhuphukile ngendlela engafanele. Xhumana negaraji noma umakhenikha ngokushesha.

 Uma imoto iqhubeka nokugxuma ngemuva kokuthi uyicindezele phansi ngaphambili noma ngemuva, ama-shock absorber ayo agugile. Ama-shock absorber agugile angalimaza kakhulu ukusebenza kwemoto futhi kufanele ashintshwe.

 Phenya amaphunga angajwayelekile, okuhlanganisa irabha evuthayo, uphethiloli noma iphunga likagesi, ngokushesha. Ungazifaki engozini yomlilo.

 Izinjini ezishisiwe kakhulu kanye nemililo

 Izinjini eziningi zipholiswa ngamanzi. Uma injini ishisa kakhulu, yivumele iphole ngokwemvelo. Susa isivalo sokugcwalisa i-coolant bese ufaka amanzi noma esinye i-coolant kuphela ngemva kokuba injini ipholile.

 Uma imoto isha, khipha wonke umuntu ngokushesha bese ubahambisa endaweni ephephile. Ungazami ukucima umlilo endaweni yenjini ngoba ukuvula ibhonethi kungabangela umlilo uqhume. Shayela i-fire brigade.

 Ukuphepha kukaphethiloli

 Uma ugcwalisa ithangi likaphethiloli lemoto noma ithini likaphethiloli, gwema ukuchitha uphethiloli egcekeni lesiteshi sikaphethiloli. Bika noma yikuphi ukuchitheka kumuntu osebenzayo ngokushesha.

 Ukuchitheka kukadizili kuyingozi kakhulu kubagibeli bezithuthuthu ngoba kunciphisa kakhulu ukubamba kwamathayi.

 Hlola ukuvuza kukaphethiloli futhi uqiniseke ukuthi:

 • ithangi likaphethiloli aligcwalisiwe ngokweqile
• isivalo sikaphethiloli siboshwe kahle
• isivalo sesivalo asidabukile, asinyamalalanga noma asilahlekanga
• isivalo sikaphethiloli kanye nethangi azinawo umonakalo obonakalayo
• noma yisiphi isivalo sikaphethiloli esiphuthumayo sakha isivalo esihle.

 Ungalokothi ubheme noma usebenzise ifoni ephathekayo egcekeni lesiteshi sikaphethiloli. Kokubili kuyingozi enkulu yomlilo futhi kungabangela ukuqhuma.

 Izimoto zezentengiselwano

 Qedela konke ukuhlolwa kokuhamba kwansuku zonke okunconywe yi-Driver and Vehicle Standards Agency kanye ne-Fleet Operator Recognition Scheme.

 Ukuphepha kwezimoto zezentengiselwano ze-DVSA
(https://www.gov.uk/dvsa/commercial-vehicle-safety)

 Uhlelo Lokuqashelwa Kwabaqhubi Bezimoto
(https://www.fors-online.org.uk)

 Ukuphepha kwezimoto

 Noma nini lapho ushiya imoto yakho:

 • susa ukhiye wokushisa bese ubamba ilokhi yokuqondisa
• vala imoto, noma ngabe uyishiya imizuzu embalwa kuphela
• vala wonke amafasitela ngokuphelele
• ungalokothi ushiye izingane noma izilwane ezifuywayo emotweni engenamoya
• thatha konke okuqukethwe noma uzikhiye ebhuthini
• ungalokothi ushiye amadokhumenti emoto ngaphakathi.

 Isikhwama sokuthwala singabonakala siqukethe izinto eziyigugu futhi sidonsele isela ngisho noma okuqukethwe kwaso kungabalulekile.

 Ukuze uthole ukuphepha okwengeziwe, faka idivayisi yokulwa nokwebiwa njenge-alamu noma i-immobiliser. Uma uthenga imoto entsha, hlola izici zayo zokuphepha ezakhelwe ngaphakathi.

 Cabanga ngokuqopha inombolo yokubhalisa yemoto kuwo wonke amafasitela. Lokhu kuyindlela yokuvimbela engabizi futhi ephumelelayo kumasela ochwepheshe.

subcategory: 1. Bhekana nengozi. 2. Thola usizo. 3. Siza labo abahilelekile. 4. Nikeza ukunakekelwa okuphuthumayo
englishSubcategory: 1. Deal with danger. 2. Get help. 3. Help those involved. 4. Provide emergency care
description:
1. Bhekana nengozi

 Ezinye izingozi kanye nomlilo yizona zingozi eziyinhloko ngemva kwengozi.

 Sondela ezimotweni ezihilelekile ngokucophelela futhi uqaphele izingozi ezifana namafutha achithekile kanye nengilazi ephukile. Cisha zonke izinjini futhi, uma kungenzeka, uxwayise abanye abantu.

 Uma unemoto, vula izibani zayo zokuxwayisa ngengozi. Vimbela noma ubani ekubhemeni eduze kwengozi. Uma ikhithi yakho yosizo lokuqala inamagilavu, wagqoke.

 2. Thola usizo

 Uma kuphephile, cela abantu ababukele ukuthi bakusize. Cela othile ukuthi ashayele izinsizakalo eziphuthumayo ezifanele ku-999 noma ku-112 ngokushesha okukhulu.

 Izinsizakalo eziphuthumayo zizodinga:

 • indawo eqondile yengozi
• indlela yomgwaqo, njengokuya enyakatho noma eningizimu
• inani lezimoto ezihilelekile
• ulwazi ngesimo sabalimele.

 Bika ukuthi kukhona yini:

 • onenkinga yokuphefumula
• opha kakhulu
• ubhajwe emotweni
• akaphenduli lapho kukhulunywa naye.

 3. Siza labo abahilelekile

 UNGASUSI umuntu olimele emotweni ngaphandle kokuthi kukhona ingozi eyengeziwe.

 UNGAKHUMULI isigqoko somshayeli wesithuthuthu ngaphandle kokuthi ukwenza kanjalo kubalulekile.

 YENZA:

 • gcina abalimele befudumele, bomile futhi bekhululekile ngangokunokwenzeka
• baqinisekise ngokuthula nangokuzethemba
• zama ukungabashiyi bodwa
• ubavimbele ekuzulazuleni endleleni yethrafikhi.

 UNGANIKI abalimele noma yini yokudla noma yokuphuza.

 4. Nikeza ukunakekelwa okuphuthumayo

 Khumbula i-DRABC: Ingozi, Impendulo, Indlela Yomoya, Ukuphefumula kanye Nokujikeleza Kwegazi.

 D — Ingozi

 Hlola ukuthi kuphephile yini ukusondela kolimele.

 R — Impendulo

 Zama ukuthola impendulo ngokushukumisa amahlombe olimele kancane bese ubuza ngokuzwakalayo, ‘Uphilile?’ Uma olimele ephendula, hlola ukulimala.

 A — Indlela Yomoya

 Uma kungekho mpendulo, vula indlela yomoya ngokubeka iminwe yakho ngaphansi kwesilevu solimele bese uyiphakamisa phambili.

 Uma olimele engazi lutho kodwa ephefumula, mbeke endaweni yokululama kuze kufike usizo lwezokwelapha.

 B — Ukuphefumula

 Hlola ukuthi olimele uphefumula ngendlela evamile yini:

 • bheka ukunyakaza kwesifuba
• bheka futhi ulalele ukuphefumula
• zwa umoya esihlathini sakho.

 Uma kungekho zimpawu zokuphefumula, qala ukuvuselela inhliziyo namaphaphu (CPR).

 Kumuntu omdala:

 • xhuma iminwe yakho
• beka izandla zakho maphakathi nesifuba
• cindezela phansi ngokuqinile nangokushesha
• cindezela isifuba cishe ngamasentimitha angu-5 kuya kwangu-6
• cindezela cishe kabili ngomzuzwana.

 Kumntwana, kungadingeka usebenzise isandla esisodwa kuphela futhi akufanele ucindezele phansi kuze kube yilapho.

 Kumntwana osanda kuzalwa, sebenzisa iminwe emibili maphakathi nesifuba bese usicindezela cishe ingxenye yesithathu yokujula kwaso.

 Qhubeka ne-CPR kuze kube yilapho olimele eqala ukuphefumula futhi noma uchwepheshe wezokwelapha ethatha izintambo.

 C — Ukujikeleza kwegazi

 Uma olimele esabela futhi ephefumula, funa ukopha. Zivikele ekuthinteni igazi.

 Hlola ukuthi kukhona yini, njengengilazi, efakwe enxebeni. Ungasusi into efakwe enxebeni. Gwema ukuyicindezela bese wakha i-padding nxazonke zombili.

 Uma kungekho lutho olufakwe enxebeni, cindezela ngokuqinile phezu kwenxeba ukuze uvimbele ukulahleka kwegazi. Ngokushesha ngangokunokwenzeka, bopha i-pad phezu kwenxeba ngebhandeji noma ubude bendwangu. Sebenzisa izinto ezihlanzekile kakhulu ezitholakalayo.

 Ukusha

 Cima noma yimaphi amalangabi ngenkathi uvikela ukuphepha kwakho. Pholisa ukusha okungenani imizuzu engama-20 usebenzisa amanzi amaningi ahlanzekile, abandayo.

 Mboza ukusha nge-cling film uma ikhona. Ungasusi noma yini enamathele ekushiseni.

 Lungela

 Njalo phatha ikhithi yosizo lokuqala. Ungase ungaludingi, kodwa lungasindisa impilo.

 Funda usizo lokuqala enhlanganweni efanelekayo efana nalokhu:

 • I-St John Ambulance
• Usizo Lokuqala LwaseSt Andrew
• I-British Red Cross
• enye inhlangano efanelekile.

category: Ikhodi Yomgwaqo Omkhulu. 29. Isijobelelo 8. Ikhodi yokuphepha yabashayeli abasha
subcategory: Ikhodi yokuphepha. Umthetho Wabashayeli Abasha. Ukuqeqeshwa okwengeziwe
englishSubcategory: The safety code. New Drivers Act. Further training
description:
Ikhodi yokuphepha

 Izingozi eziningi ezimbi kakhulu zenzeka ebusuku. Isikhathi esiphakathi kwamabili no-6 ekuseni siletha ingozi enkulu kakhulu kubashayeli abasha. Gwema ukushayela phakathi nalezi zikhathi ngaphandle uma kudingeka ngempela.

 Abagibeli

 Uma uthwala abagibeli, unesibopho sokuphepha kwabo. Ungabavumeli bakuphazamise noma bakuncenge ukuthi uthathe izingozi. Chaza ukuthi udinga ukugxila ukuze ufike lapho uya khona ngokuphephile.

 Ungalokothi ubonise noma uzame ukuncintisana nabanye abashayeli, ikakhulukazi uma beshayela kabi.

 Utshwala, izidakamizwa nemithi

 Ungashayeli ngemva kokuphuza utshwala noma ukuthatha izidakamizwa.

 Ngisho nemithi etholakalayo ngaphandle kwemithi kadokotela ingase iphazamise ikhono lakho lokushayela ngokuphephile. Funda ilebula ukuze uthole ukuthi umuthi ungathinta yini ukushayela kwakho.

 Amabhande esihlalo

 Qiniseka ukuthi wonke umuntu emotweni ubopha ibhande lesihlalo kulo lonke uhambo.

 Isivinini kanye nokulawula imoto

 Gcina ijubane lakho liphansi. Izingozi eziningi ezinkulu zenzeka ngoba abashayeli balahlekelwa ukulawula, ikakhulukazi lapho bejika.

 Izimoto ezinamandla

 Abashayeli abaningi abasha abanalo ulwazi ngezimoto ezinamandla noma zezemidlalo. Ngaphandle kokuthi ufunde emotweni enjalo, thola ulwazi oluningi lokushayela ngokuzimela ngaphambi kokushayela imoto enamandla kakhulu.

 Umshuwalense

 Ukushayela ngaphandle komshuwalense kuyicala. Bheka iSithasiselo 3, Imibhalo yezimoto kanye nezidingo zomshayeli ofundayo, ukuthola ulwazi mayelana nezinhlobo ezitholakalayo zesembozo somshuwalense.
Umthetho Wabashayeli Abasha

 Ngaphansi koMthetho Wabashayeli Abasha, ilayisensi yakho izohoxiswa uma uqoqa amaphuzu ayisithupha ezijeziso zingakapheli iminyaka emibili uphumelele ukuhlolwa kwakho kokuqala kokushayela.

 Ukuze uthole ilayisensi egcwele, kufanele uphinde uphumelele kokubili ukuhlolwa kwethiyori kanye nokuhlolwa kokushayela okusebenzayo.

 Ukuqeqeshwa okwengeziwe

 Cabanga ngokuqeqeshwa okwengeziwe kokushayela okufana nePass Plus. Kungasiza ekunciphiseni ingozi yakho yokubandakanyeka engozini futhi kunganciphisa nezindleko zomshuwalense wakho.

 Ulwazi olwengeziwe

 GOV.UK
(https://www.gov.uk)

 I-imeyili yePass Plus
(passplus@dvsa.gov.uk)

description:
